# Reazix Billing Software: complete documentation (version 1.0.0)

Source: https://billing.reazix.com/help/

---

# Reazix Billing documentation

URL: https://billing.reazix.com/help/

Make GST invoices, keep track of who owes you, and prepare your GST returns. On your own computer, with no account and no monthly fee.

**One payment, yours for life. Works on your computer, even offline. No tracking. No ads.**
Your invoices never leave your computer, there is no account to make, and nothing is ever sold to you inside the app. Don't take our word for it: [check it yourself in two minutes](https://billing.reazix.com/help/security.html#check-yourself).

- [Install it Download, extract, click Install. About three minutes, no admin rights needed.](https://billing.reazix.com/help/install.html)
- [Make your first invoice From a blank app to a GST tax invoice you can send, in five minutes.](https://billing.reazix.com/help/first-invoice.html)
- [Something isn't working The common problems, what causes each one, and the fix.](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html)

## What it does

Reazix Billing is invoicing and GST software for small businesses in India, and for anyone billing in other currencies: 20 are supported. It runs on your computer and opens in your web browser, the way a website does, but nothing leaves your machine.

- **Invoices**: tax invoices, bills of supply, proforma estimates, credit notes and delivery challans, with CGST, SGST, IGST and UTGST worked out for you.
- **Getting paid**: record payments, print receipts, see who is overdue and by how much.
- **GST returns**: GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B built from your invoices and purchases, as files you upload to the GST portal.
- **The rest of the books**: clients, products and stock, purchases, expenses, recurring invoices, profit and loss, and an income tax calculator.

## What you need

| Computer | Windows 10 or 11, macOS, or Linux (a NAS works too). |

| Browser | Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Brave. The app opens in it. |

| Disk space | Roughly 200 MB once installed. |

| Internet | Only for the first install and for updates. Everything else works offline. |

| Account or signup | None. |

## Where your data lives

Every invoice, client and setting is saved as plain files inside the app's folder, in _system\data. They never leave your computer unless you turn on Google Drive backup yourself.

That also means backing up is your job, and it is easy. See [Backups, updates and moving PC](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html).

## What does it cost?

One payment, and the app is yours for life. There is no subscription, no invoice limit and no advertising, and your purchase includes 3 years of updates. Ask us at contact@reazix.com.

## Getting help

Every screen in the app with a ? button links to the matching part of these pages. If something is missing here, or the app does something these pages don't describe, email us with a screenshot. Many features began as someone's request.

---

# Install on Windows, step by step

URL: https://billing.reazix.com/help/install.html

Paste one line and press Enter. About 3 minutes, no technical knowledge needed, no administrator password, and no "Windows protected your PC" warning. Every step below says what to press and what you will see.

**Which guide is mine?**
**Windows** (most PCs and laptops): [Install on Windows](https://billing.reazix.com/help/install.html).
**Mac** (Apple logo top left): [Install on a Mac](https://billing.reazix.com/help/install-mac.html).
**Linux or a NAS**: [Install on Linux or a NAS](https://billing.reazix.com/help/install-linux.html).
Already installed? [Updating](https://billing.reazix.com/help/update.html).
Wondering whether it is safe? [Is it safe? Security and privacy](https://billing.reazix.com/help/security.html).

## Before you start

- **Windows 10 or Windows 11.** To check: press Windows + R, type winver, press Enter.
- **Internet** for the install only (it downloads about 25 MB). After that the app works offline.
- **About 600 MB of free space.**

## Install with one line

- **Copy this line**Click the Copy button at the right end of the line below. (Or select all of it with the mouse and press Ctrl + C.)

```
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c "[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol='Tls12'; irm https://billing.reazix.com/install.ps1 | iex"
```

- **Press Windows + R**Hold the Windows key (the one with the Windows logo) and press R. A small **Run** box opens at the bottom left.
- **Paste and press Enter**Click in the box, press Ctrl + V, then press Enter.
- **Watch it work**A blue or black window shows four steps, each ending in **OK**:

```
[1/4] Checking this computer ... OK
[2/4] Downloading (25 MB) ...
[3/4] Installing ... OK
[4/4] Adding icons ... OK
```

It may also fetch Node.js, the engine the app runs on (about 30 MB, kept inside the app folder).

- **Answer one question**It asks Open Reazix Billing by itself when this computer starts? Type Y and press Enter for yes, or just press Enter for no.
- **The app opens in its own window**The window says Done! Opening Reazix Billing... and the app appears, with no browser tabs or address bar. A short welcome asks for your business details; see [The first-run setup](https://billing.reazix.com/help/first-run.html). The install window closes by itself.

**Every day after that:** click the **Reazix Billing** icon on your Desktop or in the Start menu.

**To update or repair it:** do the same three steps again. It finds your install, backs up your data to Documents\Reazix Billing Backups, and replaces only the app's own files. Your invoices, clients and settings stay exactly as they are.

**If the window shows PROBLEM in red**
The line under it says what to do (no internet, the disk is full, the folder cannot be written to). Do that, then paste the same line again; it carries on where it stopped. Nothing in your data is changed by a failed install.

The app is installed to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Reazix Billing. If you installed it from the ZIP before, the line finds that copy (through its Desktop shortcut) and updates it where it is. Your data is in the _system\data folder inside it.

## Other way: download the ZIP

For offices that copy the app from a USB stick, or where the line above is blocked. It takes a few more clicks and Windows shows a warning the first time.

## Step 1: Download

- **Click this button**[Download Reazix Billing](https://billing.reazix.com/download/Reazix-Billing.zip)
- **Wait for the download to finish**Your browser shows it at the top right (Chrome and Edge) or bottom left. The file is called Reazix-Billing.zip.
- **Open your Downloads folder**Click the folder icon next to the download, or open **File Explorer** (the yellow folder on the taskbar) and click **Downloads** on the left.

## Step 2: Unzip (extract) it

A ZIP is a packed folder. Windows can open it, but the app cannot run from inside it, so it has to be unpacked first.

- **Right-click the ZIP**Right-click Reazix-Billing.zip and choose Extract All…. (On Windows 11 it may be under Show more options.)
- **Choose where**Click Browse… and pick **Documents**, or a drive like D:\. Not **Downloads**: things there get deleted when people tidy up. Do not choose C:\Program Files.
- **Click Extract**A new folder called **Reazix-Billing** opens. Inside you see **Reazix Billing - WINDOWS**, **READ ME FIRST**, and launchers for Mac and Linux.

If you double-click the launcher while still looking inside the ZIP, it says Please extract the ZIP first. Close it and do this step.

## Step 3: Open the launcher and click Install

- **Double-click "Reazix Billing - WINDOWS"**In the Reazix-Billing folder.
- **If Windows warns you**See "Windows protected your PC" just below: click More info, then Run anyway. If it asks Do you want to run this file?, click Run or Open.
- **Click Install**A small window opens with one big button. Click Install. There is nothing to fill in.
- **Leave the black window alone**A black window appears and does the work: it may get Node.js (the engine the app runs on, about 30 MB, kept inside the app folder). This takes 1 to 3 minutes. Don't close it; it closes by itself.
- **The app opens by itself**in its own window, at http://localhost:47371. A **Reazix Billing** icon is now on your Desktop and in the Start menu. A short welcome asks for your business details. See [The first-run setup](https://billing.reazix.com/help/first-run.html).

Before install the launcher shows one button. Afterwards it shows Open App, and the rest is under More options.

**If the black window shows a message in red**
It says what is wrong and what to do (no internet, disk full, folder in the wrong place, antivirus). Do that, then click Install again; it carries on where it stopped. The full list is in [The install stopped with an error](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#install-failed).

## "Windows protected your PC"

This blue box appears the first time for any program that is not signed with a paid certificate (a certificate Reazix does not have yet). It does not mean anything is wrong. More in [Is the install safe?](https://billing.reazix.com/help/security.html#install-safety)

- Click the small link More info.
- Click the button Run anyway.

If the file will not open at all: right-click **Reazix Billing - WINDOWS**, choose Properties, tick Unblock at the bottom, click OK, and double-click it again.

If your antivirus deletes a file during the install, add the Reazix-Billing folder to its exclusions (often under Exclusions or Allowed apps) and click Install again.

## Every day after that

- **Double-click the "Reazix Billing" icon on your Desktop**The install put this icon (the blue **R**) there and in the Start menu. It starts the app and opens it in its own window. There is nothing else to click.

Update, back up, restore, restart and stop the app from the [Control Panel](https://billing.reazix.com/help/control-panel.html) in the app's menu. Restarting the computer also stops it. The launcher, **Reazix Billing - WINDOWS** in the Reazix-Billing folder, stays there for updates and repairs.

Your data is in the _system\data folder inside Reazix-Billing; see [Backups](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html).

Use only this icon. If you also have a Reazix Billing app icon made by Chrome or Edge, remove it (right-click it, then Uninstall): it opens a window but cannot start the app.

## What the installer does

- **Checks your PC**: Windows 10 or 11, enough free space, a folder it can write to, and the internet.
- **Sets up Node.js inside the app folder** if the PC does not have a recent one. It is downloaded once from nodejs.org into _system\node. Nothing is installed into Windows and no administrator password is needed. If that download fails, it asks before using Windows' own installer (winget), and otherwise opens the download page.
- **Adds a Reazix Billing shortcut** to your Desktop and Start menu.
- **Opens the app** in your browser.

The app's parts come inside the ZIP, so nothing else is downloaded.

## For IT people

The one line can also be pasted into an open PowerShell window. To install into another folder, set it first: $env:REAZIX_DIR = 'D:\Apps\Reazix Billing'. If that folder already has the app, it is updated in place.

## Removing the app

**Back up your data first** if you may want it again. See [Export everything to one file](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html#export-import).

**The easy way:** in the app, open Control Panel and use Remove…. Tick what else to delete (your data, PDFs, backups) and click Remove the app. See [Remove the App](https://billing.reazix.com/help/control-panel.html#remove). Or, with the app closed, double-click **Reazix Billing - WINDOWS** in the app folder, click **More options**, then Remove the app...: the same tick boxes, then Remove the app.

**Or with one line:** press Windows + R, paste this line and press Enter:

```
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c "[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol='Tls12'; & ([scriptblock]::Create((irm https://billing.reazix.com/install.ps1))) -Uninstall"
```

It stops the app and removes it and its icons. Your invoices, clients and settings are kept unless you type DELETE when it asks (and even then a last copy goes to Documents\Reazix Billing Backups).

By hand: in the launcher, More options → Stop the app, then delete the app folder and the **Reazix Billing** shortcuts on the Desktop and in the Start menu. Nothing is installed into Windows itself.

---

# Install on a Mac, step by step

URL: https://billing.reazix.com/help/install-mac.html

Paste one line into Terminal and press Return. About 3 minutes, no password, and no "Apple cannot check it" message. Every step says what you will see.

**Which guide is mine?**
**Windows** (most PCs and laptops): [Install on Windows](https://billing.reazix.com/help/install.html).
**Mac** (Apple logo top left): [Install on a Mac](https://billing.reazix.com/help/install-mac.html).
**Linux or a NAS**: [Install on Linux or a NAS](https://billing.reazix.com/help/install-linux.html).
Already installed? [Updating](https://billing.reazix.com/help/update.html).
Wondering whether it is safe? [Is it safe? Security and privacy](https://billing.reazix.com/help/security.html).

## Before you start

- **macOS 11 Big Sur or newer.** To check: click the Apple menu (the apple logo at the top left), then About This Mac.
- **Internet** for the install. After that the app works offline.
- **About 600 MB of free space.**

## Install with one line

- **Copy this line**Click the Copy button at the right end of the line below. (Or select all of it and press Cmd + C.)

```
curl -fsSL https://billing.reazix.com/install.sh | bash
```

- **Open Terminal**Press Cmd + Space, type Terminal and press Return. A plain text window opens. (More help: [Opening Terminal on a Mac](https://billing.reazix.com/help/terminal.html#mac).)
- **Paste and press Return**Press Cmd + V, then Return.
- **Watch it work**It shows four steps, each ending in **OK**: [1/4] Checking this computer, [2/4] Downloading (also Node.js, the engine the app runs on, if this Mac does not have it), [3/4] Installing, [4/4] Adding icons.
- **Answer two questions**Add Reazix Billing to the Dock? [y/N] and Open Reazix Billing by itself when this computer starts? [y/N]. Type y and press Return for yes, or just Return for no.
- **The app opens**It says Done! Opening Reazix Billing... and the app appears in its own window if you have Chrome or Edge, or in Safari otherwise. A short welcome asks for your business details; see [The first-run setup](https://billing.reazix.com/help/first-run.html). You can close Terminal.

**Every day after that:** click **Reazix Billing** in the Dock or in Launchpad. (It lives in the **Applications** folder inside your home folder: Finder → Go → Home → **Applications**.)

**To update or repair it:** paste the same line again. It backs up your data to Documents/Reazix Billing Backups and replaces only the app's own files; your invoices, clients and settings stay as they are.

If something goes wrong, Terminal shows **PROBLEM** and, under it, what to do. Do that, then paste the line again.

The app's files are in Applications/Reazix Billing in your home folder; your data is in _system/data inside it.

## Removing the app

**The easy way:** in the app, open Control Panel and use Remove…, then tick what else to delete. See [Remove the App](https://billing.reazix.com/help/control-panel.html#remove).

**Or** paste this into Terminal and press Return:

```
curl -fsSL https://billing.reazix.com/install.sh | bash -s -- --uninstall
```

It removes the app and its icon. Your invoices are kept unless you type DELETE when it asks. If the app is in the Dock, drag it out.

## Other way: download the ZIP

Three parts: install Node.js, download the app, open it. About 10 minutes.

## Part 1: Install Node.js (once)

Node.js is free software the app runs on. It installs like any other Mac app.

- **Go to nodejs.org**Open [nodejs.org/en/download](https://nodejs.org/en/download) in Safari or Chrome.
- **Download the macOS Installer**Click the button for the **macOS Installer (.pkg)** of the **LTS** version. (LTS means the stable version.)
- **Open the downloaded file**Click the download arrow in your browser, or open **Finder** → **Downloads**, and double-click the file whose name starts with node-v and ends in .pkg.
- **Click through the installer**Continue, Continue, Agree, Install. Type your Mac password when asked and click Install Software. Then Close. (If it asks to move the installer to the Bin, that is fine.)

## Part 2: Download and unzip the app

- **Download**[Download Reazix Billing](https://billing.reazix.com/download/Reazix-Billing.zip)
- **Find it in Downloads**Open **Finder** (the blue face in the Dock) and click **Downloads** on the left. **Safari** usually unzips it for you, so you see a folder called **Reazix-Billing**. If you see Reazix-Billing.zip instead, double-click it to unzip.
- **Move the folder to Documents**Drag the **Reazix-Billing** folder onto **Documents** on the left of Finder, so it is not deleted when Downloads is cleared. Your invoices will be kept inside it.

## Part 3: Open it the first time

Apple asks you to confirm apps that are not from the App Store. This is needed **once**.

- **Control-click the launcher**In the Reazix-Billing folder, hold the Control key and click **Reazix Billing - MAC** (or right-click it, or click with two fingers on a trackpad). Choose Open.
- **Confirm**A box says macOS cannot check the developer. Click Open.
- **On macOS 15 Sequoia or newer, if there is no Open button**Click Done. Open the Apple menu (the apple logo) → System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll down to the message about **Reazix Billing - MAC**, click Open Anyway, type your password, then Open Anyway again.
- **A Terminal window opens**It is a plain text window; you do not need to type anything in it. (A download from before version 1.10.83 asks Install now? [Y/n]: press Return.)
- **Wait up to a minute**When it says Server running. This window can be closed, the app opens in your browser at http://localhost:47371.
- **Close the Terminal window**The app keeps running. A short welcome asks for your business details; see [The first-run setup](https://billing.reazix.com/help/first-run.html).

## If the Mac shows a message

- **"could not be executed because you do not have appropriate access privileges"**: you have a download from before v1.10.82. Download it again (Part 2), or fix this copy: open Terminal (see [Opening Terminal on a Mac](https://billing.reazix.com/help/terminal.html#mac)), type chmod +x and a space, drag **Reazix Billing - MAC** from Finder into the Terminal window, press Return, then go back to Part 3.
- **"Node.js is not installed"** in the Terminal window: do Part 1, then open the launcher again. If it asks Open the Node.js download page now? [y/N], type y and press Return.
- **"Node.js ... is too old"**: install the current LTS from nodejs.org (Part 1); it replaces the old one.
- **"The app cannot reach the internet"** or the install stops: check the Wi-Fi, then open the launcher again; it carries on.

More in [The Mac will not open the launcher](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#mac-blocked).

## Every day after that

- **Double-click "Reazix Billing - MAC"**After the first time, a normal double-click works. If the app is already running it just opens your browser.

**Tip:** make a Desktop shortcut. Control-click the launcher → Make Alias, and drag the alias to your Desktop. You can also bookmark http://localhost:47371 in your browser; it works while the app is running.

To stop the app: in the app open **Control Panel** in the sidebar and click Stop Server. Restarting the Mac also stops it.

Your data is in Reazix-Billing/_system/data. Updating: see [Updating on a Mac](https://billing.reazix.com/help/update.html#mac); never drag a new download over the old folder.

# Install on Linux or a NAS, step by step

URL: https://billing.reazix.com/help/install-linux.html

For Ubuntu, Linux Mint, Debian, Fedora and similar: paste one line into the Terminal and press Enter. No password needed. Each step is explained.

**Which guide is mine?**
**Windows** (most PCs and laptops): [Install on Windows](https://billing.reazix.com/help/install.html).
**Mac** (Apple logo top left): [Install on a Mac](https://billing.reazix.com/help/install-mac.html).
**Linux or a NAS**: [Install on Linux or a NAS](https://billing.reazix.com/help/install-linux.html).
Already installed? [Updating](https://billing.reazix.com/help/update.html).
Wondering whether it is safe? [Is it safe? Security and privacy](https://billing.reazix.com/help/security.html).

## Open the Terminal

Press Ctrl + Alt + T. A window opens where you type commands. New to this? Read [Using the Terminal](https://billing.reazix.com/help/terminal.html) first; it takes two minutes.

To paste a command into the Terminal, use Ctrl + Shift + V (not Ctrl + V), then press Enter.

## Install with one line

- **Copy this line, paste it into the Terminal, press Enter**

```
curl -fsSL https://billing.reazix.com/install.sh | bash
```

- **Watch it work**It shows four steps, each ending in **OK**: [1/4] Checking this computer, [2/4] Downloading (also Node.js, the engine the app runs on, if the computer does not have version 18 or newer; it is kept inside the app folder), [3/4] Installing, [4/4] Adding icons.
- **Answer one question**Open Reazix Billing by itself when this computer starts? [y/N]: type y and press Enter, or just Enter for no.
- **The app opens**In its own window if you have Chrome, Chromium or Edge, or in your browser otherwise.

**Every day after that:** open **Reazix Billing** from your applications menu. **To update or repair it:** run the same line again; your data is backed up to ~/Documents/Reazix Billing Backups first and never touched.

If it says curl: command not found, run sudo apt install -y curl first. The app goes to ~/.local/share/reazix-billing; your data is in _system/data inside it.

**NAS or Alpine:** there may be no bash; end the line with | sh instead. Alpine needs Node.js from its own store first: sudo apk add nodejs. To choose the folder, put REAZIX_DIR=/volume1/apps/reazix-billing just before sh.

**To remove it** (your invoices are kept unless you type DELETE when asked):

```
curl -fsSL https://billing.reazix.com/install.sh | bash -s -- --uninstall
```

## Other way: download the ZIP

Install Node.js yourself, then unzip and start the app.

## Step 1: Install Node.js 20

The Node.js in Ubuntu's own store is often too old for the app, so it comes from NodeSource, the official source for Linux. Paste these one at a time, pressing Enter after each:

```
sudo apt install -y curl unzip
```

```
curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | sudo -E bash -
```

```
sudo apt install -y nodejs
```

**When it asks for your password**, type the password you use to log in and press Enter. **Nothing appears while you type**, not even dots; that is normal.

Check it worked:

```
node -v
```

It should print v20 or higher, for example v20.19.0.

**Fedora:** sudo dnf install nodejs npm. **Arch:** sudo pacman -S nodejs npm. **Alpine / NAS:** sudo apk add nodejs npm.

## Step 2: Download and unzip

- **Download**[Download Reazix Billing](https://billing.reazix.com/download/Reazix-Billing.zip) It goes into your **Downloads** folder.
- **Unzip it**Paste this in the Terminal and press Enter: it unpacks the app into a folder in your home folder.

```
cd ~ && unzip -o ~/Downloads/Reazix-Billing.zip
```

## Step 3: Start the app

```
cd ~/Reazix-Billing && bash "Reazix Billing - LINUX.sh"
```

- **Wait up to a minute**When it says Server running, the app opens in your browser at http://localhost:47371. You can close the Terminal; the app keeps running. (A download from before version 1.10.83 first asks Install now? [Y/n]: press Enter.)

**Every day after that**, open the Terminal and run the same command. Or bookmark http://localhost:47371; it works while the app is running. To stop the app: **Control Panel** in the app → Stop Server, or restart the computer.

## On a NAS or server (for IT people)

```
unzip Reazix-Billing.zip
cd Reazix-Billing
bash "_system/start-unix.sh"
```

The ZIP carries the app's packages, so there is no npm install; any Node.js 18 or newer runs it.

The app listens on 127.0.0.1:47371 only (it has no login, so it is never opened to the network). Updating from inside the app needs unzip or python3.

---

# Updating the app, step by step

URL: https://billing.reazix.com/help/update.html

Your purchase includes 3 years of updates. Updating keeps all your invoices, clients and settings, and the app backs them up first. The easiest way is one button inside the app.

## The easy way: the Update button (Windows, Mac, Linux)

- **Open the app**When a new version is out, the sidebar shows **Update to v…** (you can also go to **Settings → App Updates**).
- **Read what is new and click Update Now**A window shows what changed. Click Update Now.
- **Wait about a minute**A window shows the progress; it backs up your data first, then updates.
- **Reload the page**Press F5 (on a Mac Cmd + R). The version at the bottom of the Dashboard shows the new number.

Changes still look the same? Press Ctrl + F5 (Mac: Cmd + Shift + R) to make the browser load the new version.

### The "Update available" window

It opens when you click **Update to v…** in the sidebar. At the top it shows the new version and the one you are on, with the date it was released.

| Part | What it means |

| **Your data is safe.** | Updating replaces only the app itself. Your data folder (invoices, clients, products, settings) and your Saved Invoices PDFs are never touched. |

| The release notes | What changed in this version. |

| **Recommended:** export a backup | Open Settings → Data Management takes you to [Export Backup](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html#export-import). Worth doing before any update, just in case. |

| Skip this version | Hides the **Update to v…** button for this version. The next version will be offered as usual, and you can still update from **Settings → App Updates**. |

| Remind me later | Closes the window; the sidebar button stays. |

| Release notes | Opens the release page in your browser. |

| Update Now | Backs up your data, then fetches and installs the new version. It takes about a minute: leave the window open, then reload the page when it finishes. |

**Something wrong?**
If the update stops with an error, your data is still safe. See [The update failed](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#update-failed), or use one of the other ways on this page.

## Also easy: the install line again

The line that installs the app also updates it, and repairs it if it will not start. It finds your install, backs up your data first, replaces only the app's own files and opens the new version.

**Windows:** press Windows + R, paste this, press Enter:

```
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c "[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol='Tls12'; irm https://billing.reazix.com/install.ps1 | iex"
```

**Mac and Linux:** open Terminal, paste this, press Return:

```
curl -fsSL https://billing.reazix.com/install.sh | bash
```

## Windows: other ways

**From the launcher:** double-click **Reazix Billing - WINDOWS** in the Reazix-Billing folder → More options → Update to the latest version → then Open App.

**By hand, with the ZIP** (if the app does not open at all):

- **Download**[Download Reazix Billing](https://billing.reazix.com/download/Reazix-Billing.zip)
- **Stop the app**Launcher → More options → Stop the app.
- **Extract into the same place as before**Right-click the ZIP → Extract All… → Browse… → choose the folder that contains your Reazix-Billing folder (for example **Documents**) → Extract.
- **Replace the files**Windows asks about files that already exist: choose Replace the files in the destination. On Windows this **adds** to your folder; your _system\data folder is not touched.
- **Open the app**Double-click **Reazix Billing - WINDOWS** → Open App. The first start after an update takes a minute.

If you extracted the new ZIP somewhere else and opened its launcher, it says Reazix Billing is already installed on this computer and offers Update the installed copy: use that, and delete the new folder.

## Mac: other ways

Use the Update button in the app. That is the safe way on a Mac.

**Never drag a new download over your old folder on a Mac**
On a Mac, Finder's Replace swaps the **whole** folder, including _system/data with all your invoices. (Windows merges folders; the Mac does not.)

If the app will not open and you need the new download:

- **Back up first**If the app opens: **Settings → Data Management → Export Backup…**.
- **Download and unzip the new version**It appears as a new folder (macOS may call it **Reazix-Billing 2**).
- **Move your data across**In your **old** folder open _system (if you cannot see it, press Cmd + Shift + . in Finder to show hidden folders) and copy the data folder. In the **new** folder open _system and paste it (Cmd + V), choosing Replace for that **data** folder only.
- **Open the new launcher**As in [Install on a Mac, Part 3](https://billing.reazix.com/help/install-mac.html#open). When everything works, you can delete the old folder.

## Linux: other ways

Use the Update button, or in the Terminal:

```
sh ~/Reazix-Billing/_system/update-unix.sh
```

It downloads the newest version, checks every file, keeps _system/data, and rolls back if anything fails. Restart the app afterwards.

# The first-run setup

URL: https://billing.reazix.com/help/first-run.html

The screens you see the first time the app opens: a four-step welcome for your business details, then a three-step setup for how your invoices look. Both can be skipped and changed later.

## Step 1 of the welcome: where you invoice from

The first screen explains what the app does, and asks **Where will you be invoicing from?**

A small **Safe and private** box on it sums up how your data is kept: on this computer, with no account, working offline, with no tracking. Its How we keep it safe link opens [Is it safe? Security and privacy](https://billing.reazix.com/help/security.html).

| 🇮🇳 India | GST, GSTR-1 and 3B, UPI. The default. |

| 🌍 Outside India | VAT and other local taxes |

| 🌐 Both | India, with clients abroad |

Get Started carries on. Skip Setup goes straight to the app; fill in [Settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#company-details) later.

## Step 2: business details

These print at the top of every invoice. Only the **Business Name** is required.

| Business Name | Required |

| Address | Your full address |

| State | Needed to work out CGST and SGST versus IGST |

| GSTIN | Leave blank if you are not registered |

| PAN, Phone, Email | Optional |

Next stays greyed out until a Business Name is typed. Back returns to the first screen without losing what you typed.

**Getting it right**
**State** is where your business is registered. The app compares it with each client's state: same state means CGST + SGST, a different state means IGST. A wrong state here makes the tax wrong on every invoice.

**GSTIN** is your 15-character GST number, for example 07ABCDE1234F1Z5. Its first two digits are your state code. Not registered for GST? Leave it blank; you can make bills without GST. Everything here can be changed later in [Settings → Company details](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#company-details).

Not sure whether you need GST registration, or which scheme to choose? See [GST basics: do I need GST registration?](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-basics.html#registration)

## Step 3: bank and UPI

Where clients should pay you: bank name, account number, IFSC code and UPI ID. A UPI ID puts a scan-to-pay QR code on your invoices. You can also upload your logo and signature here, up to 500 KB each, and choose **Show my business name and logo in the app's menu** (ticked to start; change it any time in [Settings → Company → Branding](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#branding)). Skip, I’ll add later leaves it all for [Settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#payment-accounts).

**Something wrong?**
**"Image must be under 500KB".** The logo or signature file is too big. Open it in Paint (or any photo app), make it smaller, save it as PNG or JPG, and choose it again.

**A typing mistake in the account number or IFSC.** Check them against your passbook or cheque book; they print on every invoice. You can correct them later in [Settings → Payment accounts](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#payment-accounts).

## Step 4: you're all set

A short list of what to do next: make your first invoice, download or share it, check the GST reports, and file your returns. Start Billing saves everything; your bank details become your first [payment account](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#payment-accounts). You see **Setup complete! Start creating invoices.** and the app opens.

If you see **Failed to save. Try again.**, the app's engine stopped: check it is still running (see [Failed to fetch](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#cannot-connect)) and click Start Billing again.

Next: [make your first invoice](https://billing.reazix.com/help/first-invoice.html).

## Then: setting up your invoices

Next, a three-step window sets up printing.

- **What kind of business do you run?**Pick one: Retail shop / kirana, Freelancer / consultant, Restaurant / cafe, Wholesale / trading, Manufacturing, Service / repair shop, or Everything. It decides which features the app shows: a freelancer, for example, does not see Products or Purchases. See [Business type](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#business-type) for what each one shows and hides; nothing is deleted, and you can change it any time in Settings. It also sets an invoice style to match (see [Print and PDF: business type](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html#business-type)). Or choose **None of these** to keep every feature as it is and set things up yourself.
- **Paper size and language**Pick what you mostly print on: A4, A5, 80 mm or 58 mm thermal. It becomes the paper size of new invoices. Then the language for section labels such as BILL TO: English, Hindi, Tamil, Marathi or Bengali.
- **Ready to go**A summary of your choices. Finish setup applies them.

Skip setup, or the ✕, closes it. A ✨ Finish setup button then waits at the bottom right of the screen, for whenever you want to come back to it. Everything it sets can also be changed in [Print and PDF settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html).

The top of the window shows **Step 1 of 3** and a bar that fills as you go. Continue moves on, Back goes back without losing your choices.

### What kind of business do you run?

Click the card that fits you best; it turns blue. Each card has a one-line hint:

| Card | For |

| Retail shop / kirana | Selling from a counter, keeping stock, buying from suppliers. |

| Freelancer / consultant | Billing for your time or services, no stock. |

| Restaurant / cafe | Quick bills, UPI payments, buying supplies. |

| Wholesale / trading | Buying and selling goods in bulk and sending them with e-way bills. |

| Manufacturing | Making products from raw material. |

| Service / repair shop | Repairs and services, spare parts in stock, yearly contracts. |

| Everything | Every feature the app has. |

Your choice decides which screens the sidebar shows and sets a matching invoice style. Hidden screens are only hidden: nothing is deleted, and you can switch any feature back on later in [Settings → Features](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#features) or change the type in [Settings → Business type](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#business-type).

None of these — I'll configure manually closes the window at once and changes nothing: every feature stays as it is, and the ✨ Finish setup button does not appear.

**Not sure?**
Pick the one closest to what you do most. A shop that also repairs things can pick Retail shop / kirana. If you want to see everything first, pick **Everything** and hide what you do not use later.

### Paper size + language

**Paper size**: what you mostly print on. It becomes the paper size of every new invoice; you can still change it on any one invoice.

| A4 · Standard | Normal office paper and laser or inkjet printers. The usual choice. |

| A5 · Compact | Half of A4. For short bills. |

| 80mm Thermal | The common shop receipt printer (about 8 cm wide roll). |

| 58mm Thermal | Small receipt printers (about 6 cm wide roll). |

Not sure which thermal printer you have? Measure the paper roll, or see [Thermal printing](https://billing.reazix.com/help/thermal-printing.html#setup).

**Section label language**: the language of the printed headings such as BILL TO and TOTAL: English, हिन्दी (Hindi), தமிழ் (Tamil), मराठी (Marathi) or বাংলা (Bengali). Your item names, addresses and the rest stay exactly as you type them; the app's own screens stay in English.

### Ready to go

A summary of the three choices: **Business type**, **Default paper size** and **Section label language**. Check them, then click Finish setup. You see **Setup complete! Your defaults are configured.** and land on the Dashboard. Your next new invoice uses these settings.

**Something wrong?**
**A screen I need is missing from the sidebar.** Your business type hid it. Turn it back on in [Settings → Features](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#features).

**Invoices print on the wrong paper.** Change the paper size on the invoice ([Paper / print size](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoice-options.html#paper-size)), or the default in [Print and PDF settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html).

# Your first invoice

URL: https://billing.reazix.com/help/first-invoice.html

From a blank app to a GST tax invoice you can send, in about five minutes.

## Before you start

Have these to hand: your business name, address and GSTIN, and your bank account or UPI ID if you want clients to pay you directly from the invoice. None of it is compulsory, and all of it can be added later.

## Make the invoice

- **Add your business details**If you skipped the welcome, open Settings and fill in **Company Details**. This is the header of every invoice. Your state matters: it decides whether GST is split into CGST and SGST, or charged as IGST.
- **Start a new invoice**Click New Invoice in the sidebar. **Tax Invoice** is already selected, which is the right choice for a normal GST sale.
- **Add the client**Under **Billed To**, type the client's name. If they are registered for GST, type their GSTIN and their state fills in by itself. A mistyped GSTIN is caught straight away.
- **Add what you sold**For each line, give a description, quantity, unit, rate and GST rate. The HSN or SAC code is optional but helps your GST return. Not sure which rate or code? See [What GST rate do I charge?](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-basics.html#which-rate) and [finding your HSN or SAC code](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-basics.html#hsn-search). Clicking a number field selects what is there, so you can just type.
- **Check the tax**The preview on the right shows the totals. Same state as you: CGST and SGST. Another state: IGST. You do not need to choose.
- **Save and download**Click Save & Download. The invoice gets its number, is saved to your records, and downloads as a PDF.

## Send it

- WhatsApp opens a message to the client. On a phone the PDF is attached for you; on a computer, WhatsApp does not let websites attach files, so download the PDF and drag it into the chat.
- Print opens your printer directly, including thermal receipt printers.
- Or attach the downloaded PDF to an email yourself.

## When the client pays

On the [Dashboard](https://billing.reazix.com/help/dashboard.html), find the invoice and record the payment. A printable receipt opens straight away, and the invoice's status changes to **Partial** or **Paid**. Unpaid invoices past their due date are marked **Overdue** for you.

## What to do next

- [Add your products and services](https://billing.reazix.com/help/products.html), so you pick them from a list instead of typing them each time.
- [Add your bank or UPI](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#payment-accounts), so a payment QR code prints on every invoice.
- [Add your logo, signature and stamp](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#branding).
- At the end of the month, [prepare your GST returns](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html) from the invoices you have made.
- New to GST? Read [GST basics for new business owners](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-basics.html): registration, rates, HSN codes, returns and due dates.

The **Getting started** list on the Dashboard tracks these for you, and ticks each one off once it is done.
