# GST basics for new business owners

URL: https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-basics.html

GST in plain words for a first-time shop owner, freelancer or small manufacturer: whether you need to register, which rate to charge, how to find your HSN or SAC code, which bill to give, returns and due dates, exports and LUT, and a checklist for your first week.

**Last checked: 29 October 2026**
Rules change. Check the [GST portal (gst.gov.in)](https://www.gst.gov.in/) or ask a tax adviser (a CA or GST practitioner) before acting on anything here. This page explains the basics; it is not legal advice. Every section lists the official pages it is based on.

## What GST is

GST (Goods and Services Tax) is a tax on selling goods and services in India. Your customer pays it to you on top of your price. You pay it to the government. Before you pay, you take off the GST you yourself paid on things you bought for the business. That is called input tax credit.

Who gets the tax depends on where your customer is:

- **Customer in your own state**: the tax is split in two equal halves, **CGST** (for the Centre) and **SGST** (for your state).
- **Customer in another state**: the whole tax is **IGST** (Integrated GST).
- In Union Territories without their own legislature, such as Chandigarh or Ladakh, **UTGST** takes the place of SGST.

**Example.** Your shop is in Punjab. You sell goods worth ₹10,000 that carry 18% GST.

| Customer is in | Tax on the bill | Customer pays |

| Punjab (same state) | CGST 9% = ₹900, SGST 9% = ₹900 | ₹11,800 |

| Haryana (another state) | IGST 18% = ₹1,800 | ₹11,800 |

The customer pays the same either way. Only the name of the tax changes. The app picks the right one by itself from your state and the place of supply: see [How GST is worked out](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#gst).

**Official sources:** [GSTN Welcome Kit for New Businesses](https://tutorial.gst.gov.in/downloads/news/welcome_kit_for_new_taxpyers.pdf)

## Do I need GST registration?

It depends on your **aggregate turnover**: the total of all your sales in a financial year (April to March), across India, on your PAN. It counts taxable sales, exempt sales, exports and sales to other states. It does not count the GST itself.

You must register once that total crosses the limit in this table:

| What you sell | Limit in most states | Where the limit is lower |

| Goods only | ₹40 lakh | ₹20 lakh in Arunachal Pradesh, Meghalaya, Puducherry, Sikkim, Telangana and Uttarakhand. ₹10 lakh in Manipur, Mizoram, Nagaland and Tripura. |

| Services, or goods and services together | ₹20 lakh | ₹10 lakh in Manipur, Mizoram, Nagaland and Tripura. |

The ₹40 lakh limit is not for everyone who sells goods. It does not apply if you sell ice cream, pan masala, tobacco products or a few other notified goods; you then use the ₹20 lakh limit (₹10 lakh in the four states above).

- **Example 1.** A kirana shop in Gujarat sells only goods, ₹35 lakh a year, all inside Gujarat. It does not have to register.
- **Example 2.** A freelance designer in Delhi bills ₹22 lakh a year. That is a service above ₹20 lakh, so they must register.

Apply within 30 days of the day you cross the limit. Below the limit you may not charge GST: only a registered business can put GST on a bill.

**Official sources:** [CGST Act section 22](https://taxinformation.cbic.gov.in/content/html/tax_repository/gst/acts/2017_CGST_act/active/chapter6/section22_v1.00.html) · [Notification 10/2019-Central Tax (₹40 lakh for goods)](https://gstcouncil.gov.in/sites/default/files/2024-05/notfctn-10-central-tax-english-2019.pdf) · [CBIC flyer: how aggregate turnover is counted](https://gstcouncil.gov.in/sites/default/files/e-version-gst-flyers/composition-levy-scheme.pdf)

### When you must register whatever your turnover

Some businesses must register from the first rupee:

- **You sell goods to a buyer in another state.** Service providers are let off: inter-state services alone do not force you to register while you are under the ₹20 lakh limit.
- **You sell through an online marketplace** that collects TCS (tax collected at source) from your payouts. One relief: since 1 October 2023, a small seller of goods who stays under the turnover limit, sells only inside one state and has no inter-state sales can sell through such a marketplace without GST registration, using an enrolment number from the GST portal.
- **You have to pay tax under reverse charge** on something you buy (see RCM).
- **You are a casual taxable person**: you sell for a short time in a state where you have no fixed place of business, for example at an exhibition or a fair.
- **You sell on behalf of someone else**, as their agent.

**Official sources:** [CGST Act section 24](https://taxinformation.cbic.gov.in/content/html/tax_repository/gst/acts/2017_CGST_act/active/chapter6/section24_v1.00.html) · [CGST notifications: 34/2023 (marketplace sellers of goods)](https://gstcouncil.gov.in/cgst-tax-notification) · [Notification 10/2017-Integrated Tax (inter-state services), on the CBIC Tax Information portal](https://taxinformation.cbic.gov.in/)

### Registering before you have to

You can register even below the limit. It is worth it when:

- most of your customers are GST-registered businesses. They can claim back the GST on your bill, so they often prefer a registered supplier;
- you want to claim back the GST you pay on stock, machines or services;
- you want to sell goods to other states, or on online marketplaces.

The cost: once registered, you must charge GST on taxable sales (your price to consumers goes up) and file returns on time every month or quarter, even when you sold nothing.

### How to register, step by step

Registration is free and done online on the GST portal. Keep these ready first:

| Document | Notes |

| PAN | Of the business. For a proprietor, your own PAN. |

| Aadhaar | Of the owner or partners and the authorised signatory, with the mobile number linked, for OTP checks. |

| Photographs | Of each owner, partner and the authorised signatory. JPG, up to 100 KB. |

| Proof of business address | Property tax receipt, municipal khata copy or electricity bill. If rented: the rent or lease agreement. If someone lets you use their place free: a consent letter from them, with their proof. |

| Proof of the business's constitution | Partnership deed, certificate of incorporation or registration certificate. Not needed for a sole proprietor. |

| Proof of the authorised signatory | A letter of authorisation or board resolution, when the signatory is not the owner. |

| Bank account details | Added after you get your GSTIN (step 7). |

- **Part A: get a TRN**On gst.gov.in, go to Services › Registration › New Registration. Choose **Taxpayer**, your state and district, and enter the legal name exactly as on the PAN, the PAN, your mobile number and email. Enter the two OTPs. You get a **TRN** (Temporary Reference Number).
- **Part B: fill in the form**Log in again with the TRN, within 15 days or the draft is deleted. Fill in each tab: business details (this is where you can choose the composition scheme), owners or partners, authorised signatory, principal place of business, the goods and services you deal in (up to five HSN and five SAC codes: see HSN and SAC), and state-specific details.
- **Submit**Sign with EVC (an OTP) or a digital signature (DSC). A DSC is compulsory for companies and LLPs.
- **Aadhaar check**A link comes by SMS and email to each person to be verified. Some applicants are instead asked to book a slot at a GST Suvidha Kendra for a photo, fingerprints and a document check. Once that is done you get an **ARN** (Application Reference Number).
- **Track it**Services › Registration › Track Application Status. If the officer asks a question, answer it on the portal by the date given.
- **Download the certificate**Once approved, you get your 15-character **GSTIN**. Download the certificate (form REG-06) from Services › User Services › View/ Download Certificate, print the first page, and display it at your shop or office.
- **Add your bank account**Services › Registration › **Amendment of Registration Non-Core Fields**. Do it within 30 days of getting your GSTIN, or before your first GSTR-1, whichever comes first; the portal will not take a GSTR-1 without it.

**The quicker route for small businesses**
Since 1 November 2025, if the GST on your sales to registered businesses will be no more than ₹2.5 lakh a month, you can tick **Option for registration under Rule 14A** in the form. After Aadhaar authentication, registration is granted online within three working days of the ARN.

**Official sources:** [GST portal user manual: new registration](https://tutorial.gst.gov.in/userguide/registration/Apply_for_Registration_Normal_Taxpayer.htm) · [GSTN document checklist](https://tutorial.gst.gov.in/cbt/registration/gstregistration/course/story_content/external_files/GST_Registration_Document_Checklist.pdf) · [GST Council newsletter, November 2025 (Rule 14A and bank account advisories)](https://www.gstcouncil.gov.in/sites/default/files/2025-12/newsletter_november_2025.pdf) · [GSTN Welcome Kit](https://tutorial.gst.gov.in/downloads/news/welcome_kit_for_new_taxpyers.pdf)

## Regular scheme or composition scheme?

Once registered you are in the **regular** scheme unless you choose **composition**. Composition is a simpler scheme for small local businesses: you pay a small flat percentage of your sales, out of your own pocket, and file fewer returns.

| | Regular | Composition |

| Who can choose it | Anyone registered | Turnover last year up to ₹1.5 crore (₹75 lakh in Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura and Uttarakhand). For service providers: up to ₹50 lakh. |

| Tax you pay | The GST rate of each item, charged to your customer | A flat share of your turnover: 1% for manufacturers and traders, 5% for restaurants, 6% for service providers |

| Can you charge GST to customers? | Yes, on a tax invoice | No. You give a **bill of supply** headed "Composition taxable person, not eligible to collect tax on supplies" |

| Input tax credit on purchases | Yes | No |

| Selling to other states | Yes | No |

| Selling on online marketplaces | Yes | Goods only, within your own state. No services. |

| Returns | GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, monthly or quarterly | CMP-08 every quarter and GSTR-4 once a year (see due dates ) |

You also have to write **Composition Taxable Person** on the signboard at your shop. You cannot use composition if you sell to other states, make ice cream, pan masala, tobacco products or a few other notified goods, or sell goods that are outside GST (such as petrol or liquor).

**Example.** A sweet shop in Indore sells ₹30 lakh a year, all to walk-in customers. Under composition it pays 1% of its sales, ₹30,000 for the year, in four quarterly payments, and charges no GST on its bills. It cannot claim back the GST on its own purchases.

### Which one should I choose?

- **Composition suits** a local shop, dhaba or small manufacturer selling mostly to consumers in its own state, with few purchases on which it pays GST.
- **Regular suits** you if your buyers are GST-registered businesses (they want to claim the GST back, and cannot from a composition bill), if you sell to other states or abroad, or if you pay a lot of GST on purchases and want it back.

**How to opt in:** while registering (Part B, Business Details), or later with form **CMP-02** (Services › Registration › **Application to Opt for Composition Levy**) before the financial year starts. To leave, file **CMP-04**. In the app, use the [Composition (Bill of Supply)](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#invoice-types) document type; it prints the declaration for you.

**Official sources:** [CBIC flyer: Composition Levy Scheme](https://gstcouncil.gov.in/sites/default/files/e-version-gst-flyers/composition-levy-scheme.pdf) · [Notification 14/2019-Central Tax (₹1.5 crore / ₹75 lakh)](https://www.gstcouncil.gov.in/sites/default/files/2024-05/notfctn-14-central-tax-english-2019.pdf) · [GST portal FAQ: opting for composition](https://tutorial.gst.gov.in/userguide/registration/Opt_for_Composition_Scheme.htm) · [Notification 36/2023-Central Tax (marketplace sales)](https://gstcouncil.gov.in/cgst-tax-notification)

## What GST rate do I charge?

The rate depends on what you sell, not on who you are or how big you are. Every product and service has a code (HSN or SAC), and the government sets the rate for each code. You do not choose it.

From **22 September 2025** the rates were simplified ("GST 2.0"). The main rates are now **5%**, **18%** and **40%**. The old 12% and 28% slabs were removed for almost everything. From **1 February 2026**, pan masala, cigarettes and other tobacco products also moved to 40% (biris to 18%) and the old compensation cess on them ended.

| Rate | Used for | Examples |

| Nil (0%) | Basic necessities | Fresh fruit and vegetables, fresh milk, UHT milk, pre-packed paneer, roti, chapati and paratha, exercise books, pencils, erasers, sharpeners, maps, many life-saving medicines, individual life and health insurance |

| 5% | Everyday items | Soap, shampoo, hair oil, toothpaste and toothbrushes, butter, ghee, cheese, packaged namkeen, sauces, pasta, chocolates, coffee, bicycles, kitchenware, most medicines, spectacles, tractors, clothes and shoes up to ₹2,500 a piece or pair. Services: hotel rooms up to ₹7,500 a night; gyms, salons, barbers and yoga centres; most restaurants |

| 18% | The standard rate: most goods and services | TVs, air conditioners, dishwashers, cement, small cars, motorcycles up to 350 cc, auto parts, clothes and shoes above ₹2,500. Most professional services: IT and software, design, consulting, repairs, advertising |

| 40% | Luxury and harmful goods | Sugary and aerated drinks, pan masala, cigarettes and tobacco, bigger cars, motorcycles above 350 cc, yachts, private aircraft; betting, casinos and online money gaming |

| 3% and 0.25% | Special rates | Gold, silver and jewellery (3%); rough diamonds and some precious stones (0.25%) |

Some items, such as clothes and shoes, change rate with the price. Many services carry conditions; for example the 5% rate for salons and small hotels comes without input tax credit.

**Official sources:** [GST Council: recommendations of the 56th meeting, 3 September 2025 (full item lists)](https://gstcouncil.gov.in/sites/default/files/2025-09/press_release_press_information_bureau.pdf) · [PIB: GST Reforms 2025](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2025/sep/doc202594628401.pdf) · [All India Radio News: tobacco and pan masala from 1 February 2026](https://www.newsonair.gov.in/govt-notifies-february-1st-as-date-from-which-additional-excise-duty-to-be-levied-on-tobacco-products/)

### Finding the rate for your item

- **Find the code first**Look up the HSN code (goods) or SAC code (services) as described below. The rate follows from the code.
- **Look at your supplier's bill**A GST bill from your supplier shows the HSN code and the rate they charged. If you resell the same item unchanged, that is usually your code and rate too.
- **Check the official list**The GST Council's item-by-item list for the 22 September 2025 changes (linked below) gives the new rate by HSN code. The rate notifications are on CBIC's Tax Information portal, [taxinformation.cbic.gov.in](https://taxinformation.cbic.gov.in/).
- **Still not sure? Ask**A CA or GST practitioner can tell you in minutes. Charging the wrong rate means paying the difference later, with interest.

The app suggests a rate for some common codes as you type them into an invoice. Treat it as a hint, and check it against the official rate before you rely on it.

### Exempt, nil-rated, zero-rated and non-GST

| Term | What it means for you |

| Exempt or nil-rated | No GST is charged, such as on fresh vegetables. You cannot claim input tax credit on purchases used for these sales. If you sell only these, give a [Bill of Supply](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#invoice-types). |

| Zero-rated | Exports and sales to SEZ units. No GST in the end, and you keep your input tax credit. See Exports . |

| Outside GST | Petrol, diesel, natural gas, aviation fuel and liquor for drinking. They carry other taxes, not GST. |

## Finding your HSN or SAC code

**HSN** (Harmonised System of Nomenclature) codes classify goods. They are used around the world, and each extra pair of digits narrows the item down: the first 2 digits are the chapter, 4 digits the heading, 6 the sub-heading and 8 the exact tariff item. For example, 3306 is toothpaste and other dental preparations, and 8712 is bicycles.

**SAC** (Services Accounting Code) codes classify services. They start with 99. For example, 998314 is IT design and development services, and 9963 is hotel and restaurant services.

**Official sources:** [GST Council 56th meeting annexures (HSN-wise lists)](https://gstcouncil.gov.in/sites/default/files/2025-09/press_release_press_information_bureau.pdf)

### How many digits to print

It depends on your **AATO**, your aggregate turnover in the last financial year:

| Turnover last year | Bills to registered businesses (B2B) | Bills to consumers (B2C) |

| Up to ₹5 crore | At least 4 digits | Optional |

| Above ₹5 crore | At least 6 digits | At least 6 digits |

More digits are always allowed, and are often clearer. The same rule applies to the HSN summary in your GSTR-1; tell the app which applies to you in [GSTR filing details](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#gstr-details).

**Official sources:** [Notification 78/2020-Central Tax](https://gstcouncil.gov.in/sites/default/files/2024-05/notfctn-78-central-tax-english-2020.pdf) · [CGST Rules, rule 46](https://taxinformation.cbic.gov.in/content/html/tax_repository/gst/rules/cgst_rules/active/chapter6/rule46_v1.00.html)

### Searching the official list

- **Open the search**On gst.gov.in, without logging in, go to Services › User Services › Search HSN Code. The direct address is [services.gst.gov.in/services/searchhsnsac](https://services.gst.gov.in/services/searchhsnsac).
- **Search by name or by number**Choose HSN for goods or SAC for services, then type a plain word such as toothpaste or repair, or the first digits of a code.
- **Pick the closest description**Read the results and choose the most specific one that fits. Check the chapter it sits in makes sense for your item.
- **Want the whole list?**The same page has **Download HSN Directory in Excel Format**.
- **Search by what it is made of and what it is for**: "steel almirah" may be listed as furniture of metal; "plastic bucket" as household articles of plastics.
- **Ask your supplier or the manufacturer.** Their bill or the product's packaging usually shows the code.
- **Two codes both look right?** They may have different rates. Ask a CA rather than guess.

Once you know a product's code and rate, save them on the product in the app, so every invoice picks them up: see [Adding a product or service](https://billing.reazix.com/help/products.html#add-product).

**Official sources:** [GST portal user manual: search HSN code](https://tutorial.gst.gov.in/userguide/taxpayersdashboard/Search_HSN_SAC_Tax_Rates.htm)

## Which bill to give, and what goes on it

| Document | When |

| Tax invoice | You are registered (regular scheme) and sell something taxable. |

| Bill of supply | You are in the composition scheme, or you sell only exempt or nil-rated items. No GST is shown. |

| Credit note | To reduce an invoice you already gave: goods returned, a discount after the sale, or you charged too much. |

| Debit note | To increase an invoice you already gave, when you charged too little. |

| Delivery challan | Moving goods without selling them: to a job worker, on approval, or between your own places. |

If you are not registered, give an ordinary bill or cash memo without GST. It is not a tax invoice. In the app, see [Choosing the document type](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#invoice-types).

### What a tax invoice must show

- Your name, address and GSTIN.
- An invoice number of up to 16 characters (letters, numbers, - and /), never repeated within a financial year, and the date.
- The buyer's name, address and GSTIN, if they are registered.
- For an unregistered buyer, their name, address, delivery address and state when the bill is ₹50,000 or more (or whenever they ask).
- The HSN or SAC code, description, quantity and unit of each item.
- The total value, the taxable value after any discount, and the rate and amount of CGST, SGST, IGST and cess.
- The place of supply and its state, for a sale to another state, and the delivery address if it is different.
- Whether tax is payable under reverse charge.
- Your signature or digital signature. An electronic invoice does not need one.

The app prints all of these once your details, the client's and the items are filled in.

**Official sources:** [CGST Rules, rule 46](https://taxinformation.cbic.gov.in/content/html/tax_repository/gst/rules/cgst_rules/active/chapter6/rule46_v1.00.html) · [GSTN Welcome Kit, Invoicing in GST](https://tutorial.gst.gov.in/downloads/news/welcome_kit_for_new_taxpyers.pdf)

### B2B, B2C and the buyer's GSTIN

- **B2B** means your buyer is GST-registered. Put their GSTIN on the invoice. They can only claim back the GST you charged if the invoice carries their correct GSTIN and you report it in your GSTR-1. A wrong GSTIN costs your buyer their credit. The app checks a GSTIN's format as you type it: see [What the GSTIN check tells you](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#gstin-check).
- **B2C** means your buyer is a consumer or an unregistered business. These sales are reported as totals, except an inter-state sale to an unregistered buyer above ₹1 lakh, which is reported bill by bill.

### Place of supply, in plain words

The place of supply decides whether you charge CGST and SGST or IGST.

- **Goods**: generally where the goods are delivered, where their journey ends.
- **Services**: generally where your registered buyer is. For an unregistered buyer, their address if you have it, otherwise your own location.
- **Exceptions**: some services follow their own rule. For example, work on a building is supplied where the building is, and a restaurant meal where it is served.

Same state as yours: CGST and SGST. Different state: IGST. In the app, the **Place of Supply** field starts with the client's state; change it when the delivery is elsewhere: see [Invoice Details](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#details).

**Official sources:** [IGST Act sections 10 to 13 on the CBIC Tax Information portal](https://taxinformation.cbic.gov.in/)

## Input tax credit (ITC)

Input tax credit means you take the GST you paid on business purchases off the GST you owe on your sales. You pay only the difference.

**Example.** You buy stock for ₹10,000 plus 18% GST, ₹1,800. You sell it for ₹15,000 plus 18% GST, ₹2,700. You owe ₹2,700, take off the ₹1,800 credit, and pay ₹900.

**Official sources:** [CGST Act section 16](https://taxinformation.cbic.gov.in/content/html/tax_repository/gst/acts/2017_CGST_act/active/chapter5/section16_v1.00.html)

### When you can claim it

- You have the supplier's tax invoice (or debit note), with your GSTIN on it.
- The supplier has reported it in their GSTR-1, so it shows in your **GSTR-2B** on the portal.
- You have received the goods or the service. For goods that come in lots, after the last lot.
- The supplier has paid the tax to the government.
- You file your own GSTR-3B.
- You pay the supplier within 180 days of the invoice date. If you do not, you must pay the credit back, with interest, and can claim it again when you pay.
- You claim it by 30 November after the financial year ends, or by the date you file your annual return if that is earlier.

On the portal, the **Invoice Management System** lists your suppliers' invoices so you can accept, reject or keep them pending before your GSTR-2B is final. In the app, enter every purchase bill ([Adding a purchase bill](https://billing.reazix.com/help/purchases.html#add-purchase)) and check it against GSTR-2B ([GSTR-2B matching](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html#gstr-2b)).

**Official sources:** [CGST Act section 16](https://taxinformation.cbic.gov.in/content/html/tax_repository/gst/acts/2017_CGST_act/active/chapter5/section16_v1.00.html)

### What you cannot claim credit on

- Cars and other vehicles for people with up to 13 seats, and their insurance and repairs, unless you sell vehicles, carry passengers for a fare, or run a driving school.
- Food and drinks, outdoor catering, beauty treatment, health services, cosmetic surgery, and life and health insurance, unless you supply the same thing yourself or a law makes you provide it to staff.
- Club, gym and fitness memberships, and holiday travel for employees.
- Building or renovating your own shop or office (other than plant and machinery).
- Anything for personal use.
- Goods lost, stolen, destroyed, written off, or given away as gifts or free samples.
- Purchases used for exempt sales, and everything bought while you are in the composition scheme.

**Official sources:** [CGST Act section 17(5)](https://taxinformation.cbic.gov.in/content/html/tax_repository/gst/acts/2017_CGST_act/active/chapter5/section17_v1.00.html)

## Returns and due dates

A return is a form you file on the GST portal to report your sales and pay the tax. The dates below are the usual ones; the government sometimes extends them, so check the portal.

| Return | Due | Who files it | What it is |

| GSTR-1 | 11th of the next month | Regular, monthly | Your sales, bill by bill for B2B |

| GSTR-3B | 20th of the next month | Regular, monthly | Summary of sales and credit; you pay the tax with it |

| GSTR-1 (QRMP) | 13th of the month after the quarter | Turnover up to ₹5 crore who chose quarterly filing | Sales for the quarter |

| IFF | 13th of the next month | QRMP | Optional: B2B bills for month 1 or 2 of the quarter, so your buyers get their credit sooner |

| PMT-06 | 25th of the next month | QRMP | Tax payment for month 1 and month 2 of the quarter |

| GSTR-3B (QRMP) | 22nd or 24th of the month after the quarter, depending on your state | QRMP | Summary for the quarter |

| CMP-08 | 18th of the month after the quarter | Composition | Composition tax for the quarter |

| GSTR-4 | 30 June after the financial year (from FY 2024-25) | Composition | Composition annual return |

| GSTR-9 | 31 December after the financial year | Regular, turnover above ₹2 crore (optional below that, from FY 2024-25) | Annual return |

| GSTR-9C | With GSTR-9 | Turnover above ₹5 crore | Reconciliation statement |

- **File even when you sold nothing.** A nil return is still due on time: see [NIL returns](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html#nil-return).
- **Late costs money.** A late return attracts a late fee for every day of delay (lower for a nil return), and tax paid late carries interest at 18% a year.
- **Do not let returns pile up.** Once three years have passed since a return's due date, the portal no longer accepts it.

**Official sources:** [GST portal FAQ: GSTR-3B](https://tutorial.gst.gov.in/userguide/returns/GSTR3B.htm) · [GST portal FAQ: QRMP and IFF](https://tutorial.gst.gov.in/downloads/news/faq_on_qrmp_iff.pdf) · [CBIC flyer: CMP-08](https://gstcouncil.gov.in/sites/default/files/e-version-gst-flyers/composition-levy-scheme.pdf) · [CGST Rules, rule 62 (GSTR-4 by 30 June)](https://taxinformation.cbic.gov.in/content/html/tax_repository/gst/rules/cgst_rules/active/chapter8/rule62_v1.00.html) · [Notification 15/2025-Central Tax (GSTR-9 up to ₹2 crore)](https://gstcouncil.gov.in/cgst-tax-notification)

### How the app helps

The app does not log in to the portal or file for you. It prepares the figures and the files from what you have entered:

- [GSTR-1](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html#gstr-1) and [GSTR-3B](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html#gstr-3b), as JSON files you upload on the portal, for a month, a quarter or a year ([Choosing the period](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html#period)).
- [GSTR-2B matching](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html#gstr-2b), to see which purchase credits your suppliers have reported.
- The [Filing Guide](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html#filing-guide), with step-by-step portal instructions for regular and nil returns.

## E-way bill and e-invoicing

**E-way bill.** Before goods worth more than ₹50,000 are moved in one consignment, an e-way bill is generated on [ewaybillgst.gov.in](https://ewaybillgst.gov.in/), with the vehicle details. Some states set a higher limit for movement within the state. Services do not need one. The app can make the file for the e-way bill portal: see [E-way bill](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#eway-bill).

**E-invoicing.** If your aggregate turnover has been above ₹5 crore in any financial year since 2017-18, your B2B invoices and exports must be registered on the e-invoice portal, which gives each one an IRN and a QR code. Below ₹5 crore you do not need it. See [E-invoicing (IRN)](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html#e-invoice) for how the app handles it.

**Official sources:** [E-way bill portal](https://ewaybillgst.gov.in/) · [E-invoice portal](https://einvoice1.gst.gov.in/) · [CGST Rules, rule 46(r) and (s)](https://taxinformation.cbic.gov.in/content/html/tax_repository/gst/rules/cgst_rules/active/chapter6/rule46_v1.00.html)

## Exports and foreign clients

Exports, and sales to units in a Special Economic Zone (SEZ), are **zero-rated**: no GST in the end, and you still get credit for the GST on your purchases. There are two ways to do it:

- **Under a LUT, without paying IGST.** The simple way for most small exporters.
- **Paying IGST** on the invoice, then claiming that IGST back as a refund.

Selling a service to a foreign client counts as an export when you are in India, the client is outside India, the place of supply is outside India, you are paid in foreign currency (or in rupees where the RBI allows it), and the client is not your own branch abroad.

**Official sources:** [IGST Act sections 2(6) and 16 on the CBIC Tax Information portal](https://taxinformation.cbic.gov.in/)

Doing it in the app

- Save the client with their country (for example United States). No GSTIN or state is needed; their own tax ID, such as a VAT number, can go in the tax ID box and prints on the invoice. See [Clients abroad](https://billing.reazix.com/help/clients.html#foreign-client).
- On the invoice, pick their currency and type the exchange rate for the invoice date. See [Billing in another currency](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#currency).
- With a LUT saved in Settings, the invoice is under LUT (no IGST) by itself. The place of supply prints as Outside India.
- When the money arrives, record the rupees your bank credited and the FIRC / e-BRC number your bank gives you: that is the proof you were paid in foreign exchange. See [Payments from abroad](https://billing.reazix.com/help/dashboard.html#payment-foreign).
- In GST returns the invoice is reported in rupees: GSTR-1 Table 6A and GSTR-3B Table 3.1(b). See [Exports and SEZ](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html#exports).

### LUT: exporting without paying IGST

A **Letter of Undertaking** (form **GST RFD-11**) is a promise to the department that you will follow the export rules. With it you export without paying IGST, so no money is stuck waiting for a refund. Any registered business can file one, unless it has been prosecuted for tax evasion of more than ₹2.5 crore. It costs nothing.

A LUT is valid for one financial year. File a fresh one every year, before the first export of the year; the start of April is a good habit.

- **Open the form**Log in to gst.gov.in and go to Services › User Services › **Furnish Letter of Undertaking (LUT)**.
- **Choose the year**Pick the financial year in **LUT Applied for Financial Year**. If you had a paper LUT for an earlier year, you can upload it (PDF or JPEG, up to 2 MB).
- **Declarations and witnesses**Tick the declarations, then enter the name, address and occupation of two independent witnesses.
- **Sign and file**Enter the place, choose the authorised signatory, preview it, and file with DSC or EVC.
- **Keep the ARN**The portal gives an **ARN** at once, and the LUT counts as accepted from then. Download the acknowledgement. You can find it again under **View My Submitted LUTs**.

**Official sources:** [GST portal user manual: furnishing a LUT](https://tutorial.gst.gov.in/userguide/refund/Furnishing_of_Letter_of_Undertaking.htm) · [CBIC Circular 8/8/2017-GST](https://cbic-gst.gov.in/pdf/Final_Master_circular_LUT_Bond_04102017.pdf) · [CBIC Circular 40/14/2018-GST](https://cbic-gst.gov.in/pdf/circularno-40-cgst.pdf)

### What to print on an export or SEZ invoice

Rule 46 says the invoice must carry this declaration, word for word:

- Under a LUT: **"SUPPLY MEANT FOR EXPORT/SUPPLY TO SEZ UNIT OR SEZ DEVELOPER FOR AUTHORISED OPERATIONS UNDER BOND OR LETTER OF UNDERTAKING WITHOUT PAYMENT OF INTEGRATED TAX"**
- Paying IGST: **"SUPPLY MEANT FOR EXPORT/SUPPLY TO SEZ UNIT OR SEZ DEVELOPER FOR AUTHORISED OPERATIONS ON PAYMENT OF INTEGRATED TAX"**

For an export it must also show the buyer's name and address, the delivery address and the country of destination. Many exporters also print their LUT's ARN and the year it covers. The rule does not ask for it, but it saves questions.

**In the app:**

- Set the client's country, or tick **SEZ** on a client in an SEZ: see [Adding and editing a client](https://billing.reazix.com/help/clients.html#client-form).
- Save your LUT's ARN and year in [Settings, Company](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#lut). Invoices for such clients then tick **Export under LUT (no IGST)** by themselves: no IGST is added, and the declaration above prints with your ARN. Untick it to charge IGST; the "on payment" declaration prints instead. See [Exports and SEZ supplies under a LUT](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#lut).
- The **Export / International (LUT)** terms preset adds payment and shipping terms for export invoices (see [Terms, notes and a private note](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#terms-notes)).
- Bill in the client's currency if you like: see [Billing in another currency](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#currency).
- Exports to clients abroad are not in the app's GSTR-1 file. The app lists them, and you add them in Table 6A on the portal: see [the warnings above the tabs](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html#top-bar).

**Official sources:** [CGST Rules, rule 46 (export endorsement)](https://taxinformation.cbic.gov.in/content/html/tax_repository/gst/rules/cgst_rules/active/chapter6/rule46_v1.00.html)

### Selling to an SEZ

A unit or developer in a Special Economic Zone has a GSTIN like any other business. A supply to it for its authorised operations is zero-rated, even when it is in your own state: either under your LUT with no tax, or with IGST (never CGST and SGST) that the buyer or you then claim back. Keep the buyer's proof that the goods or services were received in the SEZ for its authorised operations.

## TDS and TCS: when tax is cut from your payment

Three different things are called TDS or TCS. A small business usually meets them like this:

### A client deducts income-tax TDS from your payment

Many business clients must deduct income tax (TDS) when they pay you for contract work, professional or technical fees, rent, commission, or large purchases of goods. They pay you the rest and deposit the TDS with the income tax department against your PAN.

**Example.** You bill ₹1,00,000 plus GST. Your client deducts ₹10,000 as TDS and pays you the rest. The ₹10,000 is not lost: it is credited to your PAN, and you claim it in your income tax return. When your invoice shows GST separately, TDS is worked out on the amount before GST.

- **Check it reached your PAN**: log in at [incometax.gov.in](https://www.incometax.gov.in/) and open your annual tax statement: **Form 26AS** for tax year 2025-26 and earlier, **Form 168** from tax year 2026-27.
- **Ask for the certificate**: the client gives you a TDS certificate every quarter: **Form 16A** for payments up to 31 March 2026, and the form that replaces it under the Income-tax Rules, 2026 after that.
- **New law from 1 April 2026**: the Income-tax Act, 2025 replaced the 1961 Act. The familiar sections such as 194C, 194J and 194Q are now entries in a table under section 393. Payments made up to 31 March 2026 still use the old sections.

In the app, record TDS on an invoice under Customize: see [TDS and TCS](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#tds-tcs), and the [TDS / TCS report](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html#tds-tcs). For your own income tax, see [Income tax](https://billing.reazix.com/help/income-tax.html).

**Official sources:** [Income Tax Department press release: Income-tax Act, 2025 in force from 1 April 2026](https://www.incometaxindia.gov.in/documents/d/guest/press-release-income-tax-act-2025-comes-into-force-from-01-april-2026-pdf) · [Income Tax Department FAQs on the transition](https://www.incometaxindia.gov.in/documents/81799/11848482/FAQs-on-Interplay-and-Transition.pdf) · [Form 168 (earlier Form 26AS)](https://www.incometaxindia.gov.in/tax-services/process-annual-tax-statement-e-filing-form-26as-form-168)

### GST TDS and GST TCS

- **GST TDS**: government departments and some public bodies deduct 2% GST TDS when a contract with them is worth more than ₹2.5 lakh. It shows on the portal as a credit you can use to pay your GST.
- **GST TCS**: an online marketplace keeps 0.5% of the net value of your taxable sales through it (since 10 July 2024; it was 1% before). Accept it on the portal and it is added to your cash ledger, to pay your GST with.

**Official sources:** [CGST Act sections 51 and 52, on the CBIC Tax Information portal](https://taxinformation.cbic.gov.in/) · [Notification 15/2024-Central Tax (TCS 0.5%)](https://gstcouncil.gov.in/cgst-tax-notification)

## Your first week: a checklist

- **Work out your turnover**Estimate a year's sales and check the table in Do I need GST registration? and the list in When you must register.
- **Get your PAN and a bank account**Open a separate current account for the business, so business and personal money never mix.
- **Choose your scheme**Regular or composition: see which one suits you.
- **Register**On gst.gov.in (steps). Add your bank account on the portal, display your registration certificate, and, under composition, put "Composition Taxable Person" on your signboard.
- **Set up the app**Go through the [first-run setup](https://billing.reazix.com/help/first-run.html). Set your state and GSTIN in [Company Details](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#company-details), and pick your [business type](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#business-type).
- **Find your codes and rates**For each product or service, find the HSN or SAC code and the rate, and save them on your [products](https://billing.reazix.com/help/products.html#add-product).
- **Keep every purchase bill**Check your GSTIN is on each one, enter it as a [purchase](https://billing.reazix.com/help/purchases.html#add-purchase), and match your credit against GSTR-2B every month.
- **Mark your due dates**Note your return due dates and file every one on time, even when it is nil. The app's [GST Returns](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html) screen prepares them.
- **Exporting?**File your LUT before your first export of the year.
- **Keep your records**Keep your books, bills and returns for 72 months (six years) from the due date of the annual return for that year.

**Official sources:** [GSTN Welcome Kit (records and registration certificate)](https://tutorial.gst.gov.in/downloads/news/welcome_kit_for_new_taxpyers.pdf)

## Words you will meet

| Word | Meaning |

| AATO | Annual aggregate turnover: all your sales in a financial year, on all GSTINs under one PAN. Decides your HSN digits, QRMP and e-invoicing. |

| ARN | Application Reference Number: the receipt number the GST portal gives when you submit something, such as a registration or a LUT. |

| GSTIN | Your 15-character GST number. The first two digits are your state code, the next ten your PAN. |

| HSN | The code for a kind of goods. Decides the rate. |

| ITC | Input tax credit: GST you paid on business purchases, taken off the GST you owe. |

| LUT | Letter of Undertaking (form RFD-11), filed every year to export or sell to an SEZ without paying IGST. |

| PAN | Permanent Account Number from the income tax department. GST registration is linked to it. |

| Place of supply | Where a sale is treated as happening. Same state as you: CGST and SGST. Another state: IGST. |

| RCM (reverse charge) | For some purchases, such as an advocate's fees or some goods transport, the buyer pays the GST to the government instead of the seller. See [Reverse charge](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#reverse-charge). |

| SAC | The code for a kind of service. Starts with 99. |

| SEZ | Special Economic Zone. Sales to units there are zero-rated, like exports. |

| TRN | Temporary Reference Number, given in Part A of the registration form. |

More terms are in the [Glossary](https://billing.reazix.com/help/glossary.html#terms).

# Is it safe? Security and privacy

URL: https://billing.reazix.com/help/security.html

Plain answers for anyone who wonders whether it is safe to keep their business books in it: where your data is, what the app connects to, and how to check it yourself.

**The short answer**
Your invoices, clients and settings are saved as files on your own computer. There is no account, no login and no cloud server of ours. The app has no ads and no tracking, and it sends none of your business data to us.

**Don't take our word for it:** switch off your internet and use the app (it all works), or turn on Offline mode so it never goes online by itself. See Check it yourself.

## Your data stays on your computer

- **Saved as files on your PC.** Every invoice, client, product, payment and setting is a file in the _system\data folder inside the app's folder. Saved invoice PDFs go in the **Saved Invoices** folder next to it.
- **No account, no login, no signup.** The app never asks for an email address or a password to use it.
- **No cloud server.** We do not run a server that holds your books. There is nothing of yours on our side to leak or to lose.
- **Google Drive only if you set it up.** If you choose to connect your own Google Drive (Settings → Google Drive), copies of your invoice PDFs and backups go to your Drive. Nothing goes there until you do. See [Google Drive](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#google-drive).

One honest limit: the data files are not encrypted. Anyone who can sign in to your Windows or Mac account can open that folder, the same as your other documents. Protect the computer with its own password, and see What you should do.

## It works without internet

Everything you do day to day works offline: making and printing invoices, PDFs, payments, stock, purchases, expenses, reports, GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B files, backups, and reading a supplier's bill from a photo (OCR). The app runs on your computer and opens in your browser, but it is not a website.

Internet is needed only to install the app, to update it, and for the optional things listed below. When you are offline the app simply skips them; your work is not affected. Everything the app needs to run, even its font, is inside the app folder.

## Offline mode: never go online by itself

Click the Wi-Fi button at the top right of any screen and then Turn Offline mode on, or tick **Offline mode** in Settings → **Privacy & internet**. The button turns orange, with a line through it, while it is on. From then on the app makes no internet connection by itself:

- no automatic check for a new version;
- no automatic copy of each invoice PDF to Google Drive.

Things you click still work when you click them: Check for Updates and Update, the ? help pages, Report, WhatsApp and other links, and Save to Drive. The setting is kept in the app's data folder, so the app's own server obeys it too. The same card lists everything that uses the internet, and when.

## Every address the app connects to

This is the complete list. Apart from these, the app talks only to itself on your own computer.

### By itself, while the app is open

| Address | When | Why, and what is sent |

| billing.reazix.com (Reazix) | About 5 seconds after the app opens, every 6 hours while it stays open, and when you click Check for Updates in Settings | Asks billing.reazix.com which version is the newest, so the app can tell you an update is ready. Nothing about you or your business is sent. |

Offline mode stops it.

### Only when you do something

| Address | When | Why |

| billing.reazix.com (Reazix) | When you install, or click Update | Downloads the app itself (the release ZIP). |

| nodejs.org | During install or update, only if your computer has no recent Node.js | Downloads Node.js, the engine the app runs on, into the app's own folder. On Windows, if that fails, the installer asks before using Windows' own installer (winget). |

| registry.npmjs.org | Only if the app's packages are missing or damaged and the launcher repairs them | Downloads the app's packages again. The release ZIP already contains them, so this normally never happens. |

| accounts.google.com , www.googleapis.com (Google) | Only after you set up Google Drive with your own Google key and sign in | Signs in to your Google account and saves invoice PDFs and backups to your Drive. The app can see only the files it put there itself. Offline mode stops the automatic copy of each PDF. |

| billing.reazix.com (these help pages) | When you click a ? button or the User Guide | Opens this guide in your browser. |

| Your email program | When you click Report or Report a problem | Opens an email to contact@reazix.com. See Problem reports . |

| WhatsApp, the GST portal, NSDL and other links | When you click them | Ordinary links that open in your browser, such as sharing an invoice on WhatsApp or opening the GST portal. |

There is nothing else: no analytics service, no advertising network, no error-tracking service, and no server of ours that receives your data.

For IT people: the app's Content Security Policy (in src/index.html) limits what the page may load or contact to the addresses above. The update check is made by the app's own server (/api/check-update in server.js); Google Drive is called from the page.

## No tracking, no ads, nothing sent to us

- **No analytics.** The app does not count your clicks, screens or invoices, and does not report how you use it.
- **No ads**, and no paid version that unlocks features.
- **No data sent to us.** We never see your invoices, clients, amounts, GSTIN or bank details. We do not even know how many people use the app.

## How is Reazix paid? What is the catch?

There is no catch, and your data is not the product.

- **One payment.** You buy the app once and use it for life. Your purchase includes 3 years of updates.
- **No servers holding your books.** The app runs on your computer, so there is no cloud that holds your data.
- **Tracking you would gain us nothing.** We do not sell ads or data, so there is nothing to collect.

## Other computers cannot open it

The app has a small built-in server that your browser talks to. It listens only on this computer's own internal address, 127.0.0.1, so other computers on your Wi-Fi or office network cannot open the app or read your data.

It also refuses requests from other websites: a web page you visit cannot quietly read your books from the app in the background.

This is also why several people cannot use it from different computers at the same time. See [Several people, or several computers](https://billing.reazix.com/help/limitations.html#multi-user).

## Can I put it online, on Railway, Render or a server?

**No, please don't try.** People ask whether they can host the app on a website service (Railway, Render, a VPS, with Supabase as the database) so they can open it from anywhere. Today that is not safe, and it would not work properly:

- **There is no login on the server.** The app was made for one computer, so its server does not ask who you are. The [PIN](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#lock) only locks the screen in your browser. Put online, anyone who found the web address could read, change or delete all your invoices, clients and bank details.
- **It only listens on your own computer** (127.0.0.1, see above), so a hosting service cannot reach it. Changing that in the code removes the protection described above.
- **Supabase would not be used.** The app does not use a database. It saves your books as files in its data folder, and on most free hosting plans those files are wiped every time the service restarts.
- **The "free" plans are not free for long.** Most now give a trial credit and then charge every month, plus extra for storage that keeps your files.

Hosting it online would also send your books to someone else's server, which is the one thing this app promises not to do.

**What you can do instead:** keep the app on one computer and take a [backup](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html) often. To move to a new computer, see [moving to a new computer](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html#move-pc).

## Check it yourself

You don't have to trust what we write. Any of these takes a few minutes and needs no technical skill except the last two.

- **Switch the internet off.** Turn off Wi-Fi (or unplug the cable), close the app and open it again. Make an invoice, download its PDF, print it, record a payment and open Reports. Everything works. That is because nothing the app does with your books needs the internet.
- **Turn on Offline mode** (above) and leave it on. The app then goes online only when you click something that needs it.
- **Watch its connections.** On Windows, open **Resource Monitor** (press Windows key + R, type resmon, press Enter), open the **Network** tab and look at **node.exe**, the program the app runs on. With Offline mode on, it has no connections outside your computer. On a Mac, use Activity Monitor's **Network** tab. Your browser is listed separately: the app's page uses it only for the things in the list above.
- **Block it in the firewall.** In Windows Defender Firewall's **Advanced settings**, add an **Outbound rule** that blocks the app's node.exe (in the app folder's _system\node folder, or C:\Program Files\nodejs). The app keeps working; only the update check stops. Remove the rule to update.

## Is the install safe?

- **No administrator rights.** The install line puts the app in your own user folder (Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Reazix Billing; Mac: Applications in your home folder). It does not change Windows system files, add a Windows service or ask for an admin password.
- **From the official place only.** The install line downloads the script and the app from billing.reazix.com, over a secure (HTTPS) connection.
- **Your data is never touched.** Installing over an existing copy backs up your data to Documents\Reazix Billing Backups first and replaces only the app's own files.

### Why Windows or the Mac may show a warning for the ZIP

The app is **not code-signed**. Reazix does not have a signing certificate yet. So when you open the downloaded ZIP's launcher, Windows may show **"Windows protected your PC"** and a Mac may say it **cannot check the app**. That message means "this program is not signed by a paid certificate". It does not mean a virus was found. See ["Windows protected your PC"](https://billing.reazix.com/help/install.html#windows-protected).

The one-line install shows no such warning because Windows and macOS put that check only on files marked as downloaded from the internet. Browsers add that mark; PowerShell and Terminal, which the install line uses, do not. It is not because the app was approved or certified by Microsoft or Apple; it was not.

## Backups and the PIN lock

- **Daily automatic backups.** Every day the app copies all your data into a dated backup and keeps the last 30 days. See [Daily backups](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html#automatic-backups).
- **A copy on another drive.** Choose a second folder (another drive, a USB disk, a synced folder) and every daily backup is copied there too, so a failed hard disk does not take your books with it. See [Keeping a copy somewhere else](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html#backup-copy).
- **Before every update**, the installer and the updater back up your data first.
- **PIN lock (optional).** On a computer others use, turn on a 6 or 8 digit PIN in Settings → App lock. The PIN is stored only as a scrambled check value (a salted hash), never as the digits, and after five wrong tries in a row it makes you wait 30 seconds. It locks the app's screens; it does not encrypt the files. See [App lock](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#lock).

## Problem reports

When something goes wrong, the app notes it in the [Problem log](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#problem-log) on your computer. Nothing is sent anywhere by itself.

Only when you click Report does it open an email to Reazix in your email program, filled in with the error and your app, browser and computer type. Before that, private details are removed: GSTIN, PAN, phone numbers, email addresses, UPI IDs, IFSC codes, long numbers such as bank account numbers, and your Windows user name. You see the form before anything is posted, and it is sent only if you send the email.

## Updates and security fixes

- **Regular updates.** Your purchase includes 3 years of updates, with urgent fixes sooner. The app tells you when one is ready; see [Updating](https://billing.reazix.com/help/update.html).
- **Watched for known problems.** Security alerts watch the code libraries the app uses, and a known security problem in one of them is fixed in an update.
- **Only what the app needs.** The download contains the built app and only the packages its server needs to run. Developer tools are left out.

## What you should do

- **Download only from the official places**: billing.reazix.com or the install line on these pages. Copies on other websites, on YouTube links or forwarded on WhatsApp are not ours and may have been changed.
- **Keep Windows or macOS up to date**, and keep its built-in antivirus on.
- **Put a password on your computer account**, and turn on the app's PIN lock if others use the same PC.
- **Keep a backup copy on another drive** or a USB disk (see [Keeping a copy somewhere else](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html#backup-copy)).
- **Keep the app updated**: click Update when it tells you a new version is ready.

## Found a security problem?

Please report it privately, not in a public issue, so it can be fixed before anyone misuses it:

- **Email**: contact@reazix.com with SECURITY in the subject.

Use made-up data when you describe it, never real invoices or GSTINs.

# Making an invoice

URL: https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html

Every card of the New Invoice screen, from top to bottom: the toolbar, the document type, the client, invoice details, ship-to and order details, the items, discounts, GST, TDS and TCS, terms, extra pages, and what happens when you save, print or share.

## How the screen is laid out

Open it with New Invoice in the sidebar, or Ctrl + N. The same screen opens when you edit, duplicate or convert an invoice from the Dashboard. The form is on the left and a live preview of the printed invoice is on the right. From top to bottom, the form has these cards:

- **Invoice Type**: the kind of document, and whether it is for goods or services. The Customize panel opens inside this card.
- **Billed To**: the client's name, address, state and GSTIN.
- **Invoice Details**: number, dates, place of supply, the Ship to address and the optional order, dispatch and reference details.
- **Line Items**: what you are selling, with the whole-bill discount under them.
- **Terms & Conditions**: terms, notes for the client and a private note for you.
- **Additional Pages / Sections**: extra pages printed after the invoice.

The totals are not typed anywhere. They are worked out as you type and shown in the live preview.

Every card title has a small ? next to it. It opens this guide at the part about that card.

## The toolbar

The toolbar stays at the top of the screen as you scroll, so Save, Print and the rest are always in reach on a long invoice.

| Button | What it does |

| ← Back | Leaves the invoice. If you have changed something that is not saved, you are asked first (see Leaving with unsaved changes ). |

| ? | Opens this guide. |

| Save status | A small coloured badge that tells you whether the invoice is saved. See Saving as you go . |

| Save | Saves the invoice without making a PDF. Ctrl + S does the same. |

| Save & Download | Saves the invoice and downloads the PDF. See Save & Download . |

| Print | Saves the invoice, then prints it. See Printing . |

| WhatsApp | Opens WhatsApp with the invoice details typed in. See Sending on WhatsApp . |

| E-Way Bill | Only on tax invoices and delivery challans, and only while **E-way bill** is on in [Settings, Features](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#features). Downloads the e-way bill file. See E-way bill . |

| E-invoice | Only when **E-invoicing (IRN)** is on in Settings, Features, and only on tax invoices and credit notes. Downloads the e-invoice file and takes back the IRN. A ✓ after the name means this invoice already has an IRN. See [E-invoicing](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html#e-invoice). |

| Customize | Opens the panel that controls what prints, the paper size, currency and more. While it is open the button reads Hide Options . See [Customize: what prints and how](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoice-options.html). |

| Hide Preview | Hides the preview so the form uses the whole width, handy for long invoices. Show Preview brings it back. The app remembers your choice in this browser. Save & Download and Print still work while it is hidden. |

While a save, download or print is running, the buttons are greyed out and Save & Download reads **Generating...**. Wait for it to finish.

## Invoice Type: choosing the document

The chips at the top of the first card decide the printed title, the number series, whether GST is charged, and whether the document counts as a sale in your totals and GST returns. Hover over a chip to see a one-line description; the same line shows under the chips for the one you picked.

| Chip | Prints as | Numbered | Use it for | GST | Counts as a sale? |

| Tax Invoice | TAX INVOICE | INV… | A normal sale by a GST-registered business | Yes | Yes |

| Quotation | QUOTATION | QUO… | A priced offer for work or supply. Convert it to a tax invoice when the client accepts. | Shown | No |

| Proforma / Estimate | PROFORMA INVOICE | EST… | A quote before the sale. Prints "This is not a tax invoice" and a faint ESTIMATE watermark. | Shown | No |

| Bill of Supply (No GST) | BILL OF SUPPLY | BOS… | Exempt goods or services, where no GST is charged | No | Yes |

| Composition (Bill of Supply) | BILL OF SUPPLY | COMP… | Sales under the composition scheme (section 10). The declaration required by Rule 46A prints automatically. | No | Yes |

| Credit Note | CREDIT NOTE | CN… | Returns, a price cut after the sale, or a correction. Its total is subtracted from your sales. See How to make a credit note . | Yes | Subtracted |

| Delivery Challan | DELIVERY CHALLAN | DC… | Moving goods without a sale, such as to a job worker or on approval | No | No |

The prefixes above are the defaults. You can change each one in [Settings, Invoice number format](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#invoice-numbers) or [Print Settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html#prefixes).

### What changes when you click a chip

- **The number** moves to that type's own series. Any number you typed is replaced.
- **The Tax % column** is turned on for types with GST and off for the others (bill of supply, composition, delivery challan). **Place of Supply** is shown or hidden the same way.
- **The title** printed at the top changes, unless you typed your own [Invoice Title](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoice-options.html#title-currency).

**Once an invoice is saved, its type is locked.** The other chips are greyed out and a note under them says why: the number and the tax already issued to your client must not change. To make a different document from it, use Duplicate on the [Dashboard](https://billing.reazix.com/help/dashboard.html#row-actions). A quotation, proforma or challan is turned into an invoice with Convert to Tax Invoice (see Turning a quote into an invoice).

**Something wrong?**
**No GST box on the items, or no tax on a new tax invoice?** The Tax % column is remembered for the next invoice. After making a bill of supply or a challan, the next new invoice can start without it. Click the Tax Invoice chip again, or tick **Tax % column** under Customize. See [No GST is charged at all](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#no-tax).

**The chips are greyed out.** The invoice is already saved. Use Duplicate to make a new document of another type.

## Goods, services or both

Under the type chips, **This invoice is for:** sets which units the Unit list offers and which unit a new row starts with. It does not change the tax.

| Chip | Units offered | Good for |

| 📦 Goods | Pcs, Nos, Kg, g, Tonne, Ltr, ml, Mtr, cm, Ft, In, Sq.ft, Sq.m, Box, Dozen, Pair, Set, Bag, Roll, Bottle and the like. The default. | Shops, traders, manufacturers |

| ⏱ Services | Hrs, Day, Week, Month, Year, Visit, Session, Project, Word, Page, plus Nos, Sq.ft and Sq.m. A reminder appears to use a **SAC code** (the services version of HSN) in the HSN/SAC box. Terms print in the **Formatted** layout unless you choose otherwise. | Freelancers, consultants, repair and service businesses |

| 🔀 Mixed | Every unit, unfiltered. | Selling goods and doing the work, such as supply and installation |

Your own custom units show in every mode. The choice is remembered for your next invoice.

**A service with no quantity (a fixed fee).** Keep the line's quantity at 1 and type the fee as the rate. Then click Customize and untick **Qty column** (see [Items table](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoice-options.html#show-items)): the invoice prints the item and its amount with no Qty column. Untick **Rate column** too if you want only the amount. Totals and GST do not change. The choice carries on to your next new invoices, so tick it again for an invoice that needs quantities; invoices already saved keep their own setting.

In **Services** mode the unit list starts with the units services use most: Hrs, Day, Month, Project and Nos. The HSN/SAC box of each line is labelled **SAC**, and the unit is not printed next to the quantity unless you turn it on (see [Unit next to Qty](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoice-options.html#show-items)).

**A Services invoice shows only what services need.** The **Freelancer / consultant** business type starts every invoice in Services mode. There, the screen leaves out:

- the **Unit** column, while the unit is not printed;
- the Delivery charges button;
- the **Ship to** box;
- the goods boxes under **Order, dispatch & reference details** (vehicle no, delivery note, dispatch, destination, terms of delivery). The PO number, service period and work details stay.

The **Discount** on a line is just an amount or a percent, and the discount on the whole bill is behind + Discount on the whole bill. Anything already filled in still shows. Click **📦 Goods** or **🔀 Mixed** to get every box back.

**Long item names.** The item box grows as you type, so a long name stays readable. Drag its bottom corner to make it taller. Press Enter to add the next row; a name stays on one line. Use + Add description for more detail under the item.

## Billed To: the client

This card says who the invoice is for. Their name, address, state and GSTIN print in the **BILL TO** block. The **state** matters most: it decides whether GST is charged as CGST + SGST or as IGST (see How GST is worked out).

| Field | What to enter |

| Client Name | Click it to see your saved clients, or type to search. Pick one to fill in everything below. You can also bill a name that is not saved. |

| Pencil button | Appears beside the name once a saved client is picked. Opens their full details for editing (see [Adding and editing a client](https://billing.reazix.com/help/clients.html#client-form)). Typing a different name unlinks the saved client and the pencil goes. |

| Billing Address | Street address and locality. |

| Country | India to start (your own country). Changing it clears the state, since each country has its own list. A client outside India makes the sale an export: see How GST is worked out . |

| City | For example Mumbai. |

| PIN Code | The 6-digit PIN. For other countries the label changes, such as ZIP Code or Postcode. |

| State | Pick from the list. Leave it blank if you enter a GSTIN: the app fills it in from the GSTIN (see What the GSTIN check tells you ). Hidden when **Business state** is turned off under Customize. |

| GSTIN | The client's 15-character GST number, if they are registered. Optional: leave it blank for a consumer or an unregistered business (a B2C sale). Letters are made capitals for you. Hidden when **Tax ID** is turned off under Customize. |

The client's email, phone and **SEZ** setting are not on this card. They are kept with the saved client and edited with the pencil. A client marked SEZ is always charged IGST.

**Something wrong?**
**CGST + SGST where it should be IGST, or the other way round?** Check the client's State and the Place of Supply, and your own state in [Settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#company-details). See [The invoice has the wrong tax split](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#wrong-tax).

**The client list does not open.** You have no saved clients yet. Type the name and use **Save "name" as new client**, or add clients on the [Clients](https://billing.reazix.com/help/clients.html#client-list) screen.

### Picking a saved client, or saving a new one

- **Click Client Name**Your saved clients drop down, each with their city and state, and their GSTIN when they have one.
- **Type to narrow the list**Any part of the name works. Use ↓ ↑ to move and Enter to pick, or click one. Esc closes the list. Each row has its own pencil to edit that client straight away.
- **Check what was filled in**Picking a client fills in their address, country, city, PIN, state and GSTIN, and a message says Loaded client: name.
- **Or save someone new**Type their name; at the bottom of the list click **Save "name" as new client**. The client form opens with what you have typed so far. Save it and the client is picked on this invoice and kept for next time. You do not have to: an invoice can go to a name that is not saved.

**Client preferences.** A saved client can carry their own paper size (a custom size too), currency and auto-print setting. When you pick them on a new invoice, those are applied. When you save an invoice for a saved client, the paper size and currency it used become that client's preference, so their next invoice starts the same way.

### What the GSTIN check tells you

When you leave the GSTIN box, the app reads the number. The first two digits are the state code, and the last character is a check character. This works offline, with no GST portal lookup.

| Message under the box | Meaning | What to do |

| ✓ Registered in state — state filled in. | The State was blank, so it has been filled in from the GSTIN. | Nothing. |

| ✓ Registered in state . | The GSTIN and the State agree. | Nothing. |

| ⚠ This GSTIN is registered in state , but the state says other state . | The two disagree. | Check which is right. The tax split follows the State and Place of Supply, not the GSTIN. |

| ⚠ This GSTIN fails its own checksum — check for a typo. | The check character does not add up, so a character is almost certainly mistyped (0 for O, 1 for I and so on). | Compare it with the client's GST certificate or their last invoice. |

These are warnings only. They never stop you saving. The message clears as soon as you type in the box again.

### Using a client's credit

If the client paid more than they owed on earlier invoices, a blue banner appears at the top of Billed To on a new invoice: **💳 Client has ₹… credit**, with the invoices the overpayment came from.

- **Choose how much to use**Type an amount in the box, or click Apply full to use as much as this invoice needs. It can never be more than the credit or the invoice total.
- **Check the line under it**It says how much will be applied and how much credit will remain.
- **Save**The credit is recorded as a payment on this invoice, and taken off the invoices it came from. A message says which ones.
- Skip (shown once an amount is entered) sets it back to nothing.
- Tick **Auto-apply available client credit on future invoices** to have the credit used automatically whenever you pick a client who has some.

The banner does not show when editing a saved invoice. To see a client's credit and payments, open [their account](https://billing.reazix.com/help/clients.html#ledger).

## Invoice Details

The number, the dates and where the supply happens. Under them are the Ship to box and the order, dispatch and reference details.

| Field | What to know |

| Invoice Number | Filled in with the next number for this type. It is only taken when you first save, so an invoice you abandon does not use up a number. If another invoice took it meanwhile, yours gets the next free number and you are told. You can also type your own number, such as the next page of a paper bill book: a number you type is kept. See [Invoice number format](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#invoice-numbers). |

| Invoice Date | Today, unless you change it. A duplicated or converted invoice starts on today's date too. |

| Due Date | Blank unless you set it. Once it passes, an unpaid invoice shows as **Overdue** on the Dashboard. |

| Cost centre | Only when cost centres are turned on. Tags the sale to a branch, project or department for the [By cost centre](https://billing.reazix.com/help/reports.html#cost-centres) report. It is not printed. |

| Place of Supply | The state where the goods are delivered or the service is supplied. Leave it on **Defaults to Client State** unless that is a different state from the client's address. The tax split follows it. Not shown for bills of supply, composition bills or delivery challans, or when **Place of Supply** is turned off under Customize. |

| Original Invoice Reference | Credit notes only: the invoice it is against, such as INV/2025-26/0001. It prints as "Against Invoice". |

### Changing the number of a saved invoice

You can edit the number of an invoice that is already saved. On the next save it moves to the new number, which must not be used by another invoice, and the copy under the old number goes to the [Trash](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html#trash). An invoice whose overpayment was used as credit on another invoice cannot be renumbered; the app says so.

**Keep GST invoice numbers to 16 characters**
GSTR-1 accepts at most 16 characters (letters, digits, - and /) for tax invoice and credit note numbers. If yours is longer, a warning appears when you save. Shorten the format in [Settings, Invoice Number Format](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#invoice-numbers).

**Something wrong?**
**"Invoice number ... already exists"** or **"was already used — saved as ... instead"**: see [Invoice number already exists](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#duplicate-number).

**The number jumped**, for example from 0007 to 0009: another invoice, a quotation of the same series or a restored backup used it. Numbers are only taken on save, never by opening the screen.

Under **Due Date**, the buttons 7 days, 15 days and 30 days set the due date that many days after the invoice date. If your business type is Freelancer, new invoices start due in 15 days.

The **Currency** box appears here when you bill abroad; see Billing in another currency.

### Exports and SEZ supplies under a LUT

When the client is **abroad** (its country is not India) or is an **SEZ unit or developer** (the SEZ tick on the client), a box appears in Invoice Details: **Export under LUT (no IGST)**, or **SEZ supply under LUT (no IGST)**.

- **Ticked**: the supply is zero-rated. No IGST (and no cess) is charged, the items keep their GST rate for the returns, and the total is the taxable value. The invoice prints, word for word, the declaration Rule 46 requires: SUPPLY MEANT FOR EXPORT/SUPPLY TO SEZ UNIT OR SEZ DEVELOPER FOR AUTHORISED OPERATIONS UNDER BOND OR LETTER OF UNDERTAKING WITHOUT PAYMENT OF INTEGRATED TAX - LUT ARN AD290426123456X (FY 2026-27). Every invoice design prints it, the thermal receipt too.
- **Not ticked**: IGST is charged ("with payment of IGST"), which you claim back later as a refund. The invoice prints the matching declaration …ON PAYMENT OF INTEGRATED TAX.

On a new invoice the box is ticked for you when your business has a LUT saved in [Settings, Company](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#lut) for the financial year of the invoice date. Untick it to charge IGST instead. An invoice saved earlier keeps its own choice. The ARN and year are copied onto the invoice when you tick it, so a new LUT next year never changes an old invoice.

Under the box:

- **Have a LUT?** appears when no LUT is saved. It explains why to file one (no tax to pay and wait for), and links to [how to file it](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-basics.html#lut) (form GST RFD-11, free, once a financial year). You can still tick the box if you have a LUT and have not added it yet; the declaration then prints without the ARN.
- **⚠ Your saved LUT is for FY …** appears when the saved LUT is for another year than the invoice date. File the new year's LUT and update Settings.

**No LUT box?** Then the app does not see this invoice as an export. A note says why, with a button to fix it:

- **Export under LUT? First set the client's country.** You are billing in a foreign currency, but the client is saved in India (the client form starts on India). Click Set the client's country and choose their country.
- **Export under LUT? Place of supply is …** The client is abroad, but Place of supply is an Indian state. Click Make it an export to set it back to **Outside India (export)**.
- **Export under LUT? GST is turned off on this invoice.** The **Tax % column** tick in Customize switches GST off for the whole invoice, which hides the LUT too. Click Turn GST on; under the LUT the tax is still 0.

The tick also decides the GST returns and the e-invoice: SEZ invoices go in GSTR-1 as **SEZ without payment** (SEWOP) or **with payment** (SEWP), and the e-invoice file uses EXPWOP / SEZWOP or EXPWP / SEZWP. Exports abroad still go in Table 6A on the portal by hand, see [the warnings above the tabs](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html#top-bar). The E-Way Bill file uses 0% rates under a LUT. More on export invoices: [What to print on an export or SEZ invoice](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-basics.html#export-invoice).

### Ship to: a different delivery address

**Ship to same as bill-to address** is ticked to start, so the invoice has only a BILL TO block. When the goods go somewhere else, such as a site, a warehouse or the client's customer, untick it and fill in:

| Field | What to enter |

| Shipping Address | The delivery address, warehouse or consignee location. Can run to two lines. |

| Shipping City | The delivery city. |

| Shipping PIN | The 6-digit delivery PIN. |

| Shipping State | The delivery state. **Same as billing state** leaves it as the client's state. |

The invoice then prints a separate **SHIP TO** block beside BILL TO.

**The ship-to state does not change the tax**
CGST + SGST or IGST follows **Place of Supply**, not the shipping state. If the delivery is in another state, set Place of Supply too. For "bill to one party, ship to another" sales, ask your CA which state is the place of supply.

### Order, dispatch and reference details

At the bottom of Invoice Details, click **Order, dispatch & reference details** to open a set of optional boxes, the ones a Tally invoice carries. It shows how many are filled, and stays open on an invoice that has any of them.

| Box | For example |

| Work details | Supply and installation of high mast lights, scope as per annexure |

| Revision No | Rev-1, when you reissue a corrected quotation |

| Vehicle No | TS09AB1234 |

| Service period from / to | The period a service bill covers, such as a monthly AMC. A warning appears if the end is before the start. |

| Buyer's Order No and Order date | The client's purchase order (PO) or work order |

| Reference No & Date, Other references | Any other number your client wants quoted |

| Delivery Note and Delivery note date | The delivery challan or note that went with the goods |

| Dispatch Doc No, Dispatched through, Destination | LR or docket number, transporter such as VRL Logistics by road, and the destination town |

| Mode / Terms of payment | 30 days, NEFT |

| Terms of delivery | Ex-works, door delivery, FOR destination |

Only what you fill in prints. The [Tally style](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoice-options.html#style) design shows them in its reference boxes, Boxed grid prints Work details on its own line, and the other designs list them under Bill To.

## Scanning barcodes

With a barcode scanner, each scan adds a product to the invoice. Give your products their barcodes first: see [Barcode](https://billing.reazix.com/help/products.html#barcode) on the Products page.

- **Click Scan barcode**The box at the top of Line Items.
- **Scan**The product is added with its price, GST rate and unit. Scan the same product again and its quantity goes up by one; a different product gets its own row.
- **Keep scanning**The cursor stays in the box, so you can scan the next item straight away.
- A code no product has shows **No product has barcode …** and adds nothing. Add the barcode to the product under [Products](https://billing.reazix.com/help/products.html#barcode), then scan again.
- Scanned into an **Item** box by mistake? That works too: the code is replaced by the product, and the cursor moves to the scan box.
- The box is hidden on an invoice for services.

### Which scanners work

USB, Bluetooth and wireless (USB dongle) scanners all work when they are in **keyboard** mode (often called HID), which most are already. The app reads what the scanner types, so no driver or pairing inside the app is needed. If codes appear but nothing is added, check these settings in the scanner's manual (usually set by scanning a setup barcode):

- **Mode**: HID or keyboard, not SPP, BLE or serial. Those modes do not type, so no browser app can read them.
- **Suffix**: Enter (CR) or Tab after each code.
