- **Keyboard language**: US English, so numbers and dashes come out right.
- **No prefix**: extra characters before the code (an AIM ID) stop it matching.

## Line Items

One row for each thing you are selling. The amount for each row and the totals are worked out for you and shown in the preview.

| Field | What to know |

| Item | The item name. Typing searches your [products](https://billing.reazix.com/help/products.html) by name or HSN and shows up to five, with their HSN and price. Pick one with the mouse, or with ↓ ↑ and Enter . Picking fills in the HSN, selling price, unit and GST rate, and links the row to the product so its stock is counted. You can also type any name that is not a product. |

| HSN/SAC | The goods (HSN) or services (SAC) code. GST returns need it. For common codes the app knows the usual GST rate since 22 September 2025: from the fourth digit it shows the rate and the item type in green under the box, and if the row's GST is still 18% or 0% it is changed to match. Where the rate depends on the price, size or packing (clothes and shoes up to or above ₹2,500, cars and bikes by engine size, loose or packed food) it shows every possible rate and leaves your GST % alone. Always check it: see [GST basics: what rate do I charge?](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-basics.html#which-rate) Finding your code: see [GST basics: HSN and SAC](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-basics.html#hsn-search). |

| Qty | 1 to start. Clicking the box selects the number, so typing replaces it. Decimals are fine, such as 2.5 kg. |

| Unit | From the list for Goods, Services or Mixed. A new row starts with the unit of the row above. ＋ Add custom… adds your own unit (up to 20 characters), marked ★ and kept in this browser for later invoices; − Remove "unit" takes one away again. Invoices already made keep the unit they used. |

| Rate | Price for one unit. Without GST, unless Prices include tax is ticked. |

| Discount | A discount on this row, as an amount or a percentage. See Discounts . Hidden when **Discount column** is off under Customize. |

| GST % | 0, 0.1, 0.25, 3, 5, 12, 18, 28 or 40%, plus any rates you added in [Print Settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html#tax-rates). Custom… takes any rate from 0 to 100, up to two decimals. New rows start at 18%. Since 22 September 2025 most goods are at 5%, 18% or 40%; 12% and 28% stay for older invoices and the items still taxed at them. Which rate applies to your item: see [GST basics: what rate do I charge?](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-basics.html#which-rate) Hidden when there is no GST on the invoice. Outside India the label is your country's tax, such as VAT %. |

| Cess % | Compensation cess, for tobacco, cars, coal and the like. Hidden until you turn on **GST Cess % column** under Customize. |

| Bin | Removes the row. The last remaining row cannot be removed. |

### Buttons under the rows

- + Add description under a row opens a box for a longer note, such as a model number, size or what the work covered. It prints under the item name.
- Add Item adds a row and puts the cursor in it. So does pressing Enter in the last row once it has something in it, or Ctrl + Enter anywhere.
- Ctrl + Shift + D copies the last row as a new row.
- Delivery charges adds a delivery line: see Delivery charges.
- **Type the item**Start typing in **Item** and pick your product from the list.
- **Set the quantity**Click **Qty** and type the number. Check the unit.
- **Check the rate and GST**They come from the product. Change them for this invoice if needed; the product itself is not changed.
- **Next row**Press Enter to add the next row, and repeat.

**Something wrong?**
**No product list appears while typing.** The product is not saved yet, or its name is spelt differently. Add it on the [Products](https://billing.reazix.com/help/products.html#add-product) screen, or just type the row by hand.

**The GST rate changed by itself.** You typed an HSN/SAC code the app knows, and the row was still on 18% or 0%. Pick the right rate from the list.

**The green hint shows two or three rates.** That item's rate depends on its price, size or packing, so the app does not pick one. Choose the rate that fits your item.

**A column such as HSN or Discount is missing.** It is turned off under Customize, in [Items table](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoice-options.html#show-items).

### Delivery charges

Delivery charges adds one **Delivery charges** line with SAC 996812. Type the amount in its **Rate**. The button goes away once the line is there; remove the line with its bin to add it again.

- Delivery that comes with the goods is a composite supply, taxed like the goods, so the line starts at the highest GST rate among the goods on the invoice (18% if there are none). A note under the buttons says so. Change its GST % if your delivery is a separate service.
- It counts in the total and in GST returns, and never touches stock.
- Picking a product in its Item box turns it into an ordinary product line.

### Prices that already include GST

If your rates already include GST, such as an MRP or a counter price, tick **Prices include tax** at the top right of the Line Items card. The box only shows when the invoice charges GST.

The GST is then worked out backwards from each rate: a ₹1,180 item at 18% is ₹1,000 taxable value plus ₹180 GST. The printed Subtotal is the value before tax, so Subtotal + tax = Total, and the client pays exactly the price you typed.

## Discounts

There are two kinds, and they do different things to the GST.

### On a line (before tax)

In the row's **Discount** box, type the amount and choose ₹ or % in the small list beside it. For a ₹ amount, a second list chooses what it comes off:

| Choice | Means | Example: 10 pcs at ₹100, 18% GST, discount 50 |

| Net | ₹ off the row's total (quantity × rate). The default. | ₹50 off ₹1,000: taxable ₹950 |

| Unit | ₹ off each unit. | ₹50 × 10 = ₹500 off: taxable ₹500 |

| W/Tax | ₹ off the total including tax, so the client's total drops by exactly that much. | ₹50 off ₹1,180: taxable about ₹957.63 |

A % discount is a percentage of the row (at most 100%). A discount can never be more than the row itself. This is the GST-correct way to give a discount, because it comes off before tax and lowers the GST too.

### On the whole bill (after tax)

Under the items, **Discount on total (whole bill)** takes an amount (fixed) or a **% of total**. It is taken off after tax, as a cash discount: the GST stays the same and the GST returns are not changed. It prints as its own line above the total. Leave it at 0 for none.

**Something wrong?**
**The GST did not go down after a discount.** You used the whole-bill discount, which is after tax. Use a line discount instead.

## How GST is worked out

You never choose between CGST, SGST and IGST. The app decides from your state and the place of supply (the client's state, unless you set Place of Supply):

| Situation | Charged as |

| Client in your state | CGST + SGST, half each |

| Client in another state | IGST |

| Within a Union Territory without a legislature (Chandigarh, Ladakh, Lakshadweep, Andaman and Nicobar, Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu) | CGST + UTGST |

| SEZ client | IGST |

| Client outside India (an export) | IGST, unless you set an Indian state as Place of Supply (goods delivered in India for a foreign buyer) |

If a state is blank, the first two digits of the GSTIN stand in for it. The preview shows **Intrastate (CGST + SGST)** or **Interstate (IGST)** next to the place of supply, so you can check it before saving. See also [the glossary](https://billing.reazix.com/help/glossary.html#terms) for these terms.

**Your own state must be set**
If your business state is blank in [Settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#company-details), the app warns you once (Set your business State in Settings) and does not guess, because a wrong guess would charge the wrong tax on every invoice. See [this fix](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#state-missing).

## Reverse charge

Under reverse charge (RCM), the buyer pays the GST to the government instead of you, under section 9(3) or 9(4). Common cases are goods transport (GTA) services, legal services from an advocate, and supplies from an unregistered person to a registered one. Ask your CA whether it applies.

- **Open Customize**Click Customize in the toolbar.
- **Tick reverse charge**Under **Compliance flags (India)**, tick **Reverse Charge applies (Section 9(3)/9(4)) — recipient pays GST**.
- **Check the preview**The invoice now says Reverse Charge: Yes and prints a notice that the recipient pays the GST.

The GST is still shown, so the buyer knows how much to pay, but it is **not added to the total**: the total is the taxable value only, and cess is not collected either. Every tax invoice and credit note prints Reverse Charge Yes or No, as the rules require.

**It is remembered**
Like every Customize option, the tick carries over to your next new invoice. Untick it when you are done.

## TDS and TCS

Both are in the Customize panel, for Indian businesses. They show unless your [business type](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#business-type) hides them; the switch is **TDS / TCS** in [Settings, Features](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#features). An invoice that already has TDS or TCS keeps its box, so it can still be changed.

- **TCS**, tax you collect from the client, is added to the invoice total. See TCS.
- **TDS**, tax your client deducts when paying you, is for information: the total does not change. See TDS.

Each has a section list and a **Rate %** box beside it. Picking a section fills in its usual rate; you can type another rate.

TDS is worked out on the value before GST, as CBDT Circular 23/2017 says when GST is shown separately. TCS under CGST section 52 is worked out on the net taxable value, and TCS under 206C(1) on the amount including GST. Who deducts what, and how to check it reached your PAN: see [GST basics: TDS and TCS](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-basics.html#income-tax-tds).

- **194Q** (and 206C(1H) on invoices before April 2025) only applies above ₹50 lakh a year with that client. The app adds up what you have already billed the client this financial year, and charges only the part above ₹50 lakh.
- **Every other section**, such as 194C, 194J or CGST section 52, applies from the first rupee. Tick it only when the rules say it applies to this client.

Invoices with TDS or TCS are listed in [Reports, TDS & TCS](https://billing.reazix.com/help/reports.html#tds-tcs), where you also tick off each TDS certificate, and summed in [the GST Returns TDS / TCS tab](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html#tds-tcs). A client deducted TDS you did not put on the invoice? Record it with the payment: see [TDS when recording a payment](https://billing.reazix.com/help/dashboard.html#payment-tds). Have your CA confirm which sections and rates apply to you.

### TCS: tax collected at source

Tick **TCS — Tax Collected at Source** (marked Adds to invoice total), then pick the section:

| Section | Starting rate | Worked out on |

| CGST 52 — E-commerce operator | 0.5% (since 10 July 2024; it was 1%. Invoices made earlier keep their rate) | The taxable value, without GST |

| 206C(1) — Tendu leaves / scrap / minerals (varies) | 1% (type the right rate for your goods) | The amount including GST |

| Custom rate | Type it | The amount including GST |

The TCS prints as its own line and is added to the total. Section 206C(1H), TCS on sale of goods, was removed from 1 April 2025, so new invoices cannot choose it; invoices already made with it keep it, and it shows greyed out in the list.

### TDS: tax deducted at source

Tick **TDS — Tax Deducted at Source** (marked Buyer deducts; informational), then pick the section your client deducts under:

| Section | Starting rate |

| 194Q — Purchase of goods (buyer turnover ₹10cr) | 0.1%, only above ₹50 lakh a year |

| 194C — Contractor / sub-contractor | 1% |

| 194C — Contractor (company) | 2% |

| 194J — Professional / technical services | 10% |

| 194J — Technical services (lower rate) | 2% |

| 194I — Rent (land / building) | 10% |

| 194I — Rent (plant / machinery) | 2% |

| 194H — Commission / brokerage | 5% |

| 194O — E-commerce participant | 1% |

| 195 — Payments to non-residents (varies) | Type it |

| Custom section / rate | Type it |

TDS is worked out on the value without GST, as the CBDT circulars require when the invoice shows GST separately. The invoice shows **Less: TDS** and the **Net Receivable**, the amount you should actually receive. The invoice counts as paid once payments cover the total less the TDS.

## Billing in another currency

If you bill clients abroad, you can make the invoice in their currency: US dollars, euros, pounds, dirhams and the other currencies of the countries the app supports.

### Where the currency box is

A **Currency** box (for example **$ USD**) sits in the Invoice Details card, next to the dates, when any of these is true:

- [Settings, Region](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#region) is **International** or **Both / Auto**.
- The client's country is not India.
- The invoice is already in a currency other than rupees.

If your Region is **India only** and you bill an Indian client in rupees, the box stays out of the way. It is always in Customize at the top of the panel.

Changing the currency changes every money symbol on the screen and in the preview at once. The Rate box of each line shows the symbol too, such as **Rate ($)**.

### Which currency a new invoice starts in

- A client you saved with a **Preferred currency** gets that currency.
- A client abroad without one gets their country's currency (a UK client gets pounds). For the country **Other**, the last foreign currency you used is picked.
- An Indian client gets rupees. Before, the app kept whatever the last invoice used, so after a dollar invoice the next Indian client was billed in dollars too.
- When you save, the currency is remembered on the client, so the next invoice for them starts the same way.

### The exchange rate

For any currency other than rupees, a second box asks **1 USD = ? INR**. Type how many rupees one unit was worth on the invoice date, such as 84.10. Use your bank's rate for that day or the RBI reference rate. The app does not fetch rates from the internet.

- Under the boxes the app shows the invoice total in rupees, for example **≈ ₹84,100.00 in all**.
- The rate is saved with the invoice. GST returns, reports, the Dashboard and income tax turn the invoice into rupees with this rate, never with today's, so a return you filed last month gives the same figures today.
- The rate you last typed for a currency shows in grey in the box as a reminder. It is not filled in for you, because rates change every day.
- If you leave the rate empty, a warning says so. The GST returns screen then lists the invoice as an error and will not make the GSTR-1 file until you add the rate.

### What prints on the invoice

- An **EXCHANGE RATE** line, such as 1 USD = 84.1000 INR. Turn on [Print Settings, Dual currency display](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html#dual-currency) to add the rupee total to that line: 1 USD = 84.1000 INR · Total ₹84,100.00.
- The UPI QR code is left off: UPI only takes rupees. If your payment account has an [online payment link](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#paid-from-abroad) (PayPal, Wise, Payoneer), it prints instead as **PAY ONLINE**.
- The currency decides the money symbol, not the tax. A client outside India is an export whatever currency you bill in; see [Exports](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-basics.html#exports) and [LUT](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-basics.html#lut).

## Terms & Conditions, notes and a private note

The fourth card holds three boxes: the **Terms** that print at the foot of the invoice, **Notes / Remarks** for the client, and a **Private Note** only you see.

### Terms

A text box with a small toolbar: **B**, I, U, • List, 1. List, H for a heading, ¶ for a normal paragraph, 🔗 to turn the selected words into a link, and ✕ to clear formatting. You can paste from Word or Google Docs.

- **Insert preset (by business type)** fills in India-specific starter wording: Generic SME / Trader, Freelancer / Consultant, Manufacturer / Wholesale, Retail Shop, Restaurant / Café, IT / Software Services, Construction / Contractor, Medical / Healthcare, Educational Services / Coaching, Transport / Logistics, Real Estate / Rental Invoice, E-commerce Seller, or Export / International (LUT). **— Start from blank —** empties the box. If you already have terms, you are asked once (Replace current Terms?); later swaps in the same browser session happen without asking. Edit the wording freely afterwards.
- **Load saved template** uses one of [your saved templates](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#terms). It only shows when you have saved one. On a brand-new invoice, your first template is loaded for you. Once you edit the text the list shows **— Custom —**.

### Notes / Remarks (optional)

Prints on the invoice under the terms, for the client: project details, special instructions, a thank-you. It has the same toolbar as Terms.

**Something wrong?**
**Terms or notes do not print.** Check **Terms & Conditions** and **Notes / Remarks** are ticked under Customize, in [Footer](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoice-options.html#show-footer). Thermal receipts never print terms.

**A saved invoice got my new terms.** It does not: the first template only fills a brand-new blank invoice. A saved invoice keeps its own terms.

### PDF layout: Compact or Formatted

On the right of the Terms & Conditions title, **PDF layout** chooses how the terms and notes print:

| Choice | Prints | Good for |

| Compact | Small footer text, to save paper | Standard boilerplate terms on goods invoices |

| Formatted | Larger, readable paragraphs with lists kept | Long service terms, scope and payment schedules |

Until you choose, the layout follows [Print Settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html#terms-page), and a **Services** invoice starts as Formatted.

### Private Note (not shown on invoice)

The yellow box at the bottom of the card is only for you, such as Client asked for 15-day credit, follow up on 20th, referred by Ravi. It is saved with the invoice but never prints or goes to the client. On the Dashboard, a yellow note icon next to the client shows it.

## Additional Pages / Sections

Extra pages printed after the invoice, such as a scope of work, a delivery timeline, a warranty card or a price breakup. Each section prints as its own page in the PDF.

- **Add a section**Click Add Section at the top right of the card.
- **Give it a title**For example Scope of Work or Delivery Timeline. It prints as the page heading.
- **Write or paste the content**Type, or paste formatted text, lists and tables from Word or Google Docs; the formatting is kept.
- **Order them**The up and down arrows move a section. The red bin removes it.

**Removing a section is immediate**
The bin does not ask first and there is no undo. Copy the text somewhere before you remove a section you may need again.

Extra pages do not print on thermal receipts. Each section is fitted onto one page, so very long content comes out squeezed: split a long annexure into two or more sections.

## The live preview

The **Live preview** on the right shows the invoice exactly as it will print, with the paper size, style and options you chose, and updates as you type. − and + zoom out and in from 50% to 200%, and Fit fits it to the width of the space. The zoom is remembered.

- A cancelled invoice shows CANCELLED across it; a proforma shows a faint ESTIMATE.
- On a thermal paper size the preview is a narrow receipt.
- Full view opens the whole page in the [print preview](https://billing.reazix.com/help/dashboard.html#print-preview) window, with Print and Download PDF.
- To give the form more room, click Hide Preview in the toolbar.

If something prints differently from the preview, see [Something is missing from the PDF](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#missing-on-pdf).

## What must be filled in

A new invoice needs a **client name** and **at least one item** with a name, a quantity and a rate. Otherwise Save, Save & Download and Print stop with Add a client name before saving. or Add at least one item with a quantity and rate before saving. Click the amber **Draft — click to complete** badge in the toolbar to jump to what is missing.

This is so a blank invoice never takes an invoice number: GST expects numbers without gaps.

## Save & Download

Save & Download (or Ctrl + P) does all of this in one go:

- Saves the invoice, giving a new invoice its number, and counts it as printed once more.
- Downloads the PDF, showing that saved number, named after the type and number, such as INV_INV-2026-27-0001.pdf.
- Keeps a copy of the PDF in the app's Saved Invoices folder, in a folder for that client and month.
- Uploads it to Google Drive, if you have connected Drive in [Settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#google-drive).
- Prints it, if auto-print is on in [Print Settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html#auto-print) or for this client.

Saving takes the items out of stock, for rows picked from your products; saving again after changing a quantity moves only the difference, a credit note puts stock back, and a quotation or proforma moves none (see [How stock is counted](https://billing.reazix.com/help/products.html#stock)). If stock runs low (5 or fewer) or out, you are told.

If you change an invoice you have already downloaded or printed, a plain Save also updates its PDF in the Saved Invoices folder, without downloading it again.

Long invoices are split between rows, never through a row, and the signature and stamp are never cut across a page break: if they would be, the whole footer moves to the next page.

**Something wrong?**
**"Failed to generate PDF."** See [Print does nothing, or "Print failed"](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#print-blocked). **"Its PDF in Saved Invoices could not be updated"**: close that PDF if it is open, see [this fix](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#pdf-file-in-use).

## Printing

- **On A4, A5 and other sheet sizes**, Print saves the invoice, makes a sharp print copy and opens your browser's print window, which has its own page preview.
- **On a thermal paper size**, it first shows a **Print preview** of the receipt, with Print, Download PDF and Cancel. See [Thermal receipt printing](https://billing.reazix.com/help/thermal-printing.html#print-preview).

Printing saves the invoice first, like Save & Download, so what you hand the client is always in your records with the same number.

**Something wrong?**
**Nothing happens, or "Print failed — try Download PDF instead".** Allow pop-ups for the app, or download the PDF and print that. See [Print does nothing](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#print-blocked).

## Sending on WhatsApp

WhatsApp opens WhatsApp with this message typed in: the invoice number, date, client, subtotal and total, and your business name. If the client is saved with a phone number, the chat opens with them; otherwise you choose the contact. It does not save the invoice.

From the invoice screen the PDF is not attached. Download it with Save & Download and drag it into the chat. The WhatsApp button on the [Dashboard](https://billing.reazix.com/help/dashboard.html#row-actions) can attach the PDF on phones.

## E-way bill

An e-way bill is generally needed when goods worth more than ₹50,000 are moved. For tax invoices and delivery challans, E-Way Bill downloads a file, such as EWB-INV-2026-27-0001.json, in the format the NIC e-way bill portal accepts. Upload it there with its JSON upload option instead of typing everything again. The app makes the file; the e-way bill number itself comes from the portal (see [what the app does not do](https://billing.reazix.com/help/limitations.html#eway-generation)).

- **Turn it on**The button shows only while **E-way bill** is on in [Settings, Features](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#features).
- **Save the invoice first**The file uses the number on screen, so save first to be sure it is the final number.
- **Click E-Way Bill**The file downloads, and a message says E-Way Bill JSON downloaded.
- **Upload it on the portal**Add the vehicle and transporter details there if the portal asks.

**Something wrong?**
**"Set your GSTIN in Settings first"**: your own GSTIN is missing in [Settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#company-details). **"Add at least one item with a quantity and rate first."**: the invoice has no real item yet.

**"Your business PIN code is missing"** or **"The client's PIN code is missing"**: the file needs both 6-digit PIN codes. Yours is in [Settings, Company Details](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#company-details); the client's is **PIN Code** under Billed To on the invoice (or on the client in Clients). Fill it in and click again. The file uses the client's billing address, not the Ship to address, so check the delivery details on the portal.

## Saving as you go

- What you type is kept while the browser tab stays open. If you leave the screen by mistake and come back, the invoice is still there.
- A **new** invoice (or a duplicate or conversion) is not stored in your records until you first click Save, Save & Download or Print. It takes its number only then.
- After that, changes are saved automatically about two seconds after you stop typing.

The badge beside Back tells you where you are:

| Badge | Means |

| **Draft — click to complete** (amber) | A new invoice still missing a client name or an item. Click it to jump to the first missing box. |

| **Not saved yet** | Ready to save, but not saved even once. Click Save . |

| **Saving…** (blue) | An automatic save is running. |

| **All changes saved** (green) | The last change is stored. Shows for a moment after each save. |

| **Ready** | Saved; nothing waiting. |

## Leaving with unsaved changes

If you click Back after changing an invoice that has a client and an item, an **Unsaved changes** window asks what to do:

| Button | What it does |

| Keep editing | Closes the window and stays on the invoice. Esc does the same. |

| Discard & leave | Leaves without saving. A new invoice that was never saved is gone, and its number is not used. On a saved invoice, only the changes since the last automatic save are lost. |

| Save & leave | Saves, then goes back. A new invoice takes its number now. If the save fails, you stay on the page so you can try again. |

Closing or reloading the browser tab asks too, with the browser's own message. Opening an invoice and leaving without changing anything does not ask.

## Keyboard shortcuts on this screen

| Ctrl + S | Save (once the invoice has a client and an item; before that the browser's own save window may open, just close it) |

| Ctrl + P | Save and download the PDF (not print) |

| Ctrl + Enter | Add an item row |

| Ctrl + Shift + D | Duplicate the last row |

| Enter in the last row | Add a row |

| ↑ ↓ Enter | Pick from the client or product suggestions |

| Esc | Close suggestions or a dialog |

On a Mac, use ⌘ instead of Ctrl. More shortcuts: [Shortcuts, search and notifications](https://billing.reazix.com/help/shortcuts.html).

## When an invoice cannot be changed

Two kinds of document open read-only, with a blue note at the top:

- **A cancelled invoice**: This invoice is cancelled and read-only. Undo the cancel on the [Dashboard](https://billing.reazix.com/help/dashboard.html#cancel) to change it.
- **A quotation, proforma or challan already converted**: Converted to INV/…. This copy is read-only.

You can still download or print them. Nothing is saved automatically, and Save explains why. To make a new document from one, use Duplicate on the Dashboard.

An invoice with an **IRN** (e-invoice) shows an amber note instead: changes made here are not sent to the e-invoice portal. To correct an e-invoice, cancel it on the portal within 24 hours and issue a new one, or issue a credit note. See [E-invoicing](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html#e-invoice).

## How to make a credit note

- **Start a new invoice**Choose **Credit Note** as the type.
- **Point it at the original**In **Original Invoice Reference**, enter the number of the invoice it corrects.
- **Enter what is being credited**Add the returned items, or the price difference, with the same GST rates as the original.
- **Save**Its total is subtracted from your sales on the Dashboard, returned goods go back into stock, and it goes into GSTR-1 as a credit note.

## Turning a quote into an invoice

When a client accepts a Quotation or a Proforma / Estimate, click Convert to Tax Invoice on it in the Dashboard. A new tax invoice opens with the same client and items, and gets its own number when you save it. The same works for a delivery challan. Once saved, the original shows **Converted** and its Convert button goes away, so it cannot be turned into a second invoice by mistake.

## Cancelling an invoice

An invoice number, once issued, has to stay in your records, so a saved invoice is cancelled rather than deleted. Cancel it from the [Dashboard](https://billing.reazix.com/help/dashboard.html#cancel): it keeps its number, prints with CANCELLED across it, drops out of your totals and GST returns, and its stock goes back.

To correct an invoice already sent to a client, the GST way is a credit note rather than a cancellation.

---

# Customize: what prints and how

URL: https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoice-options.html

The Customize panel on the invoice screen: title, currency, style, colour, every show-or-hide option, paper size and thermal settings, and exactly what each part of the printed invoice shows.

## Your choices become the default

Open the panel with Customize in the invoice toolbar. Whatever you change here is used for this invoice **and remembered for your next new invoice**, including the title, reverse charge, TDS and TCS. If a setting was only meant for one invoice, change it back afterwards.

A saved invoice keeps the options it was saved with.

These are per-invoice settings. The app-wide look, such as fonts, watermarks, copies and translated labels, is in [Print and PDF settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html).

## Title, currency and exchange rate

The first three boxes at the top of the Customize panel.

| Box | What it does |

| Invoice Title | Replaces the printed title, such as TAX INVOICE. The box shows the type's own title in grey; leave it blank to use that. Useful for wording such as INVOICE CUM CHALLAN . Thermal receipts ignore it. |

| Currency | The same box as in Invoice Details. See [Billing in another currency](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#currency). |

| 1 USD = ? INR | Only for currencies other than rupees: how many rupees one unit was worth on the invoice date, such as 84.10. Kept with the invoice; returns and reports use it. |

A custom title is remembered for your next invoice too (see Your choices become the default). Clear the box when you go back to normal invoices.

## Make this a recurring invoice

Tick **🔁 Make this a recurring invoice** to have the app create this invoice again on a schedule, with the same client, items and amounts, a fresh number and that day's date. Good for rent, retainers, AMCs and subscriptions.

| Box | What to enter |

| Frequency | Weekly, Monthly (the default), Quarterly or Yearly |

| Every N (interval) | 1 to 12. Monthly with 3 means every three months. |

| Next invoice date | When the first copy is made. Starts one month after this invoice's date (31 January becomes 28 February, not 3 March). |

| End condition | **Never (until I stop it)**; **On a specific date**, which adds a **Stop generating after this date** box; or **After N invoices**, which adds a box for how many, for example 12 for a one-year monthly contract |

- **Make the first invoice as usual**Client, items, terms.
- **Tick the box and set the schedule**In Customize, tick **🔁 Make this a recurring invoice** and fill in the boxes.
- **Save the invoice**The schedule is saved with it. Saving the invoice again later keeps the schedule running where it is, unless you change the Next invoice date.

New copies are made whenever you open the app on or after the due date (or once a day if it stays running). If this invoice has a due date, each copy gets one the same number of days after its own date. Pause, change or stop the schedule from [Recurring](https://billing.reazix.com/help/recurring.html) in the sidebar.

## TCS, TDS and the payment account

- **TCS — Tax Collected at Source** and **TDS — Tax Deducted at Source**: see [TCS](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#tcs) and [TDS](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#tds).
- **Payment account on this invoice**: which bank account and UPI ID print. See below.

### Payment account on this invoice

If you have saved bank accounts in [Settings, Bank accounts and UPI](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#payment-accounts), this list chooses which one prints in the bank block and the UPI QR. Each is shown by its label and bank, with ⭐ before your default. With no accounts saved, the list is not shown.

- New invoices start with your ⭐ default account (or, with no default, the one you used last).
- The preview changes as soon as you pick another account.
- The bank details and UPI ID are copied onto the invoice when you save it, so editing or removing the account in Settings later never changes an invoice you have already sent.

## PDF style and accent colour

**PDF Style** picks the design. Hover over a chip for a one-line description. The preview changes straight away.

| Style | Look |

| Classic | Clean, with a coloured bar across the top. The default. |

| Modern | A solid colour block behind your business name, with the logo in white. |

| Minimal | Simple, with no borders. |

| Boxed grid | Every section in ruled boxes: your name large at the top, seller and document details side by side, Billing To and Shipping To, a Work Details line, and an item table filled with empty rows to a fixed height, like a printed quotation pad. |

| Tally style | The Tally layout: reference and dispatch boxes beside your details, state names with their codes, taxes inside the item table, amount in words with E. & O.E, an HSN/SAC tax summary, tax amount in words, your PAN, a declaration, and a "Customer's Seal and Signature" box. |

Tally style (left) and Boxed grid (right), with a made-up business.

Boxed grid and Tally style pad the item table to fill the page. If that padding alone would push the invoice onto a second page, the PDF trims it so the terms, bank details and signature stay on page 1. The boxes for [order, dispatch and reference details](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#order-details) are filled from Invoice Details.

### Accent Color

The row of round swatches sets the colour of headings, bars and lines on the invoice.

- **Auto**, the multicoloured swatch, gives each type its own colour, such as blue for tax invoices, purple for proformas, teal for bills of supply and red for credit notes, so you can tell them apart at a glance. The default.
- The other eight are fixed colours: blue, purple, teal, red, orange, green, sky and dark. Hover over one to see its name. Pick one to use it on every type, for example to match your logo.

The chosen swatch has a white ring inside it. The colour is remembered for your next invoice. For black-and-white printers, **dark** prints most clearly.

## Showing and hiding parts of the invoice

Below the style, the panel lists tick boxes in groups. Each one shows or hides one part of the printed invoice. Hiding something never deletes it: tick it again and it comes back. Each group title has its own ? that opens the part below about it.

| Group | Options | Off to start |

| Header & branding | Logo, Business name, Business address, Business phone, Business email, Business state, Tax ID (GSTIN/VAT/etc.) | |

| Client / Bill-to | Client address, Client phone, Client email, Place of Supply | |

| Invoice meta | Invoice number, Invoice date, Due date | |

| Items table | HSN/SAC column, Qty column, Unit suffix (next to Qty), Rate column, Discount column, Tax % column (GST/VAT/etc.), GST Cess % column | GST Cess |

| Totals | Subtotal row, Amount in words, Round-off line, HSN/SAC tax summary table, Tax amount in words | The HSN summary and tax in words are on only in Tally style. Round-off follows [Print & PDF](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html#round-off) (on for new installs). |

| [Compliance flags (India)](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#reverse-charge) | Reverse Charge applies (Section 9(3)/9(4)) — recipient pays GST | Reverse Charge |

| Footer | Bank details, "Pay via" account label, UPI QR (rupee invoices), Signature block, "Authorized Signatory" caption, Terms & Conditions, Notes / Remarks, system-generated note, Declaration, "Customer's Seal and Signature" box | "Pay via" label, system-generated note. Declaration and the seal box are on only in Tally style. |

Between Compliance flags and Footer sits the Paper / print size list.

### Hide all and Reset to default

- Hide all turns off, in one click, everything in Header & branding, Client / Bill-to and Invoice meta; in Items table everything but GST Cess; in Totals the subtotal, amount in words and round-off; and in Footer the bank details, "Pay via" label, UPI QR, signature, caption, terms and notes. Then tick back only what you want. It leaves the HSN summary, tax in words, reverse charge, system-generated note, declaration and seal box as they were.
- Reset to default puts every option back as it was on a fresh install, including the title, currency, style, colour, paper size, Goods/Services choice, whole-bill discount, recurring, TDS, TCS and reverse charge. The payment account you picked for this invoice stays.

**Hide all also stops GST and rounding**
It turns off the **Tax % column**, which removes GST from the invoice, and the **Round-off line**, which can change the total. Tick both back on a tax invoice.

### Header & branding

Your side of the top of the invoice: **Logo**, **Business name**, **Business address**, **Business phone**, **Business email**, **Business state** and **Tax ID (GSTIN/VAT/etc.)**. All on to start. The logo, name and address come from [Settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#company-details).

- **Business state** off also hides the client's state, on the invoice and in the Billed To card.
- **Tax ID** off also hides the client's GSTIN, on the invoice and in the Billed To card. A GST tax invoice must show both GSTINs, so keep it on for tax invoices.
- Using a printed letterhead? Turn the header items off, or set a letterhead in [Print Settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html#letterhead).

### Client / Bill-to

**Client address**, **Client phone**, **Client email** and **Place of Supply**, in the BILL TO block. All on to start. The client's name always prints.

**Place of Supply** off also hides the Place of Supply box in Invoice Details; the tax then follows the client's state. Choosing a type without GST turns it off for you.

### Invoice meta

**Invoice number**, **Invoice date** and **Due date** on the invoice's side of the header. All on to start. A GST tax invoice must show its number and date, so keep those on. The due date only prints when one is set.

### Items table

| Option | Turning it off |

| HSN/SAC column | Hides the column on the invoice and the HSN/SAC box in each row of the form. GST rules require HSN for most businesses, so keep it on for tax invoices. |

| Qty column | Hides the quantity column on the invoice (the unit goes with it). The form keeps its Qty box. Useful for a fixed-fee job billed as quantity 1. |

| Unit (Hrs, Nos...) next to Qty | Prints "5" instead of "5 Hrs". In Classic, Modern, Minimal and on thermal receipts the unit is part of the Qty column; in Boxed grid the UNIT column goes away, and in Tally style the "per" column goes away. **It turns off by itself** when you pick **Services** for an invoice (and back on for Goods or Mixed), until you tick or untick it yourself; after that your choice stays. A freelancer's invoices start with it off. |

| Rate column | Hides the price per unit; the Amount still prints. |

| Discount column | Hides the Disc. column and the Discount box in each row. |

| Tax % column (GST/VAT/etc.) | No GST is charged at all: the tax columns and tax rows disappear, and the GST % box goes from the form. Bill of Supply, Composition and Delivery Challan turn it off for you. |

| GST Cess % column | Off to start. Turning it on adds a Cess % box to each row of the form. The printed invoice shows cess as one line in the totals. |

### Totals

- **Subtotal row**: the value of the items before tax.
- **Amount in words**: the total written out in words, in the invoice's currency.
- **Round-off line**: rounds the grand total to the nearest rupee and shows the difference. The default for new invoices is set in [Print & PDF](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html#round-off); a saved invoice keeps what it was saved with.
- **HSN/SAC tax summary table**: the tax grouped by HSN code and rate, as on a Tally invoice. On to start only in Tally style.
- **Tax amount in words**: the total GST in words. On to start only in Tally style.

### Footer

| Option | What it prints |

| Bank details | The BANK DETAILS block from the payment account , with your PAN. Off hides the PAN too. |

| Show "Pay via: account " label | The account's label above the bank block. Off to start. |

| UPI QR (rupee invoices) | A **Scan to pay** QR with the amount filled in. Needs a UPI ID on the account and a rupee invoice. |

| Signature block | Your signature and stamp, uploaded in [Settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#branding). Prints only when one is uploaded. |

| Show "Authorized Signatory" caption | The words under the signature. |

| Terms & Conditions, Notes / Remarks | What you typed in the [Terms & Conditions card](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#terms-notes). |

| Note: system-generated invoice… | See below . Off to start. |

| Declaration | A declaration paragraph. When on, a **Declaration text** box appears to change its wording. It starts as the standard "We declare that this invoice shows the actual price of the goods described and that all particulars are true and correct." On to start only in Tally style. |

| "Customer's Seal and Signature" box | An empty box for the client to stamp and sign, in Boxed grid and Tally style. On to start only in Tally style. |

**Something wrong?**
**Logo, signature, stamp or UPI QR missing from the PDF?** See [Something is missing from the PDF](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#missing-on-pdf).

## The "system-generated invoice" note

In the Footer group, **Note: system-generated invoice** adds this line below the terms:

**Note:** This is a system-generated invoice. No signature or stamp is required.

It is off unless you turn it on. If you use it, consider turning the signature block off too, so the invoice does not contradict itself.

## Paper size

| Option | Size |

| A4 Portrait (default) | 210 × 297 mm |

| A4 Landscape | 297 × 210 mm |

| A5 Portrait (compact) | 148 × 210 mm |

| A5 Landscape (2 per A4 sheet) | 210 × 148 mm |

| US Letter | 216 × 279 mm |

| US Legal | 216 × 356 mm |

| B5 | 176 × 250 mm |

| 80mm Thermal (POS receipt) | 72 mm printable |

| 76mm Thermal (kitchen printer) | 68 mm printable |

| 58mm Thermal (compact / mobile) | 48 mm printable |

| 112mm Thermal (wide receipt) | 104 mm printable |

| Custom size | Width 30 to 500 mm, height 50 to 1200 mm |

For a custom size, enter the printer's printable width, not the roll width. Anything under 100 mm wide prints as a receipt. The quick buttons 40mm, 76mm, 90mm and 110mm fill in common rolls.

A one-line hint under the **Paper / print size** list says what the chosen size is good for. The preview changes to the new size straight away.

A client can have their own preferred paper size, which is used when you pick them on a new invoice. Saving an invoice for a saved client makes its paper size that client's preference, so a client you always bill on a receipt gets a receipt next time while the others stay on A4.

**Something wrong?**
**Every invoice turned into a receipt.** The last size you chose is remembered for new invoices. Pick **A4 Portrait (default)** again. **Text cut off on a receipt**: see [When a receipt prints badly](https://billing.reazix.com/help/thermal-printing.html#receipt-problems).

## Thermal printer settings

When a thermal size is chosen (or a custom size under 100 mm wide), a **Thermal printer settings** box appears under the paper size:

| Font size | Small (fits more per page), Medium (recommended, the default) or Large (easier to read) |

| Compact mode | Tighter item rows, to save paper on long orders. Off to start. Whether HSN and the quantity × rate line print is set in Print Settings. |

| Cut mark at bottom | Prints a CUT HERE line to tear against. On to start. Turn it off if your printer cuts the paper itself. |

More receipt settings are in [Print Settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html#thermal). See also [Thermal receipt printing](https://billing.reazix.com/help/thermal-printing.html).

## What prints: the header

- **Your side**: logo, business name, address with city and PIN, state, GSTIN, email and phone. Each can be hidden.
- **The invoice's side**: the title; for a proforma, "This is not a tax invoice"; for a credit note, "Against Invoice" and the original number; then the number, date and due date; and, for tax invoices and credit notes in India, **Reverse Charge** Yes or No.

With a letterhead set in Print Settings, the header is replaced by your letterhead.

## What prints: Bill To, Ship To and Place of Supply

- **BILL TO**: the client's name, address, state, GSTIN, email and phone.
- **SHIP TO**: only when a different delivery address is entered.
- **PLACE OF SUPPLY**: the state, with **Interstate (IGST)** or **Intrastate (CGST + SGST)** beside it.

## What prints: the items table

Columns, left to right: **#**, **Description** (with its longer note underneath), **HSN/SAC**, **Qty** with the unit, **Rate**, **Disc.** (only when a line has a discount), the tax columns, and **Amount**.

- Within your state: **CGST** and **SGST**, each with its rate and amount.
- Another state: one **IGST** column.
- Outside India: one column with the local tax name, such as VAT.

**Amount** is the line's value after discount and before tax. The tax is in the columns beside it.

## What prints: the totals

On the left, the **amount in words** and a **Scan to pay (UPI)** QR code with your UPI ID and the amount. The QR only prints on rupee invoices, with a UPI ID set and a total above zero.

On the right, in order: Subtotal, Discount, CGST and SGST or IGST, GST Cess, TCS, Discount on total, Round-off, and **Total Due**. For a credit note, the last line reads **Credit Amount**. With TDS, **Less: TDS** and **Net Receivable** follow.

## What prints: notices and footer

- **Reverse charge notice**, when turned on.
- **Composition declaration**, always on composition bills: "Composition taxable person, not eligible to collect tax on supplies."
- **BANK DETAILS**: "Pay via" label if on, account name, bank, account number and type, IFSC, SWIFT, and your PAN.
- **EXCHANGE RATE**, on foreign-currency invoices.
- **TERMS & CONDITIONS** and **NOTES**, compact or formatted.
- **Signature block**: your signature and stamp side by side, "Authorized Signatory", and your business name. It only prints when a signature or stamp has been uploaded.

Export and SEZ invoices print no LUT declaration by themselves. Use the **Export / International (LUT)** terms preset, or write your own.

## Watermarks

- **CANCELLED**, in red, on a cancelled invoice.
- **ESTIMATE**, very faint, on a proforma.
- Your own watermark, copy labels such as ORIGINAL and DUPLICATE, REPRINT, page numbers and QR codes come from [Print Settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html), and only on sheet paper, not receipts.

---

# Thermal receipt printing

URL: https://billing.reazix.com/help/thermal-printing.html

Printing bills on a 58 mm or 80 mm receipt printer at a shop counter, from setting it up to what the receipt shows.

## Setting it up

- **Install the printer in Windows**Use the driver that came with it, set the paper size in the driver to your roll width, and make it your default printer, or pick it in the print window each time.
- **Choose the receipt size**On an invoice, open Customize and set **Paper / print size** to **80mm Thermal** or **58mm Thermal**. The app remembers it for your next invoice.
- **Try a test print**In [Print Settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html#how-it-saves), pick the **Thermal (80mm)** preview tab and click Test Print.
- **Print a real bill**Save the invoice, then click Print. A preview of the receipt opens; click Print again.

Picking the **Retail Shop** or **Restaurant** business type in [Print Settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html#business-type) sets sensible receipt defaults in one go.

## The print preview

On a receipt size, Print shows the receipt at 160% so you can read it. Its buttons:

| Print | Sends it to the printer. Shows "Sending…" while it works. |

| Download PDF | Saves and downloads a PDF instead, the same as Save & Download. |

| Cancel | Closes it. So does Esc . |

## Printing straight after saving

At a busy counter, turn on [Auto-print on save](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html#auto-print): Save & Download then prints the receipt as well, with no extra click. It can also be turned on for just one client, in their details.

## What a receipt shows

- Your logo (if turned on in Print Settings), business name in capitals, tagline, address, GSTIN and phone.
- The document type, such as TAX INVOICE, then the invoice number, reverse charge, date, and the client's name, GSTIN and phone.
- Each item: its name, then quantity × rate, GST rate and HSN, with the amount on the right. The amount is quantity × rate, before discount and tax.
- Subtotal, discount, CGST, SGST or IGST, cess, round-off and **TOTAL**.
- Amount in words, bank details, a UPI QR code with "Scan to pay via UPI", and notes.
- Your footer message, such as "Thank you for your business!", your email, the cut line and blank lines to tear against.

## What a receipt leaves out

To fit a narrow roll, receipts do not print: terms and conditions, the signature and stamp, extra pages, the due date, place of supply, client address, TCS, TDS, whole-bill discount lines, the exchange rate, watermarks, the reverse charge and composition notices, or the PDF style and colour. The custom invoice title is not used either.

If you need any of these, print that invoice on A4 or A5 instead.

## Changing how receipts look

Font, boldness, capitals, spacing, darkness, what is shown, the QR size, the footer message, the cut mark and feed lines are all in [Print Settings, Thermal receipts](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html#thermal).

## When a receipt prints badly

| Problem | Try |

| Text is cut off on the right | Use a smaller printable width: most 80 mm printers print 72 mm, and most 58 mm printers print 48 mm. Use **Custom size** if yours differs. |

| Print is faint | Set **Font weight** to Bold or Ultra bold, and **Thermal ink darkness** to Dark. |

| The printer jams or stops half-way | Turn on [Buffer-safe mode](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html#thermal-compatibility). |

| Blurry text, or nothing prints | Set **Thermal print method** to **Via PDF**. |

| Paper does not feed far enough to tear | Increase **Feed lines after cut**. |

---

# Dashboard

URL: https://billing.reazix.com/help/dashboard.html

Your invoices at a glance: what you have sold, what you are owed, what is overdue, and every action you can take on an invoice.

## At the top

The Dashboard is the first screen you see. It lists every invoice of the business selected in the sidebar, with the totals above and the actions on each row. If you run more than one business, [switch business](https://billing.reazix.com/help/shortcuts.html#switch-business) in the sidebar and the Dashboard shows only that business's invoices straight away. An old invoice that cannot be matched to any business is shown under every business, so nothing is ever hidden.

The count beside the title (for example **42 invoices**) is every document of that business: tax invoices, quotations, proformas, challans, credit notes and cancelled invoices too. The buttons on the right:

| Button | What it does |

| ? | Opens this page in your browser. The small ? next to each card's title on the Dashboard opens the part of this page about that card. |

| Lock | Locks the app straight away. It shows only when a [PIN](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#lock) is set. |

| CSV import / export | Brings in many invoices from a spreadsheet, or saves all of them to one. See Importing and exporting invoices as CSV . |

| Import IRN | Only when **E-invoicing (IRN)** is on in [Settings, Features](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#features). Reads the file the e-invoice portal gives back and saves each IRN on its invoice. See E-invoicing from the Dashboard . |

| New Invoice | Starts a blank invoice. See [Making an invoice](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html). |

From top to bottom the screen then shows: the welcome note and the Getting started list (new users only), the support card, the red overdue banner (only when something is overdue), the four totals, the low-stock strip (only when a product is running low), and the invoice list with its filters.

## The welcome note

A new install shows a large note at the top: **Welcome to Reazix Billing**. It says the app is yours for life with one payment, your data stays on your own computer and works offline, your purchase includes 3 years of updates, and help is one email away.

| Button | What it does |

| Help & Support | Opens [Help & Support](https://billing.reazix.com/help/support.html), with our email address. |

| Start billing or ✕ | Closes the note for good on this computer and browser. |

It shows only while the business has fewer than 10 documents.

## The Getting started list

A new install also shows four things to do before the app is really useful. Each one ticks itself off when it is **really done** (the app checks what is saved, not whether you opened a screen), and has a button that takes you there. The top right shows how many are done, such as **2 of 4 done**.

| Step | Done when | Button |

| Add your business details | A business name is saved | Open Settings |

| Make your first invoice | Any invoice exists | Start |

| Add your products or services | At least one product is saved | Open (opens Products) |

| Add bank details or UPI | A bank account or UPI ID is saved | Open Settings |

- **Business details**In [Settings, Company details](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#company-details), fill in your business name, address, state and GSTIN (your 15-character GST number). They print on every invoice.
- **Products**Add what you sell once, with its HSN code (goods) or SAC code (services) and GST rate. Then you pick it from a list instead of typing it on every invoice. See [Adding a product](https://billing.reazix.com/help/products.html#add-product).
- **Bank and UPI**Add your bank account or UPI ID in [Settings, Bank accounts and UPI](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#payment-accounts). Invoices then show where to pay, with a UPI QR code the client can scan.
- **First invoice**Pick the client, add the items, and the GST is worked out for you. See [Your first invoice](https://billing.reazix.com/help/first-invoice.html).

The list disappears by itself once all four are done. ✕ at the top right hides it for good on this computer even if steps are left. **Read the 5-minute guide** at the bottom opens this documentation in your browser.

**Something wrong?**
A step stays unticked after you did it? Make sure you clicked Save in Settings (see [Saving your changes](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#save-bar)), then come back to the Dashboard: the list is checked again each time the Dashboard opens. The bank step needs an account number or a UPI ID, not only a bank name.

## Overdue invoices and reminders

An invoice is **overdue** when its due date has passed and it is not fully paid. Each time the Dashboard opens, every Unpaid or Partial tax invoice, bill of supply or composition bill whose **Due Date** is before today is marked Overdue for you. Quotations, proformas, challans and credit notes are never overdue, and neither is a cancelled invoice or one with no due date.

When at least one invoice is overdue, a red banner shows above the totals, for example **3 overdue invoices — ₹41,300 outstanding**. The amount is what is still owed on them (less any TDS the client deducts); foreign-currency invoices are added after a +, never mixed with rupees.

- Click anywhere on the banner (or **View all →**) to set the Status filter to **Overdue**, so the list shows only those invoices. Set the filter back to **All Status**, or click ✕, to see everything again.
- Remind All opens the Send Payment Reminders window.

Each overdue row in the list has a light red background, and under its status it says how many days late it is, such as **12d overdue**.

**Something wrong?**
An invoice shows Overdue but the client has paid: record the payment with the ₹ button (see Recording a payment); it becomes Paid. An invoice is never overdue? Give it a **Due Date** on the invoice screen (see [Invoice Details](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#details)).

### Send Payment Reminders

Remind All on the red banner opens this window. It lists every overdue invoice on its own line: the client, the invoice number, the balance still owed in red (or **Overpaid ₹…** in blue if the client paid too much), and the client's phone number when one is saved.

- **Pick a client**Click Remind on their line.
- **WhatsApp opens**In a new tab, with the client's chat and a polite message already written, such as "Hi Sharma Traders, this is a gentle reminder that Invoice INV/0012 for ₹11,800 was due on 5/9/2026. Kindly arrange the payment at your earliest convenience. Thank you! - Your Business".
- **Send it**Check the message and press send in WhatsApp. Come back to the app tab and click Remind for the next client.

The message suits the situation: if part is paid, it asks for the **balance** and mentions the invoice total; if the due date has passed, it gives the due date. An invoice with nothing left to pay is not sent a reminder (you see "This invoice has no outstanding balance — no reminder to send"). Close closes the window.

The phone number comes from the invoice, or else from the saved client with the same name in [Clients](https://billing.reazix.com/help/clients.html#client-form). If there is none, WhatsApp opens without a contact and you choose the chat yourself.

**Something wrong?**
WhatsApp says the phone number is invalid? Save the client's phone with the country code, such as +91 98765 43210 or 919876543210. Nothing opens? Your browser blocked the new tab: allow pop-ups for the app (see [Print does nothing](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#print-blocked), step 1). On a computer, WhatsApp Web or WhatsApp Desktop must be logged in.

## The four totals

The four cards under the banner add up your sales. They cover only the business selected in the sidebar, and only **real sales**:

- Tax invoices, bills of supply and composition bills **count**.
- Credit notes are **subtracted** (money given back to clients).
- Quotations, proforma estimates and delivery challans are **left out**: they are not sales yet.
- Cancelled invoices are **left out**.

The totals are for **all years** together and do not follow the filters on the invoice list. For one month, quarter or year, use [Reports](https://billing.reazix.com/help/reports.html) or [GST Returns](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html). Sales in a foreign currency get a line of their own on each card (for example ₹4,25,000 and $1,200), never added to rupees. A card shows **—** when there are no sales yet.

### Total Invoiced

The grand total of your sales, **including GST**: the final amount printed on each invoice, added up, less credit notes. It is what you have billed, not what you have received.

When you bill in more than one currency, each currency has its own line, and a small line under them gives **≈ ₹ in all**: every invoice in rupees at its own exchange rate. Invoices without a rate are left out of that line and counted beside it.

### Tax Collected

The GST on those sales: CGST + SGST (or UTGST) on sales within your state, IGST on sales to other states, and cess, less the GST on credit notes. This is tax you collected for the government, not your income. Bills of supply and composition bills carry no GST, so they add nothing here. For what you actually have to pay after input tax credit (ITC, the GST you paid on purchases), see [GSTR-3B](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html#gstr-3b).

### Outstanding

What clients still owe you: for every sale not marked Paid, the invoice total less any TDS the client deducts (see [TDS and TCS](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#tds-tcs)), less what has been received. An overpaid invoice counts as zero here, not as a minus. Credit notes are not taken off this card. To see who owes what and for how long, use [Reports, Outstanding & Aging](https://billing.reazix.com/help/reports.html#outstanding) or a client's [account](https://billing.reazix.com/help/clients.html#ledger).

### Invoices

How many sales documents the totals are made of: tax invoices, bills of supply, composition bills and credit notes, not cancelled. It is usually smaller than the count beside the Dashboard title, which also counts quotations, challans and cancelled invoices.

**Something wrong?**
A total looks too high or too low? Check the business selected in the sidebar first. Then look for a quotation or challan that should have been converted to a tax invoice (they do not count until converted), or a wrong invoice that should be cancelled (see Cancelling an invoice).

## Low stock

If low-stock alerts are on in [Settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#stock) (they are on to start, with a limit of 5), every product whose stock is at or below your limit is listed in one line under **Low stock (n)**, where n is how many there are. Each shows the product name, its HSN code if it has one, and either **Out of Stock** in red (0 or less) or **Stock: 3** in amber.

When the list is wider than the screen, it scrolls past slowly like a news ticker; point at it with the mouse to stop it. A short list stays still. If your computer is set to reduce motion, it does not move and you scroll it sideways instead. Click any product to open [Products](https://billing.reazix.com/help/products.html) and restock it.

The strip disappears when no product is low, or when alerts are turned off. The limit is one number for all products; change it in Settings. How stock goes up and down is explained in [How stock is counted](https://billing.reazix.com/help/products.html#stock).

**Something wrong?**
A product shows Out of Stock but you have plenty? Its stock in Products was never set, or sales took it below zero. Open Products and correct the stock. Old invoices imported without "Take sold quantities out of product stock" do not touch stock.

## Finding an invoice

The **Invoices** card lists every document of the business, newest first. Above the list are the filters. They work together: for example "Overdue" and "FY 2026-27" shows only this year's overdue invoices.

| Filter | What it does |

| Search client or invoice... | Type part of a client's name or of an invoice number, such as sharma or 0012 . Capital letters do not matter. |

| All Years | Pick one financial year (1 April to 31 March). |

| All Types | Pick one document type: Tax Invoice, Quotation, Proforma / Estimate, Bill of Supply (No GST), Composition (Bill of Supply), Credit Note or Delivery Challan. |

| All Status | Unpaid, Partial, Paid, Overdue or Cancelled. See Status . |

| From / To | A range of invoice dates. Fill in one or both. |

| All cost centres | Only when [cost centres](https://billing.reazix.com/help/reports.html#cost-centres) are on: one branch, site or project, or **No cost centre** to find invoices not yet tagged. |

| ✕ | Shows once any filter is set. Clears all of them at once. |

| Columns | Choose which columns the list shows. See Choosing the columns . |

What you see on a row:

- A green **IRN** beside the invoice number: the invoice is registered on the e-invoice portal. Point at it to see the IRN.
- A yellow note icon beside the client: the invoice has a private note (never printed). Point at it to read it.
- A small currency code such as **USD** beside the amount: an invoice in a foreign currency.
- **Paid**: how much has been received so far, or — when nothing has.
- A light red row: overdue. A light blue row: ticked.

"No invoices yet." with a Create Invoice button means the business has none. "No invoices match your filters." means the filters hide them all: click ✕.

**Something wrong?**
An invoice you made is missing? Check the business selected in the sidebar, then clear the filters with ✕. Changing a filter also clears any ticks, so you never act on rows you cannot see.

## Choosing the columns

Columns at the right end of the filters opens **Pick columns to show**. Tick or untick:

| Column | Shows | To start |

| Date | The invoice date | Shown |

| Invoice # | The invoice number, with IRN when it has one | Shown |

| Type | Tax Invoice, Quotation and so on | Shown |

| Client | The client's name and the private-note icon | Shown |

| Amount | The invoice total | Shown |

| Currency | INR, USD and so on, in its own column | Hidden |

| Status | The status dropdown (see Status ) | Shown |

| Due date | The due date, or — | Hidden |

| Print count | How many times it was printed or downloaded, such as 2× | Hidden |

| Actions | The buttons for each invoice (see What you can do with an invoice ) | Shown |

The **Paid** column and the tick boxes are always shown. Your choice is remembered on this computer and browser. Click Columns again to close the list. On a narrow screen, hiding a few columns saves sideways scrolling.

## Status

Each sale is **Unpaid**, **Partial** (part paid), **Paid**, **Overdue** or **Cancelled**, shown in a coloured dropdown on its row. Recording payments sets it for you: nothing received is Unpaid, some is Partial, the full balance is Paid. Each time the Dashboard opens, unpaid and part-paid invoices past their due date become Overdue, and the row shows how many days late they are.

You can also change it yourself from the dropdown:

| Choose | What happens |

| Paid | Records a payment for the rest of the balance (mode Other, note "Marked paid", today's date), so your payment history, Receipts and reports stay complete. |

| Unpaid | Takes back the payment that marking it Paid recorded, so the Paid column clears and Send reminder comes back. Payments you recorded yourself stay: the invoice then shows Partial or Paid, with a message saying so. Delete a wrong payment under Payment History . |

| Partial, Overdue | Only the label changes. |

| Cancelled | Cancels it at once, without asking, and puts its stock back. See Cancelling an invoice . |

Only sales get paid, so only Tax Invoices, Bills of Supply and Composition bills have this dropdown. Quotations, proformas and delivery challans show **Open**, or **Converted** once turned into an invoice; credit notes show **Issued**. A cancelled one shows **Cancelled**; Undo cancel is with its actions.

## Recording a payment

When a client pays you, by UPI, bank transfer, cash or cheque, record it against the invoice. The status then changes for you, a receipt is made, and the payment appears in [Receipts](https://billing.reazix.com/help/receipts.html#receipt-list), the client's [account](https://billing.reazix.com/help/clients.html#ledger) and [Outstanding](https://billing.reazix.com/help/reports.html#outstanding).

- **Open it**Click the green ₹ button on the invoice's row. The **Record Payment** window opens. Its top line shows the invoice number, the **Total**, what is **Paid** so far, and the **Balance** (in red while something is owed, green when nothing is).
- **Amount Received**Type the amount received. The box shows the balance as a hint; for a full payment, type that amount.
- **Payment Date**Today to start. Change it if the money came on another day.
- **Payment Mode**Bank Transfer (to start), UPI, Cash, Cheque, Card or Other.
- **Note (optional)**The UTR or UPI transaction ID, the cheque number, or anything that helps you match it later.
- **Record it**Click Record Payment. You see "Payment of ₹… recorded", the status becomes Partial or Paid, and the payment receipt opens, ready to print.

Cancel, or a click outside the window, closes it without saving.

**TDS.** If the invoice already shows TDS (see [TDS and TCS](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#tds-tcs)), the balance here is already less that TDS, and paying that balance makes the invoice Paid. If the client deducted TDS the invoice does not show, record it here: see TDS when recording a payment.

**Overpayment.** If the amount is more than the balance, you are asked **Record as overpayment?**. Yes, record overpayment keeps the extra as the client's credit, to use on [their next invoice](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#client-credit). The window then shows **Overpaid** in blue instead of a balance.

**Cancelled invoice.** A cancelled invoice cannot take a payment: you see "This invoice is cancelled. Change its status back before recording a payment." Undo the cancel first. On a cancelled or converted document that already has payments, the ₹ button is called **Payment history** and opens the same window so you can see, reprint or fix them.

**Something wrong?**
"Enter a positive payment amount": the amount is empty, zero or not a number. A message "Reconciled 1 orphaned payment…" when the Dashboard opens means a receipt saved earlier had lost its link to the invoice; the app put the payment back on the invoice for you, and nothing else is needed. To record one payment that covers several invoices, record it on each invoice for its share.

### Payments from abroad

On an invoice billed in another currency (for example US dollars), the Record Payment window has an extra, optional box, **Received from abroad**:

| Box | What to type |

| Amount Received | The amount in the invoice's currency, as before (for example 1,000 USD). This is what marks the invoice paid. |

| Credited to your bank (₹) | The rupees that reached your account, from your bank statement. |

| Bank charges (₹) | What the banks took on the way, if anything. |

| FIRC / e-BRC number | The number on the Foreign Inward Remittance Certificate or e-BRC your bank issues. For an export of services it is the proof you were paid in foreign exchange; keep it with the invoice. |

The window shows the rate this works out to. The rupees and the FIRC number are saved with the payment and its receipt, and show in the payment history. They do not change the invoice or its GST figures, which stay at the invoice's own exchange rate.

The **Client deducted TDS** box is not offered for a client outside India: foreign clients do not deduct Indian TDS.

### TDS when recording a payment

A business client often pays less than the invoice because it kept back income-tax TDS (for example 10% of the value before GST for professional fees under 194J) and deposited it against your PAN. Record that TDS so the invoice shows Paid instead of Partial for ever.

On an Indian tax invoice, bill of supply or composition bill that does not already show TDS, the Record Payment window has a box **Client deducted TDS**:

- **Tick it**Tick **Client deducted TDS**. A section list and a rate box appear.
- **Section and rate**Pick the section the client used (it is on their payment advice or TDS certificate). The usual rate fills in; type another if needed. The line below shows the TDS amount and what the client now owes in all.
- **Amount Received**Type what actually reached your bank. Or leave it empty to record only the TDS, if you already recorded the payment.
- **Record it**Click Record Payment. The TDS is saved on the invoice (as if you had ticked TDS under Customize), so it is owed only its Net Receivable, and it appears in [Reports, TDS & TCS](https://billing.reazix.com/help/reports.html#tds-by-clients) for checking against your Form 26AS.

**Example.** Invoice ₹1,18,000 (₹1,00,000 + 18% GST). The client pays ₹1,08,000 and deducts ₹10,000 TDS under 194J. Tick **Client deducted TDS**, pick 194J at 10%, type 1,08,000 and record it: the invoice is Paid.

To change or remove the TDS later, open the invoice and change TDS under Customize.

The TDS you record here stays as recorded. Opening the invoice later and saving it again no longer works it out afresh (for 194Q the ₹50 lakh threshold could turn it into zero). If you change the TDS section or rate on the invoice, it is worked out again from the new rate.

### Payment History

Once an invoice has payments, the Record Payment window lists them under **Payment History**: date, amount, mode and note. Each line has three buttons:

| Button | What it does |

| Receipt | Opens the payment receipt for that payment, to view or print it again. |

| Pencil | Opens Edit Payment to correct the amount, date, mode or note. |

| Bin (red) | Deletes the payment after asking **Delete this payment?**. Its receipt is removed from Receipts too. |

After any change the paid amount and the status are worked out again: deleting the only payment makes the invoice Unpaid again (or Overdue the next time the Dashboard opens, if the due date has passed).

### Edit Payment

The pencil on a payment opens **Edit Payment**, showing the invoice number and total. Change the **Amount**, **Date**, **Mode** or **Note / reference** and click Save changes; Cancel or ✕ closes it without saving. Use it to fix a typing mistake instead of deleting and recording again.

If the new amount takes the total received above the invoice total, you are asked **Save as overpayment?** first. The receipt in Receipts is updated to match, and keeps its receipt number. A payment made by choosing Paid from the status dropdown becomes an ordinary payment once you edit it, so choosing Unpaid later no longer removes it.

## The payment receipt

A receipt is the paper you give a client to say you have received their money. It opens by itself after Record Payment, and again from Receipt under Payment History. It shows:

- Your business name, address, GSTIN, phone and email, as saved on the invoice.
- **PAYMENT RECEIPT**, with the **Receipt No.** (such as RCPT-LZ8K2M4A), **Payment Date**, **Against Invoice**, **Payment Mode** and the **Ref / Note** if you gave one.
- "Received with thanks from" the client's name, address and phone.
- The **Amount Received**, and for rupees the amount in words.
- The **Invoice Total**, **Total Paid** so far, and the **Balance** still owed (or **Overpaid** by how much).
- Lines for the customer's signature and yours, and when it was recorded.

Print Receipt prints only the receipt, on A5 paper (half of A4); in the print window choose your printer, or **Save as PDF** to send it on WhatsApp or email. Close closes it. Every receipt is also listed on the [Receipts](https://billing.reazix.com/help/receipts.html#receipt-list) screen.

## What you can do with an invoice

The row shows the actions you use most as buttons. The rest are in the ⋯ menu at the end of the row; it closes with Esc or a click elsewhere, and the arrow keys move through it.

| Action | What it does |

| 👁 View | Shows the invoice exactly as it prints, without opening the editor. See The print preview . |

| Edit (pencil) | Opens it on the invoice screen to change it. See [Making an invoice](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html). |

| Undo cancel (curved arrow) | Only on a cancelled invoice. See Cancelling an invoice . |

| ₹ Payment | Record a payment. See Recording a payment . |

| Convert to Tax Invoice | Quotations, proformas and delivery challans only, until they have been converted. See [Turning a quote into an invoice](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#proforma-to-invoice). |

| ⋯ Duplicate | A new invoice with the same client and items, a new number and today's date. It starts Unpaid, with no payments. Handy for a client you bill the same things every month. |

| ⋯ Print | Prints the invoice straight away: it opens for a moment, the print window appears, the print count goes up by one, and you are back on the Dashboard. |

| ⋯ WhatsApp | Sends the invoice to the client. See Sending an invoice by WhatsApp or email . |

| ⋯ Send reminder | Shown only on tax invoices, bills of supply and composition bills while money is still owed (never on quotations, proformas, challans or credit notes). Opens WhatsApp with a payment reminder suited to the situation, as in Send Payment Reminders . On a part-paid invoice it is called **Reminder (partial pending)** and asks for the balance. |

| ⋯ Email | Opens your email program with the invoice details. See Sending an invoice by WhatsApp or email . |

| ⋯ Cancel invoice | See Cancelling an invoice . |

A cancelled invoice keeps only View, Duplicate and Undo cancel. A quotation, proforma or challan already converted keeps only View and Duplicate, so it cannot be changed or converted twice. Opened, either one is read-only: you can download or print it, not change it. Payments they already have stay viewable from the ₹ button.

**Something wrong?**
"No editable data saved for this invoice" on Edit: the invoice came from a very old version and holds only its totals, so it cannot be opened on the invoice screen. Print does nothing: see [Print does nothing, or "Print failed"](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#print-blocked).

## The print preview

The **Print preview** window shows an invoice exactly as it will print, on the paper size chosen for it, with the same design, logo, QR code and totals. A cancelled invoice shows **CANCELLED** across it, and an invoice with an IRN shows the IRN and QR code. It opens in three places:

- From the 👁 **View** button on a Dashboard row, for any invoice, to check it without opening the editor.
- From Full view in the Live preview bar while you make or edit an invoice, on any paper size. See [The live preview](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#preview).
- From Print on the invoice screen when the invoice is on a **receipt (thermal) paper** size.
