- **D — Tax Computation**: taxable income, slab tax, rebate, surcharge, cess, total tax.
- **E — Advance Tax**: each instalment and what you paid, when advance tax applies.

The PDF uses the recommended regime, and your PDF accent colour from Print Settings when custom colours are on. It is saved to your Downloads folder as ITR-4-Summary-YourBusiness-2026-27.pdf.

**Can you file ITR-4?**ITR-4 is for resident individuals, HUFs and firms (not LLPs) with total income up to ₹50 lakh, using presumptive taxation. With most capital gains (anything beyond long-term gains on listed shares of up to ₹1.25 lakh), income above ₹50 lakh, or regular books instead of presumptive income, you need ITR-2, ITR-3 or another form: use the PDF as a worksheet for your CA. Check every figure against Form 26AS and AIS before filing.

**Something wrong?****"Could not generate PDF"**: press Ctrl + F5 and try again. The PAN line is empty: add your PAN to the business in Settings. Business income in the PDF differs from the tax: the PDF takes the Presumptive tab's figure when that tab has one, while the tax comes from the calculator; click Use ₹... as Business Income on the Presumptive tab so both match.

### Not included yet

The last card lists what the helper does not do, so you know what to get elsewhere: reading Form 16, a capital-gains module with broker imports, a house-property module for several properties, ITR-1, ITR-2 and ITR-3, the ITR JSON file the portal uploads, and Form 26AS reconciliation. File the return itself on incometax.gov.in or through your CA.

---

# Settings

URL: https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html

Every tab of Settings, card by card, in the order the tabs appear: Business type, Company, Profiles, Terms, Print & PDF, Features, Stock, Region, App lock, Backups, Google Drive, Import/Export and Updates. Each card in the app has a ? next to its title that opens the matching part of this page.

## Settings tabs and the Save all changes bar

Open Settings from the sidebar. Settings is split into **tabs**, a row of buttons at the top of the page: Business type, Company, Profiles, Terms, Print & PDF, Features, Stock, Region, App lock, Privacy & internet, Backups, Google Drive, Import/Export and Updates. Click one to show that tab. The tab you are on is filled in blue. On a phone or a small screen the buttons wrap onto two or three lines; nothing is hidden.

The app remembers the tab you had open until you close the browser tab, so coming back to Settings opens the same tab.

**The ? buttons.** The ? at the top right of Settings opens the help for the tab you are on. Every card inside a tab also has its own small ? next to its title, which opens the help for just that card, here or on the [Print and PDF](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html) and [Backups](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html) pages. They open in your web browser and need internet.

### The Save all changes bar

One bar is fixed to the bottom of the screen on every tab. It shows one of two things:

- **✓ All changes saved**, in grey: nothing is waiting to be saved.
- **● Unsaved changes in …**, in amber, with the names of the cards you changed, for example Unsaved changes in Company Details, Low-stock alerts. Two buttons appear: Discard throws away every unsaved change and puts the cards back as they were saved, and Save all changes saves them all in one click.

You can change things on several tabs and save once at the end: switching tabs never loses what you typed.

### What waits for a save, and what saves by itself

| Saves the moment you change it | Waits for Save all changes (or its own button) |

| Payment accounts (add, edit, delete, default, order, on or off), Business Profiles (Switch, Delete, Save as Profile), quick-start Terms templates, Print & PDF, Region, App lock, the backup folder, Cost centres | Company Details, GSTR filing details, PAN, logo, signature, stamp and Google Drive fields (own button: Save Profile ); Invoice Number Format ( Save Number Format ); Low-stock alerts ( Save ); a Terms template you are writing ( Save Template ); Business type and Features (no button of their own) |

### Something wrong?

- **The bar still says unsaved after I saved**: one card may have refused to save. Look for a message at the top of the screen (for example an invoice number that is too long) and fix what it says, then click Save all changes again.
- **The Company form is greyed out**: it stays locked for a moment while your saved details load, so nothing you type is lost. Wait a second; on a slow computer it can take a few seconds.
- **I closed the app without saving**: unsaved changes are lost. Saved ones are on your computer and come back next time.

## Business type

The first tab. Pick what kind of business you run, and the app shows the screens and features that business needs and hides the rest, so the menu stays short. Use it when you first set the app up, or when the menu shows things you never use.

The card shows **Your business type:** with the type that is saved now, or **Not chosen yet**.

- **Pick a type**Click one of the seven cards. Each says in one line who it is for.
- **Check what will change**A yellow box, **Not saved yet**, lists what will be turned on (Turn on: …) and turned off (Turn off: …). The tick boxes on the Features tab are filled in to match.
- **Save**Click Save all changes at the bottom. The message Features saved. The menu now shows your choices. appears and the sidebar changes. Discard instead puts everything back.

**Nothing is ever deleted.** A business type only changes what you see. Your invoices, products and purchases stay, and come back the moment the feature is shown again. You can switch any single feature back on in Features.

| Business type | Hidden (everything else is shown) |

| Retail shop / kirana | Recurring, TDS / TCS, E-way bill, E-invoicing, Purchase orders, Manufacturing, Cost centres |

| Freelancer / consultant | Products, Purchases, E-way bill, E-invoicing, Purchase orders, GSTR-2B matching, Manufacturing, Cost centres |

| Restaurant / cafe | Recurring, TDS / TCS, E-way bill, E-invoicing, Purchase orders, GSTR-2B matching, Manufacturing, Cost centres |

| Wholesale / trading | Recurring, E-invoicing, Manufacturing, Cost centres |

| Manufacturing | Recurring, E-invoicing |

| Service / repair shop | TDS / TCS, E-way bill, E-invoicing, Purchase orders, GSTR-2B matching, Manufacturing, Cost centres |

| Everything | Nothing: every feature is shown |

Every type keeps Dashboard, New invoice, Clients, Settings, Help & Support, User guide, Notifications, Dark mode and Control Panel. E-invoicing is only for businesses with a yearly turnover above ₹5 crore, so only **Everything** turns it on; tick it in Features if you need it.

The choice is kept on this computer and is the same for every business you run in the app. It is not the same as the **Business type** on the [Print & PDF](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html#business-type) tab, which only changes how invoices look.

### Something wrong?

- **A screen I use has gone from the menu**: open the Features tab, tick it, and click Save all changes.
- **I picked a type but nothing changed**: you have not saved yet. The bottom bar shows Unsaved changes in Business type; click Save all changes.
- **It says Not chosen yet**: you used the app before this tab existed. Your switches stay exactly as they are until you pick a type and save.

Choosing **Freelancer / consultant** also sets how new invoices start: in **Services** mode, without the unit next to the quantity, and due in 15 days. Invoices you already made are not changed, and you can change any of it on the invoice.

## Company Details

The first card on the Company tab: your business name and address, printed at the top of every invoice. Fill it in once when you start. Change it if you move, get a GSTIN, or change your phone number.

| Field | What to put |

| Business Name * | Your shop or company name, as it should print. The only field you must fill. |

| Country | India for most users. The list follows your Region . Changing the country changes the names of the fields below (for example VAT number instead of GSTIN). |

| Address | Street, building and area. Two lines are enough. |

| City, PIN Code | Your town and 6-digit PIN code. |

| State | **The one to get right.** GST depends on it: a sale inside your state is charged CGST + SGST, a sale to another state IGST. Pick it from the list. |

| GSTIN | Your 15-character GST number, such as 22AAAAA0000A1Z5 . Leave it blank if you are not registered. When you click out of the box, the app checks the pattern and shows GSTIN format looks unusual in orange if a character looks wrong. It is only a warning; you can still save. |

| Email, Phone | Printed on the invoice so clients can reach you. |

Below these come the GSTR filing details (Indian businesses only), Payment Accounts, Invoice Number Format and Branding.

- **Type your details**Fill in the fields. The bottom bar turns amber: Unsaved changes in Company Details.
- **Save**Click Save Profile at the bottom of the Company tab, or Save all changes in the bar. The message Profile saved! appears.

The next invoice you make uses the new details. Invoices already saved keep the details they were made with.

### Something wrong?

- **GST is split wrongly (IGST instead of CGST + SGST, or the other way)**: your State is wrong or empty. Pick the right one and save. If it is empty, the invoice screen warns you once rather than guess.
- **The GSTIN warning will not go away**: check for the letter O typed instead of the digit 0, or a missing character. A GSTIN has 15 characters.
- **My new address is not on an old invoice**: that is on purpose. Saved invoices never change. Open the invoice and save it again if you need the new details on it.

## GSTR filing details

A grey box inside Company Details, shown only when the country is India. It is used for one thing: the [GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B JSON files](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html#json-checks) you upload to the GST portal.

| Field | What it does |

| Aggregate turnover (AATO) is above ₹5 crore | Tick it if your total sales last year, for all your GSTINs together on one PAN, were more than ₹5 crore. The line below then says **6-digit HSN**: every item needs an HSN code of at least 6 digits. Unticked, 4 digits are enough. The GST portal refuses a GSTR-1 where an HSN is too short. |

Save with Save Profile or Save all changes. (Older versions also asked for last year's and this year's turnover. The GSTR-1 file no longer carries them: those fields were only for 2017-18 returns.)

### Something wrong?

- **GSTR-1 upload fails on HSN length**: check whether the tick box matches your turnover, then lengthen the HSN codes on your [products](https://billing.reazix.com/help/products.html).
- **I do not see this box**: the country in Company Details is not India.

## LUT for exports and SEZ supplies

A second grey box inside Company Details, shown only when the country is India. Fill it in if you export, or sell to units in a Special Economic Zone (SEZ), **without charging IGST**.

**What a LUT is.** A Letter of Undertaking (form **GST RFD-11**) is a promise to the GST department that you will follow the export rules. With a LUT, exports and SEZ supplies are billed without IGST (they are "zero-rated"), so you do not pay the tax and then wait months for a refund. Without one, you must charge IGST and claim it back. It is free, filed online in a few minutes, and valid for **one financial year**: file a fresh one every April, before your first export of the year. How to file it, step by step: [GST basics: LUT](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-basics.html#lut).

| Field | What to put in |

| LUT ARN (acknowledgement number) | The ARN the GST portal gave you when you filed the LUT, such as AD290426123456X : usually 15 letters and digits starting with AD. Spaces are removed and letters made capital for you. If it does not look like an ARN, an amber note asks you to check it, but it is still saved. |

| Financial year it covers | The year you chose on the portal under **LUT Applied for Financial Year**, such as FY 2026-27. |

| Date filed (optional) | The date on the acknowledgement, for your records. |

Save with Save Profile or Save all changes. Each business in Business Profiles has its own LUT, because a LUT belongs to one GSTIN.

**What it does.** On a new invoice for a client abroad or an SEZ client, dated in that financial year, **Export under LUT (no IGST)** is ticked for you: no IGST is charged and the invoice prints the Rule 46 declaration with your ARN. See [Exports and SEZ supplies under a LUT](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#lut).

**Something wrong?**"This LUT is for FY 2025-26; today is in FY 2026-27": your LUT has run out. File a new one on the portal, then type its ARN and choose the new year here. Older invoices keep the ARN they were made with. I do not see this box: the country in Company Details is not India.

## Payment Accounts: bank and UPI

The bank accounts and UPI IDs your clients pay into. The default one prints in the bank details block of every new invoice; with a UPI ID, rupee invoices also carry a QR code the client scans to pay the exact amount. Add every account you use: you pick which one goes on each invoice.

- **Add the first account**Click + Add account. A form opens; see Add account for each field.
- **Save the account**Click Save account. The account appears in the list. The first account is marked ⭐, the default.
- **Add more if you have them**Each one you add is listed under the first.

Accounts save themselves straight away: you do not need Save Profile for them.

Each account in the list shows its name, bank, the last digits of the account number, IFSC and UPI ID, with these buttons on the right:

| Button | What it does |

| ⭐ | Makes this the default account, used on every new invoice. Only shown on accounts that are not the default. |

| ↑ ↓ | Moves the account up or down the list. The order is the order in the account picker on the invoice. |

| ∅ / ✓ | Switches the account off (it turns pale and says **Inactive**) or back on. Switched-off accounts are not offered on new invoices. |

| Pencil | Opens the account to edit it. |

| Bin | Deletes the account after asking. Invoices already made with it keep the bank details they were saved with. |

To use a different account on one invoice, pick it under [Customize](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoice-options.html#tds-tcs-account) on the invoice screen.

**PAN Number (business-level)** sits below the list, for Indian businesses. It is your 10-character PAN, such as AAAAA1234A, and prints in the bank details block. Unlike the accounts, it needs Save Profile or Save all changes.

If you entered bank details in an older version, a yellow box says **Your existing bank details are still on this profile**. Click Import & continue → to turn them into your first account.

### Something wrong?

- **No QR code on the invoice**: the account used on that invoice has no UPI ID, the invoice is not in rupees, or **UPI QR code** is switched off in Features.
- **The wrong bank prints**: make the right account the default (⭐), or pick it under Customize on that invoice.
- **Clients get "beneficiary name mismatch" on NEFT or RTGS**: fill in **Account Holder Name** exactly as the bank has it.

### Add account and Edit account

The form that opens from + Add account or the pencil on an account.

| Field | What to put |

| Label (shown in the dropdown) | Your own name for the account, such as HDFC Current — 1234 . Only you see it, in the account picker. |

| Account Holder Name | The name the bank has on the account. Leave it blank to use your business name. Fill it in when they differ, for example a proprietor's own name. |

| Bank Name | Such as State Bank of India. |

| Account Type | Optional: Savings, Current, Cash Credit (CC), Overdraft (OD), NRE or NRO. |

| Account Number | The full number. The list shows only the last digits. Outside India it also takes an IBAN. |

| IFSC Code | The 11-character branch code on your cheque book, such as SBIN0001234 . Outside India this is the local bank code (Sort Code, Routing Number, IBAN…). |

| SWIFT / BIC (optional) | Only for payments from abroad, such as HDFCINBB . |

| UPI ID (optional — drives the QR for this account) | Such as yourbusiness@hdfcbank or 9876543210@paytm . If it does not look like a UPI ID (it needs an @), an orange warning appears when you click out of the box. |

| Internal notes (not printed on the PDF) | A reminder for yourself, such as Use for export clients only . |

| ⭐ Set as default account | Tick to use this account on every new invoice. Only one account can be the default. |

Click Save account to keep it, or Cancel to close without changes. The message Account added or Account updated appears.

### Getting paid from abroad

Two optional boxes in a payment account help clients outside India pay you:

- **SWIFT / BIC**: the code a foreign bank needs to send money to your bank. Ask your bank for it; it is printed with the bank details.
- **IBAN**: Indian banks do not use IBANs. Fill this only if you have an account abroad that has one (for example a Wise or Payoneer euro account). It prints under SWIFT.
- **Purpose code**: the RBI code for what the money is for. The bank asks for it on every payment from abroad: the client's bank when sending, or your bank when it credits you and issues the FIRC / e-BRC. Pick from the list or type your own, for example P0802 software consultancy, P0807 off-site software exports, P1006 business and management consultancy, P1007 advertising and market research, P1101 audio-visual work, or P1099 other services. It prints with the bank details on invoices to clients abroad or in a foreign currency, so the client can quote it on the transfer. One invoice can use another code: type it in **Purpose code (RBI)** on the invoice. Your bank decides which code is right, so check with them once.
- **Online payment link**: a PayPal.me, Wise or Payoneer link. It prints as **PAY ONLINE** on invoices in a foreign currency, in place of the UPI QR code (UPI only takes rupees). It does not print on rupee invoices.

Money for an export of services should come in convertible foreign exchange (or in rupees where the RBI allows it). Ask your bank for the FIRC or e-BRC for each payment and note its number when you [record the payment](https://billing.reazix.com/help/dashboard.html#payment-foreign).

## Invoice Number Format

How your invoice numbers look, and where they start. Set it before your first real invoice. You can change it later; numbers already given never change.

The box at the top, **Next tax invoice:**, shows exactly the number your next tax invoice will get, and changes as you change the settings below. With a brand prefix it also shows the next quotation, delivery challan and credit note.

### Format Style

| Button | Looks like | When to use it |

| Branded Sequential | INV/2026-27/0001 | The default. Numbers start again each financial year. |

| Simple Sequential | INV/0001 | One running number, no year. |

| Random | INV/A3X9K2 | Numbers nobody can guess. Not in order, so most shops do not use it. |

### Start numbering from

For tax invoices. If you used a paper bill book up to 1000, type **1001**: the next tax invoice is .../1001, then 1002 and so on. When you save, the app asks **Start tax invoices from 1001?** because numbers never go back down; skipped numbers cannot be used later. If you have already gone past the number, numbering simply continues; a number already used is never given again. Quotations, challans, credit notes and receipts keep their own count. Hidden for Random.

- **Pick a style**Click Branded Sequential, Simple Sequential or Random.
- **Set the first number**Type it in **Start numbering from**, or leave 1.
- **Change the details if you like**Open ⚙ Customize prefix, separator & padding: see below.
- **Check the preview, then save**Click Save Number Format (or Save all changes). The message Invoice number settings saved! appears.

**16 characters at most**
GST allows invoice and credit note numbers of up to 16 characters (letters, digits, - and /), and GSTR-1 refuses longer ones. If the prefix, year and number together would be longer, a red line under the preview says so and the format will not save. Use a shorter prefix, the short year, or fewer digits.

Each document type keeps its own count, and a type can have its own prefix in [Print & PDF, Custom prefix per invoice type](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html#prefixes).

### Something wrong?

- **The red line says the number is too long**: shorten the Brand Prefix, choose the short year (26-27), or fewer padding digits.
- **I typed 10001 instead of 1001**: choose No when the app asks to confirm. Once saved, numbers cannot go back down.
- **Changing one business changed another's numbers**: they share numbering. Give the business its own numbering.

### Shared numbering or own numbering for this business

Shown under Numbering for your business when you have more than one business in Business Profiles. Every business uses **Shared numbering** to start: one series for all of them. The line below names who shares it, such as Shared by Firm 1, Firm 2; saving a change then asks **Change numbering for all 2 businesses?**

To keep one business's numbers separate:

- **Select the business**Pick it at the top of the sidebar.
- **Choose own numbering**Click Own numbering for this business.
- **Give it a prefix**Type a **Prefix for this business**, such as its initials KS. It is required and must differ from every other business's, because two invoices can never share a number.
- **Save**Set **Start numbering from** if you like, then click Save Number Format.

Its invoices then run KS/26-27/0502, 0503… whatever the other businesses do. It starts with the short year, so its credit notes, KS-CN/26-27/0001, fit the 16 characters. Its receipts follow its numbering too, and it keeps its numbering when you change its name or add its GSTIN. Shared numbering puts it back on the shared series after asking; invoices it already made keep their numbers.

### Customize prefix, separator & padding

Click ⚙ Customize prefix, separator & padding under the format to open it. The defaults are fine for most businesses.

| Setting | What it does |

| Brand Prefix | Up to 10 capital letters and digits, such as ACME . Tax invoices print it alone ( ACME/2026-27/0001 ); every other document adds its type ( ACME-QUO/… , ACME-DC/… , ACME-CN/… ). Leave it empty to use each type's own prefix: INV, QUO, EST, BOS, COMP, CN and DC. With own numbering, the business's prefix is set above instead. |

| Separator | The mark between the parts: / , - or # . |

| Include Financial Year | **Yes** ( 2026-27 ), **Short** ( 26-27 ) or **No**. Not shown for Random. |

| Number Padding | How many digits: 3 ( 001 ), 4 ( 0001 ), 5 or 6. Not shown for Random. |

## Branding: logo, signature and stamp

The last card on the Company tab. Your logo prints at the top of the invoice, and your signature and company stamp (seal) at the bottom, above the signatory line.

- **Upload**Click Upload Logo, Upload Signature or Upload Stamp and pick a picture from your computer: PNG or JPG, up to 5 MB. The message says Logo uploaded — click Save Profile to keep it.
- **Set the size**Drag the slider under the picture between S and L. Logo 24 to 80 pixels high (48 to start), signature 30 to 110 (60), stamp 30 to 120 (70).
- **Save**Click Save Profile or Save all changes. Until you save, the pictures are not kept.

Change Logo, Change Signature and Change Stamp pick a new picture; the red bin on a picture removes it (save to keep the change). Saving a logo or signature also ticks **Show logo** and **Show signature** for new invoices.

**Tips for good pictures.** Large photos are made smaller for you (to 1024 pixels on the longer side). For the signature and stamp, a PNG with a transparent background looks best, so the paper shows through; sign on white paper, photograph it in good light, and crop it close. A logo photo (PNG or JPG) is saved with a white background, so it prints cleanly on any printer.

On a long invoice the signature and stamp always move to the next page together, never split.

**Your name and logo in the menu.** Tick **Show my business name and logo in the app's menu** under the logo, then save: the top of the menu shows your logo (or your first letter) and business name instead of "GST Billing". With several businesses, it shows the one that is open. "by Reazix" stays under it. New installs ask this during the first setup.

### Something wrong?

- **"Could not decode this image"**: often an iPhone photo in HEIC format. Share it as JPEG first, or set the iPhone camera to Most Compatible.
- **"over the 5MB cap"**: make the picture smaller first, for example with a free online compressor.
- **The logo is not on the invoice**: check you clicked Save Profile, and that **Show logo** is ticked under Customize on the invoice.

### Signature and stamp layout

Appears under the stamp once both a signature and a stamp are uploaded. It decides where the stamp goes:

- **Side by side**: the signature and stamp next to each other. The default.
- **Stamp above the signature**: the stamp on top, the signature under it.
- **Stamp on the signature**: the stamp printed over the signature, as a real rubber stamp often is.

The white **Preview** box below shows the result at the sizes you set. Save with Save Profile or Save all changes.

## Business Profiles

The Profiles tab. If you run more than one business, or more than one GSTIN, save each one as a profile and switch between them. Each profile keeps its own name, address, GSTIN, bank accounts, logo, signature and stamp.

Each saved profile is a card with its name, state and GSTIN, and its address. The one in use has a blue border and an **Active** badge.

| Button | What it does |

| + Add New Profile | Saves the business now on the Company tab into the list first (so it is never lost), then opens the Company tab with an empty form for the new business. |

| Save as Profile | Saves the Company tab as it is into the list, or updates that business's card if it is already there. |

| Switch | Makes that business the active one. The current one is saved first. Every screen then shows the new business. The active card shows Current instead. |

| Bin | Removes the profile from the list after asking. Its invoices stay. |

### Adding a second business

- **Save the first**Make sure the first business's Company details are filled in and saved.
- **Start the new one**On the Profiles tab, click + Add New Profile. The message says the first business is safe under the Profiles tab, and the Company tab opens empty.
- **Fill it in**Type the new business's details, accounts, logo and so on.
- **Save it**Click Save Profile, then Save as Profile on the Profiles tab. Both businesses are now in the list.

You can also change business from the name at the top of the sidebar.

### Something wrong?

- **No saved profiles yet**: fill in Company Details and click Save as Profile.
- **Two cards for the same business**: delete the older one with the bin. Invoices are not affected.
- **The invoice numbers of two businesses run together**: give one its own numbering.

### More than one business: separate books

Each business has its **own books**. Invoices, totals, purchases, expenses, receipts, recurring invoices, reports and GST returns all follow the business selected at the top of the sidebar. Manage profiles… there opens the Profiles tab.

Your client list is shared by all businesses. Records made before you had several businesses show under all of them until you [assign them](https://billing.reazix.com/help/purchases.html#unassigned).

## Terms & Conditions Templates

The Terms tab. The terms you print at the bottom of invoices, such as payment due dates, interest on late payment and returns, kept as templates so you pick one instead of typing it each time. On a new invoice your first template is loaded for you; see [Terms and notes on an invoice](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#terms-notes).

### Quick Start

Under **Quick Start — Pick a template for your business**, one click adds a ready-made set of Indian terms: **Services (IT, Consulting, Freelance)**, **Goods & Products (Retail, Wholesale)**, **Manufacturing & Trading**, **Export / International** or **Freelancer (Simple)**. It is saved straight away; clicking the same one again says You already have this template. Edit it afterwards to put in your own city, days and rates.

### Your own template

- **Start**Click + New Template.
- **Name it**Type a **Template Name**, such as Standard Terms or Export Terms. A name is required.
- **Write or paste the terms**Into **Content (paste your terms here)**. One point per line reads best.
- **Save**Click Save Template (or Save all changes). Cancel closes without saving.

Each saved template is listed with its text. The pencil edits it; the bin deletes it after asking. Deleting or changing a template never changes invoices that already used it.

### Something wrong?

- **The terms run onto a second page**: turn on [Print T&C on a separate page](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html#terms-page), or shorten them.
- **A different template loads on new invoices**: the first one in the list is used. Pick another on the invoice with **Load saved template**.

## Print & PDF

The Print & PDF tab sets the look of every printed invoice and PDF: designs, thermal receipts, watermarks, copies, colours, languages and formats. It has its own page with a section for each card: [Print and PDF settings](https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html).

## Features

The Features tab: what shows in the menu and on the screens, and in what order. Turn off what you never use to keep the app simple, or turn on extras such as Purchase orders or E-invoicing.

- **Tick and untick**Tick what you want to see and untick what you do not. A yellow box, **Not saved yet**, lists what will be turned on and off.
- **Save**Click Save all changes at the bottom. Only then does the menu change. Discard undoes your ticks.

Unticked things disappear from the menu and the screens. **Nothing is deleted**: your data is kept, and ticking it again brings it all back. Each switch has a line saying what it does.

Reset to my business type, at the top right, sets every switch back to what your business type gives; save to apply it. Before a business type is chosen, the button is Reset to default.

When **Cost centres** is on, a **Cost centres** card appears under Features on this tab, to add your branches, sites or projects: see [Cost centres](https://billing.reazix.com/help/reports.html#cost-centres).

### Something wrong?

- **I ticked it but it is not in the menu**: click Save all changes.
- **Recurring invoices still arrive after I hid Recurring**: hiding a screen does not stop recurring invoices being made, and the switch says so. Pause them on the Recurring screen.
- **A switch is missing**: India-only switches (TDS / TCS, E-way bill, E-invoicing, UPI QR code, GSTR-2B matching) are not listed when Region is International.

### Menu: show, hide and reorder

The **Menu** part lists every item of the sidebar in two boxes, **Top of the menu** and **Bottom of the menu**, in the order they appear, and a third box, **Buttons at the top right**, for the User Guide, Notifications, Lock and Dark mode buttons.

- The tick box shows or hides the item.
- The ▲ and ▼ arrows on the left move the item up or down. Default order, shown once you have moved something, puts the menu back in the usual order.
- **Dashboard**, **New invoice**, **Clients**, **Settings**, **Help & Support** and **Lock app** (shown only when a PIN is set) say **(always shown)** and have no tick box. You can still move them.

Quick search (Ctrl + K) leaves out anything hidden. Save with Save all changes.

### Features inside screens

Switches for parts of a screen, grouped by the screen they appear on:

| Screen | Switch | What it shows |

| Invoice screen | TDS / TCS | Tax deducted or collected at source on an invoice. See [TDS and TCS](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#tds-tcs). |

| E-way bill | The button to download the e-way bill file for goods you send. |

| E-invoicing (IRN) | Only if your yearly turnover is above ₹5 crore. **Off** to start. See [E-invoicing](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html#e-invoice). |

| UPI QR code | The scan-to-pay QR code on invoices. |

| Purchases screen | Purchase orders | Orders to suppliers, turned into bills when goods arrive. **Off** to start. See [Purchase orders](https://billing.reazix.com/help/purchases.html#purchase-orders). |

| GSTR-2B matching | Matching your purchase bills with GSTR-2B, a tab on GST returns. |

| Products screen | Manufacturing (bill of materials) | What goes into a product, and Make to move the stock. **Off** to start. See [Manufacturing](https://billing.reazix.com/help/products.html#manufacturing). |

| Reports screen | Cost centres | Tag bills, purchases and expenses with a branch, site or project, and see profit for each. **Off** to start. |

| Integrations | Google Drive | Saving invoice PDFs and backups to your Google Drive. |

## Low-stock alerts

The Stock tab. Warns you when a product is running out, so you reorder in time. It powers the 🔔 bell at the top right and the low-stock list on the Dashboard, and the Products screen colours a product amber when it is at or below the number you set.

- **Turn it on or off****Show low-stock alerts** is ticked to start.
- **Pick the threshold**Click a chip: **0** (only when fully out), **3** (very tight), **5** (recommended) or **10** (loose), or type any number from 0 in the box. The line above says Alert when stock ≤ 5.
- **Save**Click Save on the card, or Save all changes. The message Low-stock alert settings saved appears.

It is one threshold for every product. With alerts off, stock is still counted; you are just not warned.

### Something wrong?

- **No alerts at all**: check the box is ticked and saved, and that your products have a stock quantity.
- **Too many alerts**: pick a lower threshold, such as 3 or 0.

## Region Preference

The Region tab. Choose whether you bill only in India, only abroad, or both. It changes the country lists and which features you see. Your data is not touched, and you can change it any time.

| Button | What you get |

| 🇮🇳 India only | GST, rupees first, GSTR-1 and 3B, e-way bill, UPI QR code. |

| 🌍 International | VAT and other tax names, several currencies, no India-only features or switches. |

| 🌐 Both / Auto | All countries, chosen on each invoice. The default. |

Click one: it saves straight away, with the message Region preference: …. No Save button is needed.

Region, Print & PDF and your other display choices are also kept in the app's data folder, so they come back even if the browser clears its saved data.

### Something wrong?

- **My country is missing from Company Details**: choose 🌐 Both / Auto.
- **GST features disappeared**: Region is International. Choose 🇮🇳 India only or 🌐 Both / Auto.

## App lock (PIN)

The App lock tab. For a computer other people also use: the app asks for a 6 or 8 digit PIN each time it opens. It is off to start. The card says whether it is on.

### Turning it on

- **Start**Click Turn on PIN lock.
- **Choose the length**Under **Digits**, pick 6 or 8.
- **Type the PIN twice**In **New PIN** and **New PIN again**. Only digits are accepted.
- **Save**Click Save PIN. The message PIN saved. It is asked each time the app opens. appears. This browser tab stays unlocked; other tabs and the next start ask for it.

### When it is on

- Lock now locks the app straight away, when you step away. So do Lock on the Dashboard, the padlock at the top right and Ctrl + Shift + L anywhere. Anything you were typing is still there after you unlock.
- Change PIN and Turn off ask for the **Current PIN** first. Cancel closes the form.
- After five wrong tries in a row, wait 30 seconds before the next.

It locks the screen only; it does not encrypt your files. Keep your backups safe as before. Backup files never contain the PIN, and restoring a backup keeps the PIN you have now.

### Something wrong?

- **"The two PINs do not match"** or **"The PIN must be 6 digits"**: type the same PIN, of the length you chose, in both boxes.
- **"Current PIN is wrong"**: check Caps Lock is not the problem (PINs are digits only) and try again; after five tries, wait 30 seconds.
- **Forgot the PIN?** Open the Reazix-Billing folder (where you start the app), make a new empty file there named RESET-PIN, and reload the app. The PIN is removed and the file deleted. Your invoices are not touched.

## Privacy & internet

The Privacy & internet tab says, in one table, everything the app uses the internet for and when. Tick **Offline mode** and the app never goes online by itself: no update check, no automatic copy of each PDF to Google Drive. Check for Updates and other things you click still work when you click them. It also tells you how to check this yourself in two minutes. The full answer is on [Is it safe?](https://billing.reazix.com/help/security.html#offline-mode).

## Backups

The Backups tab holds the **Backup Management + Trash Bin** card: the automatic daily backups (Backup now, Restore, Delete), a folder on another drive for a second copy of each, and the trash bin for deleted invoices. Each part is explained on the Backups page:

- [Daily backups](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html#automatic-backups) and [restoring one](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html#restore-daily-backup)
- [Keeping a copy in another folder](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html#backup-copy)
- [Trash bin](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html#trash)

## Cloud Backup (Google Drive)

The Google Drive tab. Keeps a copy of your invoice PDFs in your own Google Drive, so you can open them from your phone or another computer, and they survive if this computer is lost.

### Easiest Way — Google Drive for Desktop (Recommended)

No setup in the app is needed.

- **Install Google Drive**Click Download Google Drive for Desktop on the card (free, from Google) and install it.
- **Sign in**With your Google account. A **Google Drive (G:)** drive appears on your computer.
- **Sync the PDFs**Move the app's Saved Invoices folder into Google Drive, or set Google Drive to back up that folder.
- **Done**Every PDF you download is now in your Drive too, at drive.google.com.

**PDFs only, not your data folder**
Sync the Saved Invoices folder, never the app's data folder: two computers writing the same data files can damage them. For your data, use [a backup folder](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html#backup-copy) or [Export Backup](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html#export-backup).

### Something wrong?

- **PDFs do not appear in Drive**: check Google Drive for Desktop is running (its icon near the clock) and signed in, and that you moved the right folder.
- **"Google Drive not configured" when exporting**: that tick box needs the Advanced setup below. The backup file still downloads to your computer.

### Advanced: Direct API Upload

For people comfortable with Google Cloud. Click **Advanced: Direct API Upload (for developers)** to open it. It lets the app upload each invoice PDF itself, and save a copy of an exported backup to Drive.

- **Make a Client ID**Click Open Google Cloud Console, create a project, enable the Drive API, and create an OAuth Client ID of type Web application, with the app's address as an allowed origin. The card shows that address in grey; it is the one in your browser's address bar, such as http://localhost:….
- **Paste it**Into **Google OAuth Client ID**. It ends in .apps.googleusercontent.com.
- **Name the folder****Drive Folder Name** is Reazix Billing Invoices to start. Backups go to a folder of the same name ending in - Backups.
- **Save**Click Save all changes: these fields are saved with Company Details.
- **Connect**Click Connect Google Drive and allow access in the Google window. **Status** then says **Connected**; Disconnect undoes it.

After that, Save & Download on an invoice also uploads its PDF, and **Also save a copy to my Google Drive** works in [Export Backup](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html#export-backup). If it stops working, connect again.

**"Enter your Google OAuth Client ID first"** means the Client ID box is empty.

## Import/Export (Data Management)

The Import/Export tab. Export Backup… saves your data to one file you keep anywhere; Import Backup… brings a file back. Your data stays on your computer: nothing is sent to us. Step by step: [Export Backup and Import Backup](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html#export-import).

## App Updates

The Updates tab. Checks whether a newer version of the app is out, and installs it.

- **Check**Click Check for Updates. It needs internet. Next to the button you see Current: v… | Latest: v….
- **Update**If there is a newer version, a green box says **New version v… is available!**. Click Update Now.
- **Wait**The message says Updating… your data is backed up first. This takes about a minute.
- **Reload**When it says Update finished, reload the page (F5) to use the new version.

Your invoices, data and saved PDFs are never touched by an update. For the other ways to update, see [Updating](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html#update).

### Something wrong?

- **"Could not check for updates"**: check your internet connection and try again.
- **"Update failed"**: the message gives the reason. Try Update Now in the [Control Panel](https://billing.reazix.com/help/control-panel.html), or update from the launcher.
- **Still the old version after updating**: reload the page, or close the browser tab and open the app again.

---

# Print and PDF settings

URL: https://billing.reazix.com/help/print-settings.html

The app-wide defaults for how every invoice looks on paper and in a PDF: business-type presets, designs, thermal receipts, copies, watermarks, fonts, colours, languages and formats. Each part of the Print & PDF tab in Settings has a ? that opens its section here. Each invoice can still override the basics from its own Customize panel.

## Print & PDF Settings: how they save

Open Settings and click the Print & PDF tab. Use it once when you start, to make your invoices look the way you want, and again whenever you change printer or paper.

There is no Save button: every change is kept the moment you make it. The Live preview on the right updates as you change things, using a sample invoice with your business name, so you can see the effect without touching a real invoice. On a narrow screen the preview moves below the settings.

Three buttons sit at the top of the card:

| Button | What it does |

| 🚀 Run setup wizard | Shows the first-run setup wizard again the next time the app is reloaded. |

| Reset defaults | Puts **every** print setting back to how it was on a fresh install, straight away and without asking. That includes your saved templates , number prefixes, signature image and letterhead, so there is no way back: use it only to start over. |

| Test Print | Sends a test print of the preview to your default printer. Pick the **Thermal (80mm)** preview tab first; in Split view it says the preview is not ready. |

These are the defaults for new invoices. On one invoice you can still turn things on or off under [Customize](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoice-options.html#show-hide).

### Something wrong?

- **The preview does not change**: thermal settings show only on the **Thermal (80mm)** preview tab, and font scale only in a downloaded PDF.
- **I pressed Reset defaults by mistake**: there is no undo. Set things again, starting with Business type and Visual style, which set most of them in two clicks.

## Business type

The first box, **⚡ Business type**. Picking the kind of business you run sets a dozen or so print settings in one go, and hides options that do not apply to you. Use it first; every setting below stays editable afterwards.

- **Pick a type**Click a card. The app asks **Apply "…" preset?** and says how many settings it will change.
- **Confirm**Click Apply preset. The card is marked **ACTIVE** and the preview changes.

| Business type | Set up for | Main settings it applies |

| Retail Shop / Kirana | A counter with a thermal printer | Bold capitals, prints straight after saving, "Qty × Rate" lines, no HSN, "Thank you! Visit again!", cut mark and 2 feed lines |

| Freelancer / Consultant | Professional A4 PDFs | Minimalist design, HSN, amount in words, page numbers and header on long invoices |

| Restaurant / Cafe / Bar | 80 mm receipts with a big UPI QR | Bold, prints on save, no HSN or amount in words, large UPI QR, 3 feed lines, "Thanks for dining with us!" |

| Wholesale / Trading | GST copies of goods invoices | Classic design, three copies (ORIGINAL, DUPLICATE, TRIPLICATE), HSN, amount in words, darker print |

| Manufacturing | Detailed A4 invoices | Corporate design, HSN, amount in words, page numbers and header, invoice QR, three copies |

| Service / Repair Shop | Simple single-copy bills | Classic design, no HSN, amount in words, signature shown |

While a business type is chosen, options it does not need are hidden, and a note says Some options are hidden because they don't apply to your … workflow. Show all options in that note clears the business type so you can see everything; your settings stay as they are. Some options are marked **★ Recommended for your business**.

This is separate from the [Business type tab](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#business-type) of Settings, which decides which screens and features you see.

## Visual style

The second box, **🎨 Visual style**: eight ready-made designs that set the colours and type for both PDFs and thermal receipts in one click. Each card shows a small invoice in its own colours; the one in use is marked **ACTIVE**. Click a card to use it, then change anything below.

| Design | Suits | Look |

| Aurora | Freelancers, tech | Cool slate with electric blue |

| Editorial | Law, consulting | Charcoal on warm ivory, capitals |

| Executive | Enterprise, B2B | Deep navy with soft champagne |

| Whisper | Designers, studios | Off-white, one hairline, nothing else |

| Sunset | Retail, cafes, salons | Warm terracotta on cream, with a tagline |

| Monoline | Developers, agencies | Monospace, dense rows, 90% size |

| Nordic | SaaS, studios | Teal on frosted white |

| Bold Retail | Fashion, sports | Black with a red accent, capitals |

**A design applies at once**
Unlike business types, a design is applied without asking. A few designs also change one or two other settings (Monoline shrinks the text to 90% and hides the "Qty × Rate" line; Sunset turns the tagline on), and those stay as they are when you pick another design.

## Thermal receipts

Four groups, **Typography**, **Layout**, **Content** and **Footer**, that only affect 58 mm and 80 mm receipt printers (the small roll printers at shop counters). A4 and A5 PDFs are not changed by them.

They are hidden when your business type prints A4 or A5 PDFs (Freelancer, Service, Wholesale, Manufacturing); a grey note says so. Pick Retail or Restaurant, or Show all options, to see them.

For setting a printer up from scratch, see [Thermal receipt printing](https://billing.reazix.com/help/thermal-printing.html). Switch the preview to **Thermal (80mm)** to see your changes.

### Typography (Thermal receipts)

| Setting | Options | Default |

| Font family | Monospace (Courier), made for thermal printers, or sans-serif (like Arial). For A4/A5 PDFs use PDF font family . | Monospace |

| Font size | Small (fits more), Medium, Large, Extra Large (easier for older customers) | Medium |

| Font weight | Normal, Bold, Ultra bold. Thermal heads print bold much darker, so bold is recommended. | Bold |

| ALL CAPS mode | Every line in capitals, like big supermarket receipts | Off |

### Layout (thermal)

| Setting | Options | Default |

| Line spacing | Compact (saves paper), Normal, Comfortable | Normal |

| Header alignment | Centre, or left | Centre |

| Thermal ink darkness | Standard, Dark (for older printers), Extra-dark. Darkens the logo and QR code so faded prints come out darker. | Standard |

| Force ALL CAPS in header | Business name always in capitals | On |

### Content (thermal)

Tick or untick what prints on the receipt: **Show business logo**, **Show HSN code per item** (needed on GST tax invoices; turn off for informal counter receipts), **Show "Qty × Rate" line per item**, **Show amount in words**, **Show bank details** and **Show UPI QR code**. All are on to start. With the QR on, **UPI QR size** is Small, Medium (the default) or Large.

With both HSN and "Qty × Rate" off, items print as a compact single line.

### Footer (thermal)

| Setting | What it does | Default |

| Custom footer message | Printed above the cut line. Leave blank for none. | "Thank you for your business!" |

| Show cut mark ("✂ cut here") | For printers without an automatic cutter. Turn off if yours cuts by itself. | On |

| Feed lines after cut | None, 1, 2, 3, 4 or 6 blank lines so the paper tears cleanly | 2 |

| Show tagline | A line of your choice under the business name, typed in **Tagline text** | Off |

## PDF & universal print features

The grey box **📄 PDF & universal print features** holds the groups below. They apply to every paper size, A4, A5, Letter, Legal and thermal, unless a group says otherwise. Each group title has its own ?.

Some groups only show for certain business types: Multi-copy for Wholesale and Manufacturing, Customer feedback QR and Reprint tracking for Retail and Restaurant, Dual currency for Freelancer and Service. With no business type chosen, everything shows.

## Auto-print

**Auto-print on save**: with this on, Save & Download also sends the invoice straight to your default printer, with no extra click. Made for busy shop counters. Off by default. It can also be turned on for one client only, in their details.

## Watermark

A large, faint diagonal word across every page of the PDF, such as PAID or DRAFT.

- **Turn it on**Tick **Show watermark**. More settings appear.
- **Choose the word**Pick one under **Watermark text**: PAID, DUPLICATE (the default), DRAFT, OVERDUE, COPY, ORIGINAL, CANCELLED or REPRINT. Or tick **Use custom text instead of preset** and type your own in **Custom watermark text**, such as FOR INTERNAL USE.
- **Choose how strong****Opacity**: very faint (5%) to very strong (40%); medium (15%) is the default.

If you choose your own text and leave the box empty, no watermark prints. Watermarks are never printed on thermal receipts. Cancelled invoices get their own CANCELLED mark whatever this setting says.

## Multi-copy (GST rule 48)

GST rules expect three copies of an invoice for goods (for the buyer, the transporter and yourself) and two for services. Tick **Print multiple copies with labels** and choose the **Number of copies**: 2 (Original + Duplicate, for services) or 3 (Original + Duplicate + Triplicate, for goods; the default). The PDF then holds every page once for each copy, labelled in a small box at the top right:

- ORIGINAL FOR RECIPIENT
- DUPLICATE FOR TRANSPORTER
- TRIPLICATE FOR SUPPLIER

Shown for the Wholesale and Manufacturing business types, or with none chosen.

## Multi-page invoices

| Setting | What it does | Default |

| Page numbers on pages 2+ | Prints "Page 2 of 3" at the bottom right of the second page onwards. The first page is not numbered. | On |

| Business name header on pages 2+ | Repeats your business name, with a line under it, at the top of every page after the first | On |

Both only appear when an invoice runs to more than one page. Page breaks always fall between rows, and never through the signature, stamp or an image.

## Print margins (mm)

**Top**, **Bottom**, **Left** and **Right**, in millimetres, from 0 to 100 (all 0 to start). Use them when printing on pre-printed letterhead paper, to move the invoice clear of the printed logo, or to leave room for binding. For example, a top margin of 40 starts the invoice 4 cm down the page.

## Verification codes

- **Invoice number as QR**: an 18 mm QR code at the bottom right of the last page, captioned "Verify invoice". It holds the invoice number, or, if you type a **Verification URL (optional)** such as https://mycompany.com/verify/{invoice_number}, that address with the number filled in. Off by default.
- **Invoice number as barcode text**: prints the invoice number large, in a typewriter font, at the bottom left of the last page, for filing. It is text, not a scannable barcode. Off by default.

Neither is the GST e-invoice QR code; that comes with [E-invoicing](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-returns.html#e-invoice).

## Customer feedback QR

Tick **Feedback / review QR** to print a QR code at the bottom left of the PDF that opens any web address, such as your Google review page or a WhatsApp chat. Paste the address in **URL to encode**; it only prints once an address is entered. **Label above QR**, "Rate us · Give feedback" unless you change it, prints with the code. Shown for the Retail and Restaurant business types, or with none chosen.

## Digital signature

A default signature, used when a business has none of its own. **Show signature on invoice** is on to start. Upload a picture (PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG, up to 2 MB) with **Upload signature**; Remove signature takes it off. **Signatory name**, such as Rakesh Kumar · Director, prints under it; left blank, the business name is used.

A signature and stamp uploaded in [Settings, Branding](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#branding) for a business take priority over this one.

## Terms & Conditions on a separate page

**Print T&C on a separate page** moves long terms and notes to a page of their own, instead of squeezing them under the totals. Only affects invoices that have terms. Off by default. Your terms themselves are kept in [Terms & Conditions Templates](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#terms).

## PDF font family

**Font used in generated PDFs**: Helvetica (clean, the default), Times New Roman (traditional and formal), or Courier (typewriter style). It applies to A4, A5, Letter and Legal PDFs; thermal receipts have their own font setting.

## Layout & printer compatibility

- **Compact upper header (fit more items on page 1)**: tightens the space above the items table so more rows fit on the first page. Use it when invoices often spill onto page 2. Off by default.
- **Thermal buffer-safe mode**: for cheap or old receipt printers that jam or stop half-way on large print jobs. Prints in black and white at lower quality. Off by default.
- **Thermal print method**: **Direct HTML**, the default, sends sharp text straight to the printer. If your printer or browser mishandles it, choose **Via PDF**.

## Custom prefix per invoice type

Each document type numbers separately, with a built-in prefix: INV for Tax Invoice, QUO for Quotation, EST for Proforma / Estimate, BOS for Bill of Supply, COMP for Composition, CN for Credit Note and DC for Delivery Challan. Type your own in the box next to a type to replace it: letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores only, up to 8 characters. Leave it blank to use the built-in one.

A new prefix starts its own count from 1. The rest of the number (year, separator, digits) follows [Invoice Number Format](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#invoice-numbers).

## Reprint tracking

**Show REPRINT badge on reprints**: once an invoice has been printed before, this prints a red "REPRINT · Copy #2" (and so on) at the top of each page, so a copy cannot pass as the original. Off by default. The app counts every print either way. Shown for the Retail and Restaurant business types, or with none chosen.

## PDF quality vs file size

**Print quality**: Draft (about half the file size, fine for email and WhatsApp), Standard (balanced), or HD (sharpest text, largest file, best for printing and keeping). HD is the default.

## Dual currency display

For rupee invoices to clients abroad. Tick **Show foreign-currency equivalent** to show the total in a second currency too.

- **Secondary currency**: USD, EUR, GBP, AED, SGD, AUD or JPY.
- **Rate (1 USD = ? INR)**: you set it, 83 to start. There is no live exchange rate; update it yourself.
- **Display position**: on a line below the ₹ amount, or in brackets after it.

Shown for the Freelancer and Service business types, or with none chosen.

On an invoice billed in another currency (for example US dollars), the same switch adds the rupee total to the invoice's EXCHANGE RATE line, at that invoice's own rate: 1 USD = 84.1000 INR · Total ₹84,100.00. See [Billing in another currency](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoices.html#currency).

## Company letterhead

If you have printed stationery, upload it as a picture and invoices print on top of it.

- **Turn it on**Tick **Use pre-printed letterhead image**.
- **Upload**Under **Upload letterhead**, pick a PNG, JPG or WebP picture of the full A4 page, up to 3 MB. Until you do, a yellow warning says the switch does nothing yet.
- **Avoid printing your details twice****Hide invoice header block**, on by default, drops the app's own header because the letterhead already has your name and address.

Remove letterhead takes the picture off. Use Print margins to keep the invoice clear of the letterhead's printed parts.

## PDF template style (visual design)

**Template** changes the header and table style of A4 and A5 PDFs: Modern (a coloured header, the default), Classic (professional), Minimal (lots of white space), Corporate (formal blue), Minimalist (grey), Boxed grid (ruled boxes, like a quotation pad) and Tally style (order boxes, an HSN tax summary and a declaration). A design chosen under Visual style sets this for you. Thermal receipts have their own compact layout.

## Print darkness

**Force darker text on printed PDF** darkens grey labels and addresses so they do not fade on paper printers. On by default. It only changes the PDF, not the screen. Turn it off if your printer already prints greys crisply.

## PDF font scale

A slider for the **Overall size** of the PDF, from 80% to 140% (100% to start). Smaller fits more on a page; larger is easier to read. The on-screen preview always shows 100%; download a PDF to see the result.

## PDF Style Editor: your own colours

To match your brand, tick **Use custom colours** and set six colours with the colour picker or a hex code such as #1e40af. The preview changes as you go. Reset colours to defaults undoes them.

| Colour | Used for |

| Primary text | Client name, item names, totals |

| Muted text | Labels, addresses, dates and numbers |

| Accent colour | Section titles and the table header |

| Accent text | Text on the accent colour, usually white |

| Header background | Behind the business name and invoice title |

| Divider lines | Lines between sections and table rows |

Keep text dark on a light background so it prints clearly.

## Section labels and language

**Language preset** prints the section labels in English, Hindi, Tamil, Marathi or Bengali. You can also type your own wording for six labels: **BILL TO**, **PLACE OF SUPPLY**, **BANK DETAILS**, **AMOUNT IN WORDS**, **TERMS & CONDITIONS** and **NOTES**. The grey text in each box shows the current wording. Your own wording wins over the language; clear the box to go back.

## Formatting: date, number, currency

| Setting | Options |

| Date format | 02 Apr 2026 (Indian, the default), 02-Apr-2026, 02/04/2026, 04/02/2026 (US), 2026-04-02, or ISO 8601 |

| Number grouping | 1,00,000.00 (Indian, the default), 100,000.00 (Western), 100.000,00 (European) |

| Decimal places | 0, 2 (the default), 3 or 4 |

| Currency symbol position | Before the number (₹100, the default) or after it |

## Totals: round off invoice totals

Under **🧮 Totals**. **Round off invoice totals**: when on, new invoices round the grand total to the nearest rupee and print the difference as a **Round-off** line, such as −0.40. It is on for new installs and saves as soon as you click. You can still turn it off for one invoice in [Customize](https://billing.reazix.com/help/invoice-options.html#show-hide), under Totals. Changing it never alters invoices you have already saved.

## Row density

**Vertical spacing in tables + sections**: Compact (fits more per page), Normal (the default) or Comfortable (easier to read). It changes both the PDF and the on-screen preview.

## Custom tax rate presets

The built-in GST rates are 0, 0.1, 0.25, 3, 5, 12, 18, 28 and 40%. Since 22 September 2025 most goods are at 5%, 18% or 40%; 12% and 28% stay for older invoices (see [GST basics: what rate do I charge?](https://billing.reazix.com/help/gst-basics.html#which-rate)). Add your own, such as 1.5% or 7.5%: type the numbers separated by commas, such as 1.5, 7.5, and click Add. Each must be between 0 and 100. They appear in the rate list on every invoice. The × next to a rate removes it.

## My saved templates

Save your whole print setup under a name, so you can switch between setups (for example one for A4 and one for the receipt printer). Reset defaults clears the saved templates too.

- **Name it**Type a name, such as Retail v1.
- **Save it**Click Save current as template. It appears in the list.

Load brings one back after asking. It replaces your current settings, so save the current setup first if you want to keep it. The bin deletes a template.

## Live preview

On the right of the tab (below the settings on a narrow screen). Three tabs: **📄 PDF (A4)**, **🖨 Thermal (80mm)**, and **⊞ Split view** with both side by side. It shows a sample invoice numbered TEST/PRINT/0001 with three items, using your business name, so terms and notes are not shown. Some settings, such as font scale, only show in a downloaded PDF.

---

# Backups, updates and moving PC

URL: https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html

Your data is plain files on your own computer. Here is how it is backed up, how to keep a copy somewhere safe, update the app, and move to a new computer.

## Where your data is

Everything is in the _system\data folder inside the app's folder. The installer hides _system to keep things tidy; in File Explorer, turn on **View, Show, Hidden items** to see it. Open Data Folder in the [Control Panel](https://billing.reazix.com/help/control-panel.html) opens it for you.

Downloaded PDFs are also kept in the app's Saved Invoices folder, one folder per client.

## Daily backups (Backup Management)

Every day the app copies all your data, invoices, clients, products, purchases, expenses, settings and the trash, into a dated backup, and keeps the last 30 days. The first backup of the day is made a few seconds after the app starts, and a computer left on overnight makes the next one soon after midnight. You do not have to do anything.

They are on the Backups tab of Settings, in the **💾 Backup Management + 🗑 Trash Bin** card:

| Part of the card | What it does |

| Backup now | Makes today's backup straight away, for example before a big change. The message says Manual backup triggered . |

| **Also keep a copy of every daily backup in this folder** | A second copy on another drive. See Keeping a copy somewhere else . |

| **📅 Daily backups** | The list of backups, newest first, with Restore and Delete . See Restoring a daily backup . |

| **🗑 Trash bin** | Deleted invoices, kept for 30 days. See Trash bin . |

**These are on the same computer**
Daily backups protect you from mistakes, not from a broken hard disk or a lost laptop. Keep a copy somewhere else too.

### Restoring a daily backup

Each row of **📅 Daily backups** shows the date and time it was made, and also in your backup folder when a second copy exists. Use Restore when something went badly wrong, for example many records deleted by mistake, and you want **all** your data back as it was on that day.

- **Pick the day**Find the last day your data was right and click Restore on its row.
- **Confirm**The app asks **Restore all data from backup …?** and explains that it overwrites your current data. Click Restore backup.
- **Reload**When it says Backup restored — please reload the page, press F5.

Before restoring, the app saves your data as it is now in data/backups/pre-restore-…, so you can go back if the restore looks wrong.

Delete removes one backup after asking, to free space; the copy in your backup folder stays. A row marked in your backup folder only has no Delete button.

**Only one invoice is wrong?**
Restoring a day puts **everything** back to that day, including work done since. For one deleted invoice, use the Trash bin instead.

## Keeping a copy somewhere else

**Every day, automatically, on another drive.** On the Backups tab of Settings, under **Also keep a copy of every daily backup in this folder**:

- **Type a folder**On another drive, a USB disk or a synced folder, such as D:\ReazixBilling or E:\.
- **Save it**Click Save folder. The app checks it can write there and copies today's backup at once. The message says where the copies go.

Each daily backup is then also copied into Reazix Billing Backups\date inside that folder, keeping 30 days. The line under the box shows where. If a copy fails (a USB disk not plugged in), the card says so in red. Stop copying turns it off; copies already made stay.

**If the computer fails**: install the app again, set the same folder here, and its backups appear in the list with Restore.

Or by hand:

- **One click**: Create Backup in the [Control Panel](https://billing.reazix.com/help/control-panel.html), or Back up my data in the launcher under More options, saves a ZIP in Documents\Reazix Billing Backups. Copy it to a pen drive or cloud storage.
- **One file you choose**: see Export Backup.
- **Google Drive**: see [Cloud Backup (Google Drive)](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#google-drive).

### Something wrong?

- **"Could not use that folder"**: the folder does not exist, or the app may not write there. Make the folder first in File Explorer, or pick another drive.
- **"copying today's backup failed"**: the folder was saved, but the drive was not ready. Plug the disk in; the next daily backup tries again.

## Export Backup and Import Backup (Data Management)

On the Import/Export tab of Settings, the **Data Management** card saves your data to one file, or brings a file back. Use it to keep a copy on a pen drive, to move data to another computer, or to bring back just your clients or products from an older backup.

Your data is on this computer only. Nothing is uploaded to us or anyone else; the only time anything leaves your computer is when you tick **Also save a copy to my Google Drive**, which goes to **your own** Drive. The file is plain text (JSON) you can keep anywhere.

- Export Backup…: see Export Backup.
- Import Backup…: see Restore from Backup.

### Export Backup

- **Open it**Click Export Backup…. A window lists every part of your data, all ticked.
- **Choose what to include**Untick anything you do not want. Select all and Clear all tick or untick every one.
- **Google Drive copy (optional)**Tick **Also save a copy to my Google Drive** if you set up [Direct API Upload](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#google-drive-api).
- **Download**Click Download Backup. The file reazix-backup-date.json goes to your Downloads folder. Copy it somewhere safe.

| Part | What is in it |

| Active business profile | Name, address, GSTIN, bank, logo, signature |

| All business profiles | Every business in [Business Profiles](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#business-profiles) |

| Invoices / bills | Tax invoices, proforma, credit notes and the rest |

| Clients | Your client list |

| Products / Inventory | Products with HSN, rate and stock |

| Expenses | Expense entries and the cash book |

| Purchase bills | Supplier bills used for ITC, and purchase orders |

| Recurring invoices | Repeat-billing schedules |

| Receipts | Payment receipts |

| Terms templates | Your terms and conditions templates |

| App settings | Region, features, invoice number format, display options |

| Local preferences | Custom units, theme, last region choice |

### Restore from Backup

- **Pick the file**Click Import Backup… and choose a .json backup file.
- **Check what is in it**The **Restore from Backup** window shows when the file was made and, for each part, how many items it holds. Parts the file has are ticked; empty parts say empty and cannot be ticked.
- **Choose what to restore**Untick anything you want to keep as it is now. Select all (with data) and Clear all help.
- **Restore**Click Restore selected. The message lists what came back, such as Restored: 120 invoice(s), 45 client(s).

Records in the file **replace the matching records** in the app; records the file does not have are left alone, and parts you did not tick are untouched. Export your current data first, just in case.

### Something wrong?

- **"This file doesn't look like a Reazix Billing backup"**: you picked a different file. Backups are named reazix-backup-date.json. A ZIP from the Control Panel is restored there, with Choose Backup ZIP.
- **Restored, but I do not see it**: reload the page, and check the business selected at the top of the sidebar.

## Trash bin

Invoices deleted from a client's account on the [Clients](https://billing.reazix.com/help/clients.html#ledger) screen, or from the invoice list, go to the trash for 30 days, then are removed for good. They are listed under **🗑 Trash bin** on the Backups tab of Settings, with the invoice number, client and date deleted.

- Restore puts the invoice back where it was. The stock its delete returned is taken out again. The message says Invoice restored.
- Delete forever removes it and its PDF straight away, after asking. This cannot be undone.

For an invoice already given to a client, [cancel it](https://billing.reazix.com/help/dashboard.html#cancel) instead of deleting it, so its number stays in your records.

## Moving to a new computer

- **On the old computer**Click Export for Move in the [Control Panel](https://billing.reazix.com/help/control-panel.html), or Move to another PC in the launcher under More options. It saves your data and settings as one ZIP on your Desktop. Copy it to a pen drive or cloud storage.
- **On the new computer**[Install the app](https://billing.reazix.com/help/install.html) as usual.
- **Bring your data in**In the new Control Panel, click Choose Backup ZIP under **Restore Backup** and pick the file.

You can use an exported backup file instead: export on the old computer, and import it in Settings on the new one.

**One computer at a time**
Do not run the same data on two computers at once, for example through a shared OneDrive or Dropbox folder. Two copies writing the same files can damage them.

## Updating

Any of these installs the newest version:

- The Update to v… button that appears in the sidebar when a new version is out. It shows what changed, with Update Now, Remind me later and Skip this version.
- Update Now in [Settings, App Updates](https://billing.reazix.com/help/settings.html#updates).
- Update Now in the [Control Panel](https://billing.reazix.com/help/control-panel.html).
- In the launcher, More options, then Update to the latest version.

Every update first saves a backup of your data in Documents\Reazix Billing Backups, then replaces the app. It never touches your data folder or your saved PDFs. It takes about a minute; reload the page when it finishes.

To update by hand instead: download the ZIP, stop the app, extract the ZIP over your app folder replacing the files, and open the launcher again.

If you extract a new ZIP into a different folder by mistake, its launcher does not install a second copy. It shows **Already installed on this computer**, with the folder, version and number of invoices, and offers Update the installed copy and Open the installed copy. The update uses the files in the folder you extracted, so it needs no download and works without internet; your invoices, saved PDFs and trash stay as they are. The new folder can then be deleted.

Updating also removes files that older versions left behind, such as launchers under their old names, once their replacements are in place. Your data, backups and Node.js are never touched.

---

# Control Panel

URL: https://billing.reazix.com/help/control-panel.html

Update, back up, restore, move to another PC, open your folders, and stop the app, from inside the app.

## What it is

Control Panel in the sidebar does the launcher's jobs without leaving the app. At the top it shows your system, Node.js version, the port the app runs on, and how much space your data takes.

## The buttons

| Card | Button | What it does |

| Update Software | Update Now | Downloads the latest version. Your data is backed up first and never touched. |

| Backup Data | Create Backup | Saves your data as a dated ZIP in Documents\Reazix Billing Backups . |

| Restore Backup | Choose Backup ZIP | Pick a backup ZIP to restore. What you have now is saved first, as a safety net. |

| Move to Another PC | Export for Move | Saves your data and settings as one ZIP on your Desktop. See [Moving to a new computer](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html#move-pc). |

| Open Data Folder | Open | Opens the folder with your bills, clients, products and settings. |

| Open Backups Folder | Open | Opens Documents\Reazix Billing Backups . |

| Restart the App | Restart | Restarts the app when something is not working, then reloads the page. |

| Stop Server | Stop Server | Stops the app. Open it again from the launcher or shortcut. |

| Remove the App | Remove… | Uninstalls the app. You tick whether your data, PDFs and backups are deleted too. Where it cannot remove itself, the button reads How to remove it and opens the steps. |

After each action a panel shows whether it worked, with the details underneath if something went wrong. See The result panel. Each button is explained step by step below.

## Each button in detail

One section per card: what it does, when to use it, what to click, and what to do if something looks wrong. Nothing here deletes your bills, clients or products. Anything that changes your data saves a copy first.

### Update Software

**What it does.** Downloads the newest version from billing.reazix.com and puts it in place of the old one. Your data folder is not changed.

**When to use it.** When a new version is out or a problem you reported has been fixed. You need internet.

- Click Update Now. The button shows **Updating...**; wait until it finishes. It can take a few minutes.
- **Windows:** a black window opens. It first saves a backup of your data, pre-update-date.zip, in Documents\Reazix Billing Backups, then downloads and applies the update. It ends with **[OK] Update complete!**
- **Mac and Linux:** it does the same, saving the backup as pre-update-date.tar.gz in Documents/Reazix Billing Backups. If you already have the newest version it says so and changes nothing. It ends with **[OK] Update complete** and the old and new version numbers.
- Restart the app to run the new version: click Stop Server (see Stop Server), then open the app again from its icon or launcher. Then press Ctrl + F5 (Mac: &#8984; + Shift + R).

**Is it safe?** Yes. Your data is backed up first and the update never touches the data folder. On Mac and Linux, if the update fails half way, the old app files are put back.

**Something wrong?**

- "Update complete" but the old version still shows: [the old version is still there](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#update-not-showing).
- An error, or "could not reach billing.reazix.com": [an update went wrong](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#update-failed). On Linux or Mac also see [the Linux update stopped](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#linux-update-failed).
- The button says **Not available here**: scripts not found.

### Backup Data

**What it does.** Saves all your bills, clients, products and settings as one dated ZIP file, backup-date_time.zip, in the Documents\Reazix Billing Backups folder (Mac and Linux: Documents/Reazix Billing Backups).

**When to use it.** Before a big change, at the end of the month, or any time you want a copy to keep on a pen drive. The app also makes its own daily backup; this is an extra one at a moment you choose.

- Click Create Backup. It shows **Backing up...** for a moment.
- The result panel below says **Backup - OK**, with the file name and size in its output. A folder window usually opens with the new file shown.
- Copy that ZIP to a pen drive or cloud storage so it survives if this computer breaks. Open Backups Folder on the Control Panel opens the folder.

**Is it safe?** Yes. It only reads your data and writes a new file. Old backups are never replaced.

**Something wrong?** If it says "No data folder found - nothing to back up", or fails with a disk or permission message, see [a backup or restore failed](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#restore-failed), [the disk is full](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#disk-full) and [the app is not allowed to write](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#no-permission). More ways to back up: [Backups and updates](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html).

### Restore Backup

**What it does.** Replaces the data in the app with the data from a backup ZIP you choose.

**When to use it.** After moving to a new computer, or to go back to how things were on an earlier day. It works with ZIPs made by Create Backup or Export for Move.

- **Windows.** Click Choose Backup ZIP. A file window opens in your Reazix Billing Backups folder. Pick the ZIP and click **Open**. (Close the window to cancel; nothing changes.)
- The app first saves what you have now as pre-restore-date.zip in the same folder. This is your way back if you chose the wrong file.
- It then replaces the data with the backup's contents and shows **[OK] Restore complete!** Press **Enter** to close the black window.
- Restart the app (Stop Server, then open it again) to see the restored data.

**Mac and Linux:** this button says **Not available here**. To bring data back there, use **Settings, Backup Management, Import Backup** with a file saved by Export Backup (see [Export and import](https://billing.reazix.com/help/backup.html#export-import)).

**Is it safe?** Your current data is replaced by the backup, so what you entered after that backup was made will not be there. That is why a pre-restore copy is saved first. Keep it until you are happy.

**Something wrong?** See [a backup or restore failed](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#restore-failed). If the old data still shows, restart the app; if it will not open, see [the server has not answered](https://billing.reazix.com/help/troubleshooting.html#not-answered).

### Move to Another PC

**What it does.** Saves your data as one ZIP on your Desktop named MOVE-ReazixBilling-date_time.zip, ready to carry to a new computer.

**When to use it.** When you buy a new computer, or want the same books on a second one.
